papers.abstract: Verification is increasingly critical across various inference and learning paradigms, such as test-time scaling, recursive intelligence and automated research, where feedback can improve efficiency and optimization. Common score-based verifiers, or discriminative reward models, predict a scalar reward for an output. While useful for filtering, rewarding, and ranking, such scores provide no explicit, auditable evidentiary basis for the judgment. In parallel, although existing generative process reward models offer text feedback, most designs do not fully exploit agentic capabilities, such as tool use and iterative reasoning, which are essential for fact-checking and fine-grained claim verification. In this paper, we address these limitations by introducing Agent-as-a-Verifier, an agentic, certificate-producing verification system that places role-separated LLM agents inside a formal-methods-inspired claim-obligation-certificate protocol. Given a generation candidate, Agent-as-a-Verifier produces a certificate by extracting a verdict-blind dependency graph of claims, independently compiling the task's acceptance contract, and deriving checkable obligations. On Terminal-Bench 2.1, Agent-as-a-Verifier achieves higher accuracy than the state-of-the-art approach. Across different downstream applications, the augmented agent also outperforms the plain agent on FrontierMath and CyberGym. More importantly, Agent-as-a-Verifier is able to identify reward-hacking solutions that deceive the benchmark evaluator, highlighting its broader potential for iterative and recursive agent optimization. Code is available at https://github.com/sunyxedu/General-Verifier

analysis.key_results: 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上，准确率超过现有最优方法；在 FrontierMath 和 CyberGym 下游应用中，增强后的智能体优于普通智能体；并能识别欺骗基准评估器的奖励黑客解决方案。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 Agent-as-a-Verifier，一个基于代理的证书生成验证系统，通过角色分工和依赖图提取来生成可检查的验证证书。
analysis.method: 将验证任务形式化为基于主张-义务-证书协议的流程：提取与裁决无关的依赖图，编译任务的验收契约，并推导可检查的义务。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一个智能体式验证系统，用基于证据的证书和角色分工的 LLM 智能体替代单纯打分，提高验证准确性和可审计性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作关注通用 LLM 验证，不涉及机器人、视觉-语言-动作模型或世界模型，但“验证”这一概念与高效推理中的投机解码中的验证有间接关联，但无直接技术重叠。

papers.abstract: World models are increasingly used in robotics to improve the performance of embodied models. Compared with general-purpose video generation, robotics places more stringent requirements on world models. Generated videos must satisfy fine-grained physical constraints on robot motion and object interactions. However, existing world model benchmarks can overlook robotics specific physical details and struggle to assess them accurately. To address this problem, we introduce WorldPhy, a world model benchmark for accurate, fine-grained evaluation of physical plausibility in robotics. Our benchmark contains 300 tasks, each consisting of an initial-frame image and a task instruction, covering diverse robotics scenes, task categories, viewpoints, and robot configurations. We further collect over 12K high-quality human annotations, and use them to train WorldPhyReward to accurately provide scores and reasons across six fine-grained physical dimensions and an instruction-following dimension. Comparisons with general VLMs and existing reward models show that WorldPhyReward better aligns with human ratings. We system- atically evaluate 13 frontier open and closed-source world models. The results reveal that current world models struggle to consistently maintain fine-grained physical plausibility across different robotics scenarios. Our code is available at https://github.com/chuziyuan139/ WorldPhy.

analysis.key_results: WorldPhyReward 与人类评分的一致性优于通用 VLM 和现有奖励模型；对 13 个前沿世界模型的评估表明，当前模型在机器人场景中难以持续保持细粒度物理合理性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 WorldPhy 基准，通过多维度物理合理性评估和训练奖励模型，系统评估现有世界模型在机器人场景下的物理一致性。
analysis.method: 构建包含初始帧图像和任务指令的 300 个任务，收集 12K+ 高质量人工标注，训练 WorldPhyReward 模型从六个细粒度物理维度和指令跟随维度进行评分和归因。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: WorldPhy 是一个用于评估机器人世界模型生成视频的细粒度物理合理性的基准，包含 300 个任务、12K+ 人工标注和训练得到的奖励模型。

papers.abstract: We present CoTacWAM, a world-action model that learns shared contact semantics between wrist vision and touch, achieving the best observed performance in our nominal manipulation and missing-input evaluations. The two modalities observe the same local interaction through different signals: wrist images reveal nearby geometry, while touch records physical contact. Our approach connects their common contact meaning while preserving the evidence unique to each modality, giving the policy a joint description of interaction across available input combinations. This representation supports predictive action learning alongside head-view scene context and conditions corrections after an independent detector confirms a failed attempt. Experiments across four real-world tasks demonstrate improved manipulation performance over the evaluated baselines, robustness to missing local observations, and further gains from autonomous retries.

analysis.key_results: 在四个真实世界任务中，相较于基线模型提升了操作性能，对缺失局部观测具有鲁棒性，并通过自主重试获得了进一步增益。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 CoTacWAM，学习腕部视觉和触觉之间的共享接触语义，同时保留各模态特有证据，为策略提供联合交互描述，并支持预测性动作学习与自主重试。
analysis.method: 通过共享接触语义连接腕部图像和触觉信息，在头部场景上下文基础上进行预测性动作学习，并在独立检测器确认失败后触发纠正。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: CoTacWAM 是一个学习腕部视觉和触觉共享接触语义的世界-动作模型，在名义操作和缺失输入评估中表现最佳。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接提出了一种世界-动作模型（WAM），结合腕部视觉和触觉来建模机器人与环境的交互，属于 WAM 在机器人操作中的核心应用，与本站主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Open-world aerial object search methods often rely on persistent spatial maps, learned world models, or task-specific policy training. To examine how far a minimal, training-free design can go, we introduce SimpleUAV, an agent built around a frozen, off-the-shelf vision-language model (VLM). SimpleUAV separates current-view target assessment from history-conditioned action selection, combining fresh candidate evidence with lightweight search context. Local geometry converts visual selections into bounded straight-line movements, depth-based checks halt blocked segments, and measured execution feedback guides subsequent decisions. This closed loop sustains search without persistent spatial maps or task-specific training. SimpleUAV achieves 41.61% Success Rate (SR) on UAV-ON and 11.98% on AerialDojo-200K, compared with 23.80% and 3.20% for the strongest prior baselines, respectively. With limited benchmark-specific adaptation, the same core agent transfers to aerial Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) on TravelUAV, improving Full SR by at least 19.66% across all three splits under L1 assistance. These results establish a strong baseline for evaluating when additional architectural complexity benefits aerial search.

analysis.key_results: 在 UAV-ON 上达到 41.61% 成功率，在 AerialDojo-200K 上达到 11.98%，分别比最强基线高 17.81% 和 8.78%；在 TravelUAV 上，Full SR 在 L1 辅助下所有三个划分至少提高 19.66%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了 SimpleUAV，一个基于冻结 VLM 的无训练空中目标搜索智能体，将当前视图目标评估与历史条件动作选择分离，并利用局部几何和深度反馈实现闭环搜索。
analysis.method: 使用冻结的视觉语言模型进行目标评估和动作选择，结合局部几何转换为有界直线运动，深度检查停止被阻挡的段，以及测量执行反馈指导后续决策，无需持久空间地图或任务特定训练。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: SimpleUAV 利用冻结的视觉语言模型，在无训练、无持久空间地图的情况下实现空中目标搜索，并在多个基准上显著超越基线。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作使用 VLA 方法进行空中机器人搜索，不涉及世界模型或机器人操作，但展示了无需训练、无地图的视觉语言策略在机器人任务中的潜力，对 VLA 研究有参考价值。

Given a language goal and four RGB-D views (front, left, right, and downward), SimpleUAV executes three stages without persistent maps or task-specific training. (1) Select (Section 3.2 ): A frozen VLM detects candidate boxes ( ℬ t \mathcal{B}_{t} ) from current RGB views. Depth and camera calibration provide 3D candidate locations to construct ( 𝒞 t \mathcal{C}_{t} ), and a second VLM query selects an action ( a t a_{t} ) using this catalog and lightweight interaction history. (2) Fly Straight (Section 3.3 ): The selected region or candidate determines a 3D waypoint ( w t w_{t} ) for exploration ( Explore h \text{Explore}_{h} , Explore v \text{Explore}_{v} ) or Approach , and the UAV moves from 𝒙 t \bm{x}_{t} along a bounded straight-line segment. papers.abstract: Multi-token prediction (MTP) modules and EAGLE-style drafters support efficient speculative decoding by reusing target-model hidden states. Their autoregressive use, however, introduces a training-inference mismatch: training supplies sequences of hidden states from the backbone or a single MTP step, whereas inference attends to a target-model prefix followed by a growing tail of recurrently generated MTP states. EAGLE-3's training-time test (TTT) explicitly simulates this behavior during training, at the cost of additional memory and specialized attention masks. We introduce two training-only methods for improving autoregressive drafting. Hidden State Mixing (HSM) samples among backbone and MTP hidden states aligned to the same prediction target, exposing the drafter to mixtures of states from different MTP steps without explicitly simulating inference. Hidden State Gradient Detach (HSGD) is a regularization method that stochastically blocks gradients through hidden state and embedding pathways while preserving the forward computation. Neither method adds inference cost. In joint pretraining followed by supervised fine-tuning, HSGD yields the highest acceptance rates at early draft positions, while HSM performs best later in the draft. These acceptance rate trends favor HSM for long-draft-length serving and HSGD for short-draft-length serving. Furthermore, across four Nemotron models and DeepSeek-V4-Pro, HSM-based MTP boosting with a frozen backbone improves mean acceptance length by up to 52.2% over the co-trained MTP. For EAGLE-3 drafters, HSM offers competitive acceptance with TTT, with 48% lower peak reserved training memory in a four-step Qwen3-8B comparison. HSM implementations are publicly available in Megatron-LM and NVIDIA Model Optimizer.

analysis.key_results: HSGD在早期草稿位置接受率最高，HSM在后期更好；在四个Nemotron模型和DeepSeek-V4-Pro上，HSM的MTP增强最高将平均接受长度提升52.2%；HSM相比EAGLE-3的TTT在四步Qwen3-8B中接受率相当，训练峰值内存降低48%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出两种仅训练阶段的方法：隐状态混合（HSM）和隐状态梯度截断（HSGD），用于改善自回归起草器的训练-推理失配，且不增加推理开销。
analysis.method: HSM在训练时对与同一预测目标对齐的主干和MTP隐状态进行采样混合；HSGD随机阻断隐状态和嵌入路径的梯度以正则化，两者均保留前向计算。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出两种训练方法改进多token预测和EAGLE式起草器在猜测性解码中的自回归起草能力，无需增加推理成本。

papers.abstract: Given a continuous RGB-D stream and a language request, streaming 3D affordance grounding requires an agent to decide when to respond and where to locate the requested functional part using only observations available so far. Existing 3D affordance grounding methods typically assume complete scene observations, while streaming vision-language models lack fine-grained 3D functional grounding. Our goal is to jointly determine response timing and functional-part localization during continuous scene observation. We propose StreamAff, an evidence-guided response strategy that makes both decisions from the grounding model's own visual evidence. The model scores the visual patches of the frames it reads: their combined support, weighed against a wait option, decides when to respond, and the highest-scoring patch selects the frame to ground in. A conditional look-back policy lets the model answer from an earlier observation at the moment of the request or wait for new evidence, and zoom-and-refine grounding segments the part named in the answer on the 3D points of the selected frame. We further introduce StreamFun3D, a benchmark derived from real-world 3D scenes that evaluates response timing and grounding across four evidence settings: Current, History, Future, and Unobserved, together with StreamIoU, a metric that credits a mask only when the response is timely and grounded in a valid source frame. We adapt offline 3D affordance grounding methods and build external-decider baselines that pair vision-language models with our mask decoder. StreamAff achieves 30.14% StreamIoU on 15-second streams, a 40.6% relative improvement over the strongest of these baselines.

analysis.key_results: 在15秒流上达到30.14%的StreamIoU，比最强基线相对提升40.6%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出StreamAff，一种证据引导的响应策略，结合条件回顾策略和缩放细化定位，在连续场景观察中联合确定响应时机和功能部位定位。
analysis.method: 模型对读取帧的视觉块进行打分，结合等待选项决定何时响应，最高分块选择用于定位的帧；条件回顾策略允许从请求时刻的早期观察回答或等待新证据；缩放细化在所选帧的3D点上分割出答案中命名的部位。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种基于视觉证据的流式3D可供性定位方法，能够根据连续RGB-D流和语言请求联合决定响应时机并定位功能部位。

papers.abstract: Dynamic object manipulation requires maintaining spatial and temporal alignment with targets that continue to move during inference and execution. Although future prediction can inform action correction, an accurate forecast does not establish whether modifying an existing action would be beneficial. We present Aegis-VLA, a world-model-guided vision-language-action (VLA) framework that generates predictive action corrections and separately determines whether and how strongly to apply them. A Trajectory World Model combines kinematic extrapolation with learned residual dynamics to predict object motion and estimate positional uncertainty. Discrepancy-Guided Action Refinement uses differences between history-only and base-action-conditioned end-effector forecasts to propose bounded arm corrections. A Reliability Gate learns when to admit corrections based on demonstration-relative improvements over base actions, and regulates their application during inference using predictive uncertainty and anticipated object--end-effector proximity. Rejected corrections preserve the corresponding base actions. Aegis-VLA introduces only approximately 2.45M trainable parameters. On the simulated Dynamic Object Manipulation (DOM) benchmark, Aegis-VLA achieves 56.72\% success over 1,800 evaluation trials, exceeding our reproduced DynamicVLA baseline of 45.44\% by 11.28 percentage points.

analysis.key_results: 在仿真动态物体操作（DOM）基准上，Aegis-VLA在1800次评估试验中达到56.72%成功率，超过复现的DynamicVLA基线（45.44%）11.28个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Aegis-VLA框架，包括轨迹世界模型、差异引导动作修正和可靠性门控，仅增加约2.45M可训练参数，在动态物体操作基准上显著超越基线。
analysis.method: 轨迹世界模型结合运动学外推与学习残差动力学预测物体运动并估计位置不确定性；差异引导动作修正利用历史与基动作条件下的末端执行器预测差异生成手臂修正；可靠性门控根据演示相对基动作的改进学习何时接受修正，并在推理时利用预测不确定性及物体-末端执行器接近度调节应用。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: Aegis-VLA通过轨迹世界模型预测物体运动并学习可靠性门控，提出对基础动作的修正以改进动态物体操作。

papers.abstract: Autoregressive generation over adaptive 3D octrees (Uni-3DAR) offers an intrinsic $O(N \log N)$ sparsity advantage over dense $O(N^2)$ equivariant diffusion and flow models on large drug-like molecules, yet lags in geometric equilibrium, closed-shell valence stability, and property fidelity due to Morton-seam coordinate jumps, leaf-heavy compute with root-count trapping, and target-shortcut collapse in internal critics. We introduce MolGPAO (Molecular Generative Pre-trained Autoregressive Octree), a standalone 3D octree architecture and single-output speculative tree-decoding engine using zero external surrogates, zero reinforcement learning, and zero inference-time MLIP relaxation. MolGPAO unifies: (1) non-trapping 6-D ScaleFreeBudgetEmbedding with L5-to-L1 covalent packing priors; (2) a FlashAttention-2 pause-and-gather speculative octree funnel ($m_{s1} \to m_{s2} \to 1$, $M_{\mathrm{out}} = 1$); (3) an anti-shortcut ground-truth TwoStageOctreeProcessCritic with 64-RBF covalent edge gating and $SO(3)$-invariant 12-channel multipole norms (blind QM9 $r = 0.9867$--$0.9989$); (4) a $<0.5$ ms 4-layer $SE(3)$ PostTreeGraphRefiner for Morton-seam healing, expected-XYZ bonded supervision, selective CFG, and zero-heavy-displacement valence reconciliation; and (5) bubble-free stride-2 GPU leaf decoding. Across GEOM-Drugs (0.49 GPU-h), disjoint 50k/50k QM9 (0.43 GPU-h), and PBE0/def2-TZVP-verified OE62 (0.56 GPU-h), MolGPAO lifts drug-scale valid-connected yield 6.78x (12.7% to 86.2%, 99.83% atom stability), runs 7.3x faster (or 1.65x faster at 2.0x yield) than 100-step FlowMol at $N=100$, beats 156 GPU-h PropMolFlow on QM9 HOMO (-12.7%) and dipole (-21.0%) at 362x lower compute, and doubles live DFT hit rate on OE62 (33.3% vs. 16.7%) at 92.8x lower compute.

analysis.key_results: 在 GEOM-Drugs、QM9 和 OE62 数据集上，MolGPAO 将药物尺度有效连接产率从 12.7% 提升至 86.2%（原子稳定性 99.83%），比 FlowMol 快 7.3 倍，并在 QM9 的 HOMO 和偶极矩误差上分别降低 12.7% 和 21.0%，计算成本降低 362 倍；在 OE62 上将实时 DFT 命中率从 16.7% 翻倍至 33.3%，计算成本降低 92.8 倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 MolGPAO，一种独立的三维八叉树架构和单输出投机树解码引擎，不依赖外部代理、强化学习或推理时的 MLIP 松弛，大幅提升药物尺度分子的生成效率和稳定性。

papers.abstract: Low-bit storage of optimizer states can substantially reduce the memory footprint of large-scale training. In practice, however, these states are not quantized once: at every training step, they are dequantized, updated, requantized, and written back. This iterative quantization pipeline can destabilize training. We identify a failure mode behind this instability: for states updated via exponential moving averages (EMAs), quantization errors are recursively fed into subsequent updates. As a result, biased errors accumulate over time while high-variance errors are amplified, particularly when the EMA decay factor is close to 1. To address this error accumulation, we propose BReD (Block Replay Dithering), a method that reduces rounding bias and controls rounding variance during quantization. BReD adapts classical subtractive dithering to optimizer-state quantization by combining deterministic seed replay with block-wise shared dither values, avoiding auxiliary random-tensor storage and per-element dither values generation. Across the default pretraining settings (five optimizers at 120M; AdamW and Muon at 1.1B and 3.4B model) and supervised fine-tuning (AdamW and Muon at 7B model), 4-bit BReD closely matches training with full-precision optimizer states, with PPL shifts $\leq0.5$ in pretraining and $\leq0.2$ in fine-tuning and average downstream performance changes within 0.7 points. Moreover, 3-bit BReD preserves stable convergence in the evaluated settings, offering a more aggressive alternative. Our implementation of BReD is available at: https://github.com/ZhanHeshen/BReD

analysis.key_results: 在120M模型上五种优化器、1.1B和3.4B模型上AdamW和Muon的预训练，以及7B模型上AdamW和Muon的监督微调中，4比特BReD与全精度优化器状态训练接近，预训练PPL偏移≤0.5，微调≤0.2，下游性能变化平均在0.7分内；3比特BReD在所评估设置下保持收敛稳定。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出BReD（Block Replay Dithering）方法，通过确定性种子重放和块级共享抖动值，减少量化偏差并控制方差，实现低比特EMA优化器状态的稳定训练。
analysis.method: BReD将经典减色抖动适配到优化器状态量化中，结合确定性种子重放和块级共享抖动值，避免辅助随机张量存储和逐元素抖动生成。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出BReD方法，通过块重放抖动减少EMA优化器状态量化中的误差累积，实现低比特下稳定的训练。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于优化器状态量化，未涉及VLA、WAM或机器人领域。但该技术可降低大规模模型训练的内存占用，对资源受限的机器人模型训练具有潜在价值。

papers.abstract: Conventional embodied UAV tracking couples target observability with heading control because targets may leave the field of view of forward-facing cameras. We investigate a complementary paradigm that uses full-spherical perception to follow designated targets without active heading adjustment. To support this setting, we introduce 360UAV-ETrack, a simulation benchmark comprising 2,652 sequences, over 1.73 million synchronized observations, eight tracking tasks, and 150 held-out closed-loop scenarios. We propose 360UAV-TVLA, a panoramic vision--language--action (VLA) framework integrating persistent visual referring (PVR), compressed temporal memory (CTM), and geometry-aligned trajectory supervision (GTS) for instance identification, motion reasoning, and three-dimensional control. Experiments across two VLA backbones show consistent gains over standard fine-tuning, with normalized average tracking frames increasing from 22.56\% to 35.28\% for $\pi_0$ and from 25.68\% to 33.64\% for $\pi_{0.5}$. Our benchmark further reveals a substantial gap between offline imitation accuracy and closed-loop tracking reliability, establishing a challenging testbed for future research https://libingyu01.github.io/360UAV-ETrack_360UAV-TVLA/

analysis.key_results: 在两个VLA骨干上一致优于标准微调：π₀的归一化平均跟踪帧数从22.56%提升至35.28%，π₀.₅从25.68%提升至33.64%；基准揭示离线模仿精度与闭环跟踪可靠性之间存在显著差距。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入360UAV-ETrack仿真基准（2,652个序列、超173万同步观测、八类跟踪任务、150个闭环场景），并提出360UAV-TVLA全景视觉-语言-动作框架，集成持久视觉指代（PVR）、压缩时序记忆（CTM）和几何对齐轨迹监督（GTS），用于目标识别、运动推理和三维控制。
analysis.method: 采用全向球面感知支持无主动转向的跟踪；提出360UAV-TVLA框架，包含PVR、CTM和GTS三个模块；在两个VLA骨干网络（π₀和π₀.₅）上进行标准微调验证。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种利用全向球面感知的无需主动转向的具身无人机跟踪范式，并推出360UAV-ETrack仿真基准和360UAV-TVLA全景视觉-语言-动作框架。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接聚焦具身无人机中的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）框架，提出全景VLA方法并构建相应基准，对VLA在真实机器人（无人机）任务中的闭环可靠性具有直接研究价值。

papers.abstract: General-purpose multimodal foundation models enable robots to adapt during deployment from observations and execution feedback, without task-specific demonstrations or training. However, the robot retains what it learns only in the model's working context. Once the task ends, it loses this execution knowledge, such as how to carry a bowl between two grippers. On the next attempt at the task, the robot may take just as long and repeat the same mistakes. To avoid this repetition, robots must retain execution knowledge across attempts. Yet replaying past actions is insufficient, because their effects depend on the current conditions. Procedures that determine actions from the current scene address this, but when they meet conditions that earlier attempts did not cover, revising them requires the measured effects of earlier actions. We therefore propose SEEK, an agentic framework that retains both, enabling robots to improve across attempts while keeping the underlying model fixed. To adapt retained knowledge to the current scene, SEEK adopts a Self-Evolving Programmatic Policy (SEPP) that encodes manipulation as executable procedures and determines each action from current observations. As the robot executes these procedures, SEEK records the measured effects of its actions, including those from failed attempts, in a Persistent Action-Effect Bank (PAEB). Where a retained procedure applies, it acts without a model request; where it meets a condition it does not cover, this evidence guides its revision. On RoboDojo, knowledge retained over ten attempts raises SEEK's average task score from 27.0 to 54.4 and its success rate from 19.7% to 48.0% across all 42 tasks. On 34 of these tasks with GPT-6.2 Astra, SEEK reaches 80.1 after five attempts, against 49.6 for the same model acting directly, and uses 77.6% fewer model requests. https://zeyangguan.github.io/SEEK-Agentic-Robot-Manipulation/

analysis.key_results: 在RoboDojo上，跨10次尝试的知识保留使SEEK的平均任务得分从27.0提升至54.4，成功率从19.7%提升至48.0%（42个任务）；在34个使用GPT-6.2 Astra的任务中，5次尝试后得分达80.1，而直接使用同模型为49.6，模型请求减少77.6%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SEEK智能体框架，通过自我进化程序化策略（SEPP）和持久动作-效应库（PAEB）保留跨尝试的执行知识，使机器人在保持底层模型固定的情况下提升操作性能并减少模型请求。
analysis.method: 采用自我进化程序化策略（SEPP）编码操作程序，确定当前观测下的动作；在执行过程中记录动作的测量效应（包括失败尝试）到持久动作-效应库（PAEB）；当程序适用时直接执行，遇到未覆盖条件时依据PAEB证据修订程序。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: SEEK框架通过保留跨任务尝试的执行知识和程序化策略，实现在固定底层多模态基础模型下机器人操作性能的持续改进。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接面向基于多模态基础模型的机器人操作策略学习，通过程序化策略和动作效应记忆实现跨尝试的自我进化，属于通用机器人策略学习，与VLA和机器人学习高度相关。

At step t t , c t c_{t} denotes the execution context used by the active procedure. In the progress panel, a check marks a goal g t g_{t} that the procedure verifies by itself before advancing, and the model icons mark the only steps where the fixed model is called: when a procedure requests help or execution stalls (red cross). When called, the fixed model retrieves evidence from PAEB to guide execution, by interpreting observations or proposing action candidates, or to revise the main program or operations. papers.abstract: Looped language models can adapt computation for predicting a token without a proportional rescaling in unique model parameters by adjusting the number of loops. This property has been used for self-speculative decoding, taking shallow loops as fast drafters and deep loops as verifiers, which is effective since drafting still uses full parameters. In this paper, we show that shallow loops can be also predictive of several future tokens and leverage this to drastically accelerate the inference of looped language models. To that end, we present Floodgates, a simple self-speculative decoding method that appends a block of mask tokens as a suffix and learns via low-rank adaptation to draft these tokens in parallel. Across seven models, five benchmarks, a range of batch sizes, and both greedy and sampled decoding, Floodgates is the fastest lossless decoding method in most cases, attaining up to 7.5x acceleration. Through analysis, we show that this speedup is enabled by all-depth training of looped models, with the shallow drafter's ability to leverage full-depth computation by conditioning on deep prefix cache evaluated during verification.

analysis.key_results: 在七个模型、五个基准、多种批大小以及贪婪和采样解码下，Floodgates在大多数情况下是最快的无损解码方法，最高达到7.5倍加速。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Floodgates，一种用于循环语言模型的简单自推测解码方法，通过附加掩码令牌块并低秩适配学习并行草稿多个令牌，实现无损加速。
analysis.method: Floodgates自推测解码：将掩码令牌块附加为后缀，通过低秩适配训练以并行草稿多个令牌；浅层循环作为草稿器，深层循环作为验证器；验证时利用深层前缀缓存使浅层草稿器受益于全深度计算。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出Floodgates自推测解码方法，利用循环语言模型的浅层循环预测多个未来令牌，并作为并行草稿器加速解码。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于循环语言模型的自推测解码加速，未直接涉及VLA、WAM或机器人领域；但其高效推理技术可能对资源受限的具身智能模型推理具有潜在借鉴价值。

papers.abstract: Forklifts play a critical role in warehousing and distribution, but existing automation systems remain limited in handling complex tasks that require sequential decision-making. Recently, vision--language--action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising approach for multi-step decision-making by directly generating control actions from visual observations and language prompts. Although VLA-based control has been extensively researched for manipulators, to the best of our knowledge, its application to forklifts remains unexplored. Therefore, this study demonstrates the integration of VLA control for an autonomous forklift unloading task with limited real-world data. Moreover, training VLA models typically requires large-scale datasets. As there is currently no public dataset for forklift operations, we use a VLA model pretrained primarily on robotic manipulator data and construct a training dataset via simulation, which can be scaled up at low cost. We then adapt the pretrained VLA model to forklift control using 9.38 h of simulation data and 0.8 h of real-world demonstrations, with the latter accounting for approximately 8% of the collected forklift data by duration. The integrated system was validated through 72 real-world trials across four model variants. The results show that the proposed system can accomplish an unloading task even with limited real-world data.

analysis.key_results: 在72次真实世界试验中验证了四个模型变体的自主卸载能力，证明在有限真实数据下系统能够完成卸载任务。
analysis.main_contribution: 首次将视觉-语言-动作(VLA)控制应用于叉车卸载任务，并通过仿真数据高效适配预训练VLA模型，证明了在有限真实数据下实现的可行性。
analysis.method: 使用主要在机器人操作数据上预训练的VLA模型，通过仿真生成大规模低成本训练数据，结合少量真实演示(约0.8小时，占数据总量约8%)进行微调适配。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该研究展示了在缺乏公开叉车操作数据集的情况下，利用模拟数据和少量真实演示适配预训练VLA模型，实现自主叉车卸载任务。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接以VLA模型为核心，扩展其应用到叉车这一非机械臂领域，并通过仿真数据增强真实数据有限的适应问题，对VLA模型的泛化与领域迁移研究具有直接价值。

papers.abstract: A world model lets an agent anticipate the consequences of its actions and use imagined futures to make decisions. We introduce Normalizing-Flow World Model (NFWM), which pairs an invertible observation encoder with an action-conditioned probabilistic predictor. Because the encoder is invertible, the predicted distribution over latent states defines a distribution over future observations. Maximizing the exact conditional likelihood of those observations therefore trains the representation and dynamics jointly. An agent can plan directly in the learned latent space and decode sampled trajectories to inspect possible futures. On Teleport, these samples capture the two possible outcomes of the same action. In Flappy Bird, a world model trained by likelihood alone supports reward-based planning that reaches 100 pipes in all ten evaluated games. For goal-conditioned control, an auxiliary inverse-dynamics objective shapes the coordinates used to compare predicted states with a goal. On LIBERO, NFWM uses this distance to select successful action sequences more often than LeWM and SMWM. In Atari Boxing, training on imagined trajectories improves a policy beyond its behavior-cloned initialization. Together, these results establish normalizing flows as capable world models.

analysis.key_results: 在 Teleport 上，采样能捕捉同一动作的两种可能结果；在 Flappy Bird 中，仅由似然训练的世界模型支持基于奖励的规划，在全部十局评估中达到 100 根管道；在 LIBERO 上，学习到的距离比 LeWM 和 SMWM 更频繁地选择成功动作序列；在 Atari Boxing 中，基于想象轨迹的训练超越了行为克隆初始化的策略。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 Normalizing-Flow World Model (NFWM)，将可逆观测编码器与动作条件概率预测器配对，通过最大化精确条件似然联合训练表征和动力学，并直接在学到的潜在空间中进行规划。
analysis.method: 使用归一化流作为可逆观测编码器，结合动作条件概率预测器，最大化未来观测的精确条件似然；规划在潜在空间中进行，并可解码采样轨迹以检查未来；对于目标条件控制，使用辅助逆动力学目标塑造坐标。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 引入归一化流世界模型（NFWM），通过可逆观测编码器和动作条件概率预测器联合训练表征与动力学，并支持潜在空间规划与未来轨迹解码。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) have widely adopted diffusion-based action generation for continuous robot motions, enabling fine-grained control across diverse tasks. However, recent studies have shown that their performance is highly sensitive to initial noise, with resulting action errors that make recovery difficult during execution. Existing approaches search for favorable noise initializations to improve performance, yet the action expert itself remains sensitive to noise. In this work, we reveal that initial noise induces a consistent directional bias in action space that closely aligns with the noise's temporal mean. We thus introduce a simple yet effective framework that improves robustness to initial noise through interventions during both training and inference. During training, we enforce consistent action predictions from antithetic noise pairs $(\epsilon, -\epsilon)$ and, at inference, remove the noise's temporal mean. Our method substantially reduces action deviation and improves task performance across simulation benchmarks. In real-robot experiments, our method increases the average task success rate of $\pi_{0.5}$ from 40% to 68%, with more stable and consistent execution.

analysis.key_results: 在仿真基准上显著减少动作偏差并提升任务性能；在真实机器人实验中，π0.5的平均任务成功率从40%提高到68%，执行更稳定一致。
analysis.main_contribution: 揭示VLA中初始噪声引起动作方向性偏差的机制，并提出一种通过训练时对比噪声对一致性和推理时去除噪声时间均值来增强鲁棒性的简单有效框架。
analysis.method: 训练时强制来自对立噪声对（ε，-ε）的动作预测一致性；推理时去除噪声的时间均值。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文揭示初始噪声在VLA动作空间中引起与噪声时间均值一致的方向性偏差，并提出训练与推理干预以提升对初始噪声的鲁棒性。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models generate robot actions from visual observations and language instructions in real-world environments, making malicious model tampering a potential threat to physical safety. We study whether object-triggered backdoors can be implanted through a small, fixed set of parameter bit flips without retraining. The central challenge is to make persistent weight modifications disrupt trigger-present behavior while preserving performance on non-trigger inputs. We propose FlipVLA, a two-stage selector-amplifier method that exploits existing visual features within an FC-GELU-FC structure. The selector constructs a trigger-dependent response in a selected channel, using GELU to attenuate background activity. The amplifier modifies a connected downstream weight to convert this response into an action-relevant perturbation. Channel screening and discrete bit search construct both components under a limited modification budget. Experiments on OpenVLA-OFT and GR00T N1.7 across four LIBERO suites achieve attack success rates of 90.22% to 100%, with task success decreasing by at most 1.5 percentage points on clean scenes.

analysis.key_results: 在OpenVLA-OFT和GR00T N1.7上，跨四个LIBERO套件实现90.22%至100%的攻击成功率，干净场景任务成功率下降最多1.5个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出FlipVLA，一种两阶段选择器-放大器方法，在不重训练的情况下通过少量参数比特翻转植入后门。
analysis.method: 利用FC-GELU-FC结构中的现有视觉特征：选择器在选定通道中构造触发依赖响应，放大器修改下游权重将其转化为动作相关扰动，并通过通道筛选和离散比特搜索在有限修改预算下构建两个组件。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文研究如何在不重训练的情况下，通过少量参数比特翻转向视觉-语言-动作模型植入对象触发的后门。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接以视觉-语言-动作模型为核心研究对象，探索通过比特翻转对VLA模型进行后门攻击的安全威胁，与本站关注VLA安全与鲁棒性的主题高度相关，但不涉及世界模型或高效推理。

papers.abstract: Action-conditioned video world models generate future observations from an initial frame and a camera trajectory, but often fail to align camera commands with visual dynamics or represent full 6-DoF scene transformations. We present DuoWM, a first-person drone video world model with two complementary visual conditions. Action flow projects future camera positions and orientations into each target frame, while Object flow forward-warps the initial observation and overlays local 6-DoF transformations to ground the induced scene motion. We further introduce transform-aware pretraining, which pairs object appearance with explicit transformation axes before standard RGB video training. On Sekai-drone dataset, DuoWM achieves the best results across video quality, 3D consistency, and trajectory following. Compared with Captain Safari, the state-of-the-art method, our approach reduces real-domain FVD and LPIPS by 17.2\% and 21.6\%, respectively, while improving game-domain AUC@30 from 0.5003 to 0.5719 and AUC@15 from 0.3088 to 0.3747.

analysis.key_results: 在 Sekai-drone 数据集上取得最佳视频质量、3D一致性和轨迹跟随结果；与 SOTA 方法 Captain Safari 相比，真实域 FVD 降低 17.2%，LPIPS 降低 21.6%，游戏域 AUC@30 从 0.5003 提升至 0.5719，AUC@15 从 0.3088 提升至 0.3747。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 DuoWM，引入双重视觉条件（动作流和对象流）与变换感知预训练，提升视频生成质量、3D一致性和轨迹跟随性能。
analysis.method: 动作流将未来相机位姿投影到目标帧，对象流前向扭曲初始观测并叠加局部 6-DoF 变换，并采用变换感知预训练。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: DuoWM 是一种第一人称无人机视频世界模型，通过动作流和对象流两种互补视觉条件来对齐相机指令并实现全 6-DoF 场景变换建模。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文属于机器人世界模型（WAM）研究方向，针对无人机动作条件视频生成，通过显式建模 6-DoF 动作与视觉动态的关系，对具身智能中的世界建模和机器人学习具有直接参考价值。与 VLA 的关系在于世界模型可作为策略学习的基础，但本文未涉及语言或指令跟随。

papers.abstract: Human takeovers offer corrective supervision for vision-language-action (VLA) policies, but their contribution to offline post-training must be separated from that of continued optimization. We introduce FailPoint-X, a benchmark for offline VLA post-training with human takeovers. To represent uncertainty in failure onset, an annotator marks an interval for each failure, and training takeovers start at seeded frames sampled within it. From one fixed $\pi_{0.5}$ checkpoint, which also initializes post-training, we assemble 629 natural failures across 10 LIBERO-X task families at up to five difficulty levels. All 2,823 takeover attempts are logged; 2,400 are accepted recoveries, of which 2,320 are used for post-training. Evaluation restarts every method from the fixed midpoints of 384 held-out failure intervals. Under matched actor-update counts, we compare behavior cloning of recoveries, value-based offline learning on recoveries and failed rollouts, and continued training on existing demonstrations. Within 1,200 steps on the 240 L1-L3 held-out failures, cloning improves recovery by 29.4 percentage points (pp) over the demonstration-only control; the value-based learner does not establish a further gain (1.5 pp). In exploratory evaluation from L1-L5 nominal starts at the same horizon, cloning loses 30.0 pp of success relative to the base policy; mixing in demonstrations reduces the loss to 16.5 pp, a reduction that shrinks under a stricter, pre-specified horizon. Restorable failure states and a shared evaluator let all methods be compared from identical starts.

analysis.key_results: 在240个L1-L3保留失败上，行为克隆恢复率比仅演示的对照组高29.4个百分点；基于价值的学习未显示出进一步增益（1.5个百分点）；探索性评估中，行为克隆相对基础策略成功率下降30.0个百分点，混入演示后损失降至16.5个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出FailPoint-X基准，通过人工标注失败区间并在其中采样接管起始帧，从固定策略检查点收集629个真实失败和2823次接管尝试，用于评估离线VLA后训练方法。
analysis.method: 在固定的π0.5检查点上收集失败和人类接管数据，比较行为克隆恢复、基于价值的离线学习（使用恢复和失败轨迹）以及继续在已有演示上训练三种方法，评估时从保留失败区间的固定中点重启。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 该论文提出了一个用于评估基于人类接管的离线VLA策略后训练方法的基准，并系统比较了行为克隆、基于价值的学习和继续演示训练三种方法。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接相关：该工作针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的离线后训练，研究如何利用人类接管数据进行策略改进，属于机器人操作和策略学习范畴，对VLA领域有重要参考价值。

papers.abstract: Groupwise quantization is used in LLM quantization to improve accuracy at low bit widths, but grouping weights keeps standard integer MMA from spanning the full dot product for efficient GPU inference. We develop a new quantization method, Shifter Quantization (SQ), that reconstructs native-width integer operands by appending and shifting shared bits. To further extend the efficiency, we develop a special variant of SQ, Shifter Integer (SHI), to use INT4 kernels. We show that SQ and SHI formats perform better than standard groupwise quantization in quality, as measured by projection error and KL divergence, and in inference speed, as measured during decoding and prefill. For low precision like 2-bit quantization, SQ2 and SHI2 achieve 2.71-3.77x the 4,096-token prefill throughput of llama.cpp on a Q2_K checkpoint and reduce WikiText-2 KL by 6.6-7.8%. For mid precision like 4-bit quantization, SQ4 achieves 1.43-2.47x the prefill throughput of NInfer's groupwise-integer baselines across the tested models and prompt lengths, with 24-40% lower KL than the NInfer baselines. For high precision like 8-bit quantization, SQ8 achieves 27.4% higher batch-one prefill throughput and 72.7% lower KL than vLLM's online FP8.

analysis.key_results: 2比特SQ2和SHI2实现llama.cpp Q2_K检查点2.71-3.77倍的4096 token预填充吞吐量提升，WikiText-2 KL降低6.6-7.8%；4比特SQ4实现预填充吞吐量1.43-2.47倍提升，KL降低24-40%；8比特SQ8实现27.4%更高批量一预填充吞吐量和72.7%更低KL。
analysis.main_contribution: 开发了一种新的量化方法Shifter Quantization (SQ)，通过附加和移位共享比特重构原生宽度整数操作数，并进一步开发了使用INT4内核的变体Shifter Integer (SHI)。
analysis.method: 通过附加和移位共享比特重构原生宽度整数操作数，使用INT4内核的SHI变体。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出移位量化(SQ)及其INT4内核变体SHI，在LLM低比特量化中重建原生宽度整数操作数以提升GPU推理效率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于LLM量化方法，不涉及VLA或WAM，但与量化相关的效率改进可能对VLA模型部署具有潜在参考价值。

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) generation using a lightweight draft. Existing methods evaluate complete recipes under different training configurations, leaving component effects, interactions, and composition benefits unclear. Therefore, we present LEGOSpec, a composable framework for speculative draft design and training. LEGOSpec decomposes draft models into Context, Backbone, Proposal, and Objective components that share a unified training infrastructure. Using LEGOSpec, we systematically vary components and evaluate selected combinations under matched training conditions to isolate their effects and interactions. These experiments reveal three findings: (1) Different workloads favor different backbones, depending on context length and memory budget, with within-block dependency modeling particularly important for long contexts. (2) Proposal design must balance acceptance and latency. (3) The training objective should match token distributions locally and optimize acceptance length across the block. These findings guide workload-aware configurations and DFlux, a balanced general-purpose draft combining a convolution-equipped SWA--GQA hybrid backbone, Residual Corrector, and hierarchical supervision. Across Qwen and Gemma models, DFlux improves acceptance length over the strongest baseline by up to 13.7% on regular benchmarks and 34.7% on long-context workloads. To support efficient training, LEGOSpec integrates metadata-aware scheduling and asynchronous execution, increasing training throughput by up to 79% and accelerating offline supervision preparation by up to $3.11\times$ over SpecForge.

analysis.key_results: 在Qwen和Gemma模型上，DFlux相比最强基线在常规基准上接受长度提升最高13.7%，长上下文任务上提升34.7%；训练吞吐量提升最高79%，离线监督准备加速最高3.11倍（对比SpecForge）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出LEGOSpec框架，将推测解码草稿模型分解为Context、Backbone、Proposal和Objective组件，并据此系统分析各组件的影响以指导草稿设计；同时提出DFlux草稿模型和高效训练基础设施（元数据感知调度与异步执行）。
analysis.method: 将草稿模型分解为四个可组合组件，在统一训练基础设施下系统变体各个组件，在匹配训练条件下评估组合以隔离效果与交互；基于发现设计卷积增强的SWA-GQA混合骨干、残差校正器和分层监督的DFlux；训练端集成元数据感知调度和异步执行。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出可组合的推测解码框架LEGOSpec，系统解耦草稿模型组件并通过实验分析组件效果与交互，进而设计出平衡通用草稿模型DFlux。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于推测解码这一高效推理技术本身，未直接涉及VLA或WAM；但推测解码可直接用于加速任何自回归生成模型，包括机器人策略或世界模型，因此对VLA/WAM的高效推理具有潜在方法论价值。

papers.abstract: A generative verifier can flag an unsupported claim before it finishes describing the error. For applications that only screen an assistant's report, the remaining generation may be unnecessary. We examine this possibility in a frozen 2B span verifier whose output chooses between an empty error list and its first object before producing any locations. Native8 stops at that choice. Prefill1 supplies the seven fixed syntax tokens that precede it and generates just the unrestricted branch token, keeping the native instruction. On 2,015 code-agent TEST responses, Prefill1 uses 84.84% less eager resident service than full generation, with released-reference F1 of 83.43 versus 83.41. It also saves 31.98% over Native8 despite identical logical token totals. This additional saving remains 6.74-26.73% under default compiled execution on the complete workload, with small changes in decisions. Evidence interventions test whether the alarm responds to the supplied facts; first-location decoding measures the additional work and localization losses when a caller also needs an error pointer.

analysis.key_results: 在 2,015 个代码智能体 TEST 响应上，Prefill1 相比全生成减少 84.84% 的急切驻留服务量，F1 为 83.43 对比 83.41；相比 Native8 节省 31.98%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 Prefill1 方法，在冻结的 2B 跨度验证器中仅生成首个决策分支令牌，避免后续错误位置生成，大幅降低推理开销。
analysis.method: 采用原生冻结验证器，比较 Prefill1 与 Native8 停止策略，通过仅生成决策令牌实现提前停止。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 通过停止于首个决策令牌，减少生成式验证器中不必要的后续生成，显著节省推理服务成本。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该项工作聚焦于生成式验证的推理效率优化，属于独立的 speculative decoding/提前停止方法，与 VLA、WAM 或机器人模型无直接关系。

papers.title: Reading Decisions Before Spans: Efficient Generative Verification
papers.title_zh: 先读决策后读跨度：高效生成式验证

papers.abstract: Latent world models enable goal-directed planning from offline visual data, but prediction alone does not specify which action-related distinctions their representations should preserve. Inverse dynamics provides auxiliary supervision, yet squared-error action regression rewards additional information only through changes in the conditional action mean. We propose Contrastive Identification of Actions (CIA), which identifies the executed action among alternatives sampled from a history-conditioned behavior proposal. Comparing actions plausible in the same context targets information supplied by the next latent beyond history. Under exact behavior matching, we show that CIA can reward action information that leaves optimal inverse-regression error unchanged, and verify this distinction through a controlled learning example. CIA achieves higher planner-averaged mean success than the base world model and a regression inverse-dynamics baseline across five visual control benchmarks, without modifying the planner.

analysis.key_results: 在五个视觉控制基准上，CIA比基础世界模型和回归逆动力学基线取得更高的规划器平均成功率，且无需修改规划器。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Contrastive Identification of Actions (CIA)，通过区分同一上下文中可能执行的动作，为世界模型学习提供超越均方误差逆动力学回归的动作相关信息监督。
analysis.method: 使用对比学习，从历史条件行为建议分布中采样替代动作，以识别实际执行的动作，并将该信号作为世界模型表示学习的辅助监督。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出对比动作识别方法CIA，利用历史条件行为建议采样替代动作，从离线视觉数据中学习更能保留动作相关信息的世界模型。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作聚焦世界模型学习，属于动作条件世界建模，与WAM主题相关，但不涉及VLA或高效推理。

papers.title: Learning World Models through Contrastive Identification of Actions
papers.title_zh: 通过动作对比识别学习世界模型

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have achieved strong results in arm-centric manipulation, yet humanoid whole-body control (WBC) requires dynamic balance and tightly coupled full-body coordination. Existing hierarchical humanoid VLAs typically decouple motion generation from physical execution, leaving tracking and balance errors unable to directly optimize the VLA generator. We propose DiffGR00T, an end-to-end differentiable training framework that couples GR00T N1.7 with SONIC, a pretrained whole-body behavior foundation model. To enable execution-aware differentiable training, we replace the non-differentiable simulator with a learned, action-conditioned world model, allowing multi-step body-execution losses to backpropagate through the frozen whole-body controller and the flow-matching sampler directly into the VLA action head. On four HumanoidArena simulation tasks, DiffGR00T improves average task success by 12.5 percentage points over the supervised base VLA (59.2% to 71.7%), demonstrating that execution-aware gradients effectively align high-level motion generation with closed-loop whole-body dynamics.

analysis.key_results: 在四个HumanoidArena仿真任务上，DiffGR00T将平均任务成功率从59.2%提升至71.7%，相对提升12.5个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出DiffGR00T，一个端到端可微训练框架，将GR00T N1.7与预训练的全身行为基础模型SONIC耦合，利用动作条件世界模型实现执行感知的可微训练，使多步身体执行损失能反向传播至VLA动作头。
analysis.method: 使用学习到的动作条件世界模型替代不可微仿真器，通过冻结的全身控制器和流匹配采样器，将执行损失梯度直接回传到VLA动作头，实现端到端的可微训练。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: DiffGR00T通过将不可微仿真器替换为可学习的动作条件世界模型，实现了从全身执行损失到VLA动作头的端到端可微训练，显著提升了人形机器人全身控制任务的成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接针对VLA（视觉-语言-动作）模型在人形机器人全身控制中的应用，并引入世界模型（World Model）实现可微训练，属于本站核心主题VLA和WAM的交叉领域。

figures.caption: DiffGR00T teaser. The VLA action head is updated while SONIC and the world model are frozen; the world model replaces the simulator during training. Simulation-only average task success rises from 59.2% to 71.7%.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: DiffGR00T architecture. The GR00T N1.7 VLA action head is trained; the VLA backbone, the SONIC decoder, the action-conditioned world model, and the training-only critic are frozen. The execution loss is backpropagated through the world model, the SONIC decoder, and the four-step flow-matching sampler. The critic supplies a fixed tail value and is not part of the deployed controller. The world model is trained once from multi-source replay and replaces the simulator only during training; it is not used at inference.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.abstract: World action models (WAMs) adapt pretrained video generators for robot control by jointly predicting future camera frames and actions, transferring physical priors learned from video into manipulation policies. However, generating future frames before every action makes test-time inference too slow for closed-loop control, while most existing policies remain restricted to short observation histories. Building on Fast-WAM, which showed that video prediction shapes policy representations during training so that future frame synthesis can be skipped at deployment, we present G0.7, a generalist world action model scaled along two axes: extending the context window from a single observation to up to five minutes of history, and scaling pretraining to a large-scale corpus of robot teleoperation and human egocentric (ego) video. Across public simulation suites and real-robot deployments, direct action decoding (Fast mode) matches imagine-then-act (IDM) inference from the same checkpoint while running in 60 ms per 16-step action chunk on a single RTX 5090 (7.6x faster than IDM) and supporting pause-free real-time chunking. Performance scales consistently with pretraining data, with human ego video driving the largest gains in out-of-distribution generalization: G0.7 achieves a 70.8 mean score across five simulation benchmark suites, 48% and 54% zero-shot pick-and-place success on Galaxea R1 Pro and R1 Lite, 96.7% in-distribution and 93.3% out-of-distribution success on video-conditioned in-context learning tasks, and 86.9% mean task progress across seven real-world post-training tasks including multi-minute box folding, drink preparation, and product bagging. Project page: https://www.galaxea-ai.com/model-g07.html

analysis.key_results: 在五个仿真基准套件上平均得分70.8；Galaxea R1 Pro和R1 Lite上的零样本抓取成功率分别为48%和54%；视频条件上下文学习任务分布内成功率96.7%、分布外93.3%；七个真实世界训练后任务平均任务进度86.9%；Fast模式在单个RTX 5090上每16步动作块耗时60ms，比IDM快7.6倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 推出G0.7 WAM，将上下文窗口从单次观测扩展到最长5分钟历史，并在大规模遥操作与人类自我中心视频语料上预训练，实现了快速直接动作解码。
analysis.method: 扩展上下文窗口；在大规模机器人遥操作与人类自我中心视频语料上预训练；采用直接动作解码（Fast模式）或想象后行动（IDM）两种推理范式。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: G0.7是一种通用世界动作模型（WAM），通过扩展上下文窗口和预训练语料规模，实现了快速直接动作解码，并展现出强大的仿真与真实机器人操控性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作是WAM主题的核心研究，直接面向机器人操控的世界动作建模，并解决了WAM在真实闭环控制中的推理速度瓶颈，对VLA/WAM方向的效率和部署有直接参考价值。

figures.caption: G0.7 architecture and control loop. The context caches up to five minutes of real camera observations, combining the robot’s own history with an optional demonstration video. Conditioned at every layer by the language expert, the vision/action expert attends over this context to decode the next 16-step action chunk directly in 60 ms (Fast mode), or optionally imagines future frames first (IDM mode). After each chunk executes, the newest frame joins the context and the oldest slides out of the window.
figures.label: Figure 1

papers.abstract: In text to image AI models, fixing the prompt and the random seed is widely assumed to fix the image. We show that it does not on GPUs. We evaluate six text-to-image models (diffusion and autoregressive) under four numerical precisions and quantizations on three GPU types (RTX A6000, RTX 6000 Ada, and H100 NVL), across up to 100 prompts per set for all six models. For each configuration we compare, with the prompt and seed fixed, the image generated alone with the image generated inside a batch, and we also compare across GPUs. Every replay control reported here is bit-exact, so the variation is not random noise: the execution setting, mainly the batch composition and the GPU, decides the output. The effect is large and model dependent. Structural similarity between the single-image and the batched output falls to 0.580 for an autoregressive model in bf16 and to 0.551 with int8. For a second autoregressive model in bf16 it falls to 0.261 with sampled decoding and to 0.229 with greedy decoding, and for an fp8 diffusion model to 0.68. A diffusion model in bf16 stays close to the batch-1 output (0.96-0.98) but changes every image. In most cases the batched image is a different but equally valid image; in some, such as prompts with digits and counters, it is visibly worse. Cross-GPU differences are of the same order as the batch effect: for one autoregressive model in bf16 compared across two GPU architectures (RTX 6000 Ada versus RTX A6000), no image is bit-identical and the cross-GPU LPIPS (0.355 to 0.383) matches the batch effect within one GPU (0.347 to 0.381). The consequences are direct: seeds do not make results reproducible, benchmarks and image-quality comparisons that mix batch sizes or hardware can be biased, and safety audits and A/B tests on generated images need the serving setup reported.

analysis.key_results: 批处理效应显著且依赖模型：自回归模型在bf16下结构相似性降至0.580，int8下为0.551；另一自回归模型bf16下采样解码跌至0.261，贪婪解码0.229；fp8扩散模型为0.68。跨GPU差异与批处理效应同量级，一个自回归模型跨GPU无一位完全相同，LPIPS范围0.355-0.383。
analysis.main_contribution: 揭示并量化了文生图模型在GPU上运行时，由于批处理组成和硬件差异导致的输出非确定性，并指出种子不能保证结果可复现。
analysis.method: 对六种文生图模型在三种GPU上、四种数值精度下进行系统性评估，比较单张生成与批处理生成、跨GPU生成的结果差异，并使用位精确回放控制以排除随机噪声。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文研究了文生图模型中批处理组成和GPU架构导致的非确定性，即使固定提示和随机种子也无法保证输出一致。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于文生图模型的量化与非确定性推理，未涉及VLA、WAM或机器人。但其结果对任何部署在GPU上的量化模型（包括机器人策略模型）的可复现性和评估公平性具有重要警示意义。

papers.title: Reproducible by Seed? Not on GPUs: Batch-Dependent Non-Determinism in Text-to-Image Models

papers.abstract: World action models guide robots by predicting the effects of actions or generating commands from observations. A model may compare hundreds of candidate futures before acting, repeatedly reading weights that must fit in device memory. Post-training quantization reduces the number of bits used to store pretrained weights, but a smaller model is not necessarily a deployable one: temporary tensors can exceed graphics processing unit (GPU) memory limits, while even small prediction errors can change the selected action. This creates two coupled challenges: identifying bit assignments that preserve task performance and determining which of them meet real execution constraints, without exhausting costly task trials. We present PTQ4WAM, a framework for choosing layer-wise bit assignments and execution routes under memory, latency and task-evaluation budgets. Calibration measurements guide candidate proposals, optionally with a language model agent. We profile full-model routes on the GPU before spending task trials on feasible assignments. Fusing group rescaling and reading visual history in place can make an otherwise infeasible assignment deployable. Across 15 workloads from four model families, the median task score is 99.2% of the corresponding 32-bit floating-point (FP32) score. On fixed GPU replays, the median speedup over FP32 is 2.36 times and the median reduction in peak allocated memory is 71.5%. The code will be released soon.

analysis.key_results: 在15个来自4个模型族的工作负载上，中位任务得分达到对应FP32得分的99.2%；固定GPU回放中，中位加速2.36倍，中位峰值分配内存减少71.5%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出PTQ4WAM框架，用于在内存、延迟和任务评估预算下选择世界动作模型的逐层位宽和执行路径，并通过融合组重缩放与就地读取视觉历史使不可行的量化配置变得可部署。
analysis.method: 校准测量指导候选量化配置，可选地结合语言模型智能体；在GPU上剖析全模型执行路径，再在可行配置上运行任务试验；采用组重缩放融合和视觉历史就地读取等执行优化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出PTQ4WAM框架，通过联合选择逐层位宽和GPU执行路径，在内存、延迟和任务评估预算约束下实现世界动作模型的高效部署。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对世界动作模型（WAM）的量化部署，旨在保持任务性能的同时满足实际执行约束，属于WAM与模型量化交叉的核心工作。

papers.title: Quantization for Action, Execution for Deployment: Joint Precision and Execution Selection for World Action Models

papers.abstract: Graphical user interface (GUI) agents enable automated interactions with mobile, web, and desktop interfaces. However, their large memory footprint and repeated model calls hinder deployment on resource-constrained devices, motivating post-training quantization (PTQ) without full retraining. Quantization can degrade GUI response accuracy and distort the instruction-vision affinities and local spatial relations needed for GUI target selection. Small coordinate errors can cause missed clicks, while early action errors can alter subsequent interface states and disrupt task execution. Local reconstruction error alone does not directly assess whether these responses and relations are preserved. We propose GUI-Q, a PTQ framework that targets response and relation preservation with 4-bit weights and 16-bit activations (W4A16). Task-Sensitive Granularity Allocation (TSGA) allocates finer groups under a scale-byte budget by combining response sensitivity with the measured reduction in activation-weighted distortion. Relation-Preserving Symmetry Selection (RPSS) then selects symmetric or asymmetric grids to preserve instruction-vision affinities and local spatial relations in GUIs. Across three GUI-capable models, GUI-Q improves mean grounding TargetHit by 8.04 to 12.55 points over the strongest evaluated 4-bit configurations, while reducing static peak graphics processing unit (GPU) memory by 49.9% to 56.2% relative to bfloat16 (BF16). Fixed-output replay with packed 4-bit execution provides 1.7 to 2.8 times model-call speedups. The code will be released.

analysis.key_results: 在三个GUI模型上，GUI-Q相比最强4位配置将平均接地TargetHit提升8.04–12.55点，相比BF16将静态峰值GPU内存降低49.9%–56.2%，固定输出重放配合4位打包执行实现1.7–2.8倍模型调用加速。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出GUI-Q框架，在W4A16设置下同时保持GUI响应精度（指令-视觉亲和力和空间关系）并节省内存、加速推理。
analysis.method: 任务敏感粒度分配（TSGA）根据响应敏感性和激活加权失真分配更细粒度分组；关系保持对称性选择（RPSS）选择对称或非对称网格以保持GUI中的指令-视觉亲和力和局部空间关系。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: GUI-Q是一种针对GUI智能体的后训练量化框架，通过任务敏感粒度分配和关系保持对称性选择，在4位权重量化下减少内存占用并提升模型调用速度，同时保持目标选择精度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于GUI智能体的模型量化，不涉及VLA或WAM。其量化方法旨在保持视觉指令空间关系，对机器人VLA模型中的视觉-动作空间关系保持可能有一定参考价值，但无直接关系。

papers.abstract: In-context learning (ICL) enables foundation models to perform unseen tasks from context without parameter updates. In robotic manipulation, a human video provides the context that specifies how a task should be performed. However, scaling human-video ICL on world-action models (WAMs) faces two challenges: task-level human-robot pairs are not temporally aligned with robot actions, and standard action losses allow policies to rely on initial-scene or task-identity shortcuts rather than tracking the context. We present Entangle, an in-context world-action model that maps a single human video and current robot observations to future visual states and executable actions. To scale temporally aligned training data, we convert recorded robot videos into matched human contexts via video-to-video generation, supplemented by real paired recordings. For model training, we combine variable-length video windows with an intra-task contrastive objective that distinguishes the paired action trajectory from other executions of the same task, preventing task-identity shortcuts. Without task-specific fine-tuning, Entangle improves steadily as aligned training data scales, reaching an average score of 83.5/100 across six unseen tasks on an Astribot S1 robot, and achieves a 69.5% average success rate on seven unseen RoboTwin tasks, outperforming Zero-WAM by 22.6 percentage points. Under Context-OOD, although trained only on scene-aligned pairs, Entangle transfers context-specified behaviors across rearranged layouts and substituted tools. Project page at https://entangle-robotics.github.io/

analysis.key_results: 无需任务特定微调，Entangle 在 Astribot S1 机器人的六项未见任务上平均得分 83.5/100，在 RoboTwin 七项未见任务上平均成功率 69.5%，比 Zero-WAM 高出 22.6 个百分点；在 Context-OOD 下可跨重排布局和替换工具迁移上下文指定行为。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 Entangle，一个将单个人类视频与当前机器人观测映射到未来视觉状态和可执行动作的上下文世界-动作模型，并通过视频到视频生成扩展时序对齐的训练数据及任务内对比学习避免任务身份捷径。
analysis.method: 利用视频到视频生成将记录的机器人视频转换为匹配的人类上下文，补充实时成对数据；训练时结合可变长度视频窗口与任务内对比目标，区分配对动作轨迹与同一任务的其他执行。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: Entangle 提出一种上下文世界-动作模型，利用人类视频上下文和机器人观测预测未来视觉状态与可执行动作，并在任务泛化与上下文分布外场景中展现优势。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接属于世界-动作模型（WAM）研究，聚焦机器人操作中利用人类视频上下文进行动作预测，与本站主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: When a robot is damaged, it must decide which routes it can still afford, and the amount of risk it may accept can change from one mission to the next. We argue that whether a learned model helps such a robot depends on its decision interface, that is, on what the model hands to the planner. A decision policy tells the planner what to do, whereas an outcome model, a kind of world model, predicts the consequences of each route. We study simulated Unitree Go2 quadrupeds and H1 humanoids with weakened motors, added payloads, or reduced foot friction. We compare four interfaces. The first is a decision policy, and the second is the same policy trained with fixed penalties for infeasible routes. The third is an outcome model that predicts the feasibility and travel time of each route. The fourth, which we call a capability contract, is an outcome model that predicts the chance of success and the travel time of the robot on each terrain and composes them along a route. All share the same collected experience, matched tuning and risk calibration, and an uncertainty guard. Two comparatively low-risk probes let the capability contract rank hazardous terrains about as well as four new trials on every hazard. At a calibrated 5% limit on selecting empirically infeasible routes, outcome models cut declined missions from about 32% to 7-8% on Go2 and from 57% to 35-36% on H1 compared with the plain policy. Fixed penalties narrow this gap, but the best penalty changes with the risk target. Predicting outcomes lets the planner preserve missions by changing routes as risk requirements tighten.

analysis.key_results: 在5%不可行路线选择率限制下，结果模型使 Go2 的拒绝任务从约32%降至7-8%，H1 从57%降至35-36%；能力契约仅需两个低风险探测即可达到与每个危险地形四次新试验相当的排序效果。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出并比较了四种模型决策接口（普通决策策略、固定惩罚策略、结果模型、能力契约），证明结果模型（尤其是能力契约）能在校准风险限制下显著减少拒绝任务的比例。
analysis.method: 在模拟的 Unitree Go2 四足机器人和 H1 人形机器人上，通过改变电机力量、增加负载或降低足部摩擦模拟损伤，训练并对比四种接口的表现。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文研究在机器人受损后风险感知规划中，学习模型应提供的决策接口（决策策略 vs. 结果模型/能力契约）对任务成功率与风险校准的影响。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文的结果模型属于世界模型（World Model）范畴，预测机器人在地形上的成功概率和旅行时间，并沿路线组合，与本站关注的世界建模主题直接相关；虽然未涉及视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，但为机器人世界模型在风险感知规划中的应用提供了实证支持。

The route model predicts route feasibility, while the contract predicts terrain success and composes estimates for new combinations.

papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit strong semantic understanding but remain limited in their ability to reason about metric 3D space in the physical world. Existing VLMs typically infer 3D scene structure from one or more images without known camera calibration or cross-view geometric constraints. This makes metric 3D inference inherently ambiguous and leaves it unclear whether their spatial predictions are grounded in visual evidence or driven primarily by semantic priors. In contrast, calibrated stereo provides explicit cross-view geometry that resolves this ambiguity and offers a more reliable foundation for metric 3D perception and geometric generalization. We investigate how VLMs can learn transferable 3D representations directly from calibrated binocular observations. To this end, we introduce StereoVLM, the first geometry-aware binocular VLM for metric 3D spatial reasoning. StereoVLM follows a hierarchical learning paradigm spanning from cross-view correspondence and disparity estimation to calibration-conditioned metric depth perception and semantic spatial reasoning. We further find that disparity supervision generalizes substantially better than direct binocular depth supervision on unseen environments. To evaluate these capabilities, we introduce Stereo3D-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark across three levels, from point-level geometry to object-level spatial reasoning. StereoVLM-8B achieves 95.17% depth accuracy ($\delta_1$) and a 66.98 average object-level score on Stereo3D-Bench. Intervention results further indicate that the model's performance on Stereo3D-Bench benefits from valid cross-view geometry and cannot be explained solely by additional visual tokens or semantic priors. Hierarchical geometric supervision also yields average gains of 3.54 points across five spatial benchmarks and 4.3 percentage points in RoboCasa manipulation success.

analysis.key_results: StereoVLM-8B在Stereo3D-Bench上达到95.17%的深度准确率（δ1）和66.98的平均对象级得分；层次几何监督在五个空间基准上平均提升3.54分，在RoboCasa操作成功率上提升4.3个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出首个几何感知的双目视觉语言模型StereoVLM，用于度量三维空间推理，并引入Stereo3D-Bench基准。
analysis.method: 采用层次化学习范式，从跨视角对应和视差估计到校准条件下的度量深度感知和语义空间推理。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出StereoVLM，一个利用双目校准图像学习可迁移度量三维表示的视觉语言模型，并构建Stereo3D-Bench基准验证其空间推理能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作关注视觉语言模型的三维空间推理能力，并通过RoboCasa操作任务评估其对机器人操作性能的提升，与VLA的空间理解和操作能力相关，但未直接提出动作预测或世界模型。

figures.caption: StereoVLM: from binocular geometry to spatial understanding and action. (a) Monocular observations leave metric scale ambiguous. (b) An illustrative example of language-grounded metric reasoning from calibrated stereo observations. (c) Stereo3D-Bench evaluates spatial understanding at three levels. Disparity supervision improves depth generalization, while hierarchical geometric supervision benefits broader 3D spatial reasoning and downstream VLA performance.
figures.label: Figure 1

Independently selected point- and object-level subsets contain 2,017 and 1,556 stereo pairs, respectively, yielding 94,546 question–answer instances. (b) Representative queries and answer formats for eight tasks spanning point-level geometry, object-level geometry, and object-level spatial reasoning.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: StereoVLM: Binocular Vision-Language Models for Metric 3D Spatial Reasoning

papers.abstract: Streaming visual geometry transformers retain historical key-value (KV) states as cross-view geometric memory, but growing caches constrain long-sequence inference. We systematically characterize KV quantization in streaming geometry and uncover two linked challenges: Nonuniform Geometric Sensitivity and Cache-Geometry Mismatch. Quantization sensitivity varies across precision choices and cache locations, while perturbed retrieval changes geometry-head inputs and propagates through subsequent predictions and KV writes. Guided by these findings, we propose QuantStream3D, to our knowledge the first dedicated KV quantization framework for streaming visual geometry transformers. Geometry-Guided Mixed-Precision KV Quantization protects sensitive cross-view evidence, while Geometry-Aligned Quantization-Aware Distillation jointly adapts transformer blocks and geometry heads on student-generated quantized history. Across five benchmarks and two backbones, QuantStream3D achieves near-lossless geometric accuracy in most settings with predominantly 2-bit KV caches, and many configurations surpass unquantized inference. Compared with LLM-oriented KV quantizers, it reduces TUM absolute trajectory error and NeuralRGBD completeness error by up to 57.4% and 69.7%, respectively. Integration with existing native cache-pruning methods further pushes compression while improving reconstruction quality on NeuralRGBD. Our optimized StreamVGGT backend achieves $5.05\times$ physical KV compression and 23.1% lower latency at batch size one. Under a fixed memory budget on the same GPU, it supports $5.4\times$ the maximum batch size and up to $1.67\times$ the peak throughput of unquantized inference. Code and pretrained checkpoints will be made publicly available.

analysis.key_results: 在五个基准和两种主干上，2位KV缓存实现近无损几何精度；在TUM绝对轨迹误差上降低57.4%，在NeuralRGBD完整性误差上降低69.7%；后端实现5.05倍物理压缩、23.1%延迟降低，支持最大批量大小5.4倍、峰值吞吐量1.67倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出QuantStream3D，首个面向流式视觉几何Transformer的专用KV缓存量化框架，包含几何引导混合精度量化与几何对齐量化感知蒸馏，实现近无损几何精度。
analysis.method: 几何引导混合精度KV量化：根据几何敏感性分配精度；几何对齐量化感知蒸馏：用学生生成的量化历史联合适配Transformer块和几何头。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出首个针对流式视觉几何Transformer的KV缓存量化框架QuantStream3D，通过几何引导的混合精度量化和几何对齐的量化感知蒸馏实现近无损压缩。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于视觉几何Transformer的KV缓存量化，属于模型量化效率优化，与VLA、WAM无直接关系，但其高效推理技术可能对机器人策略或世界模型中的几何流式处理有借鉴意义。

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates language-model inference by preparing candidate continuations before the target model generates them. Its efficiency depends on how well limited drafting computation anticipates the path the target will actually follow. Anticipating this path involves two sources of uncertainty: the target model's predictions and the randomness of sampling. Yet the former requires a target-model forward pass, while the latter can be fixed before drafting. Building on this observation, we introduce DICE (Draw-Informed Candidate Selection), which pre-samples and synchronizes verification randomness across drafting and verification. By combining these known draws with predictions from an existing drafter, DICE allocates computation toward continuations more likely to be used in the current sampling run. This principle guides node selection throughout draft-tree construction and extends to asynchronous prefetching, where DICE predicts which next-round drafts to prepare. Without additional drafter training or changes to the target sampling distribution, DICE achieves state-of-the-art decoding throughput across diverse settings, with speedups of up to 24.6pp over strong baselines.

analysis.key_results: 在多种设置下实现了最先进的解码吞吐量，相比强基线最高提升24.6个百分点（pp）。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入DICE（Draw-Informed Candidate Selection），通过预采样验证随机性并将其与草稿模型预测结合，改进草稿树节点选择与异步预取，在不改变目标采样分布或额外训练草稿模型的情况下提升推测解码吞吐量。
analysis.method: DICE，即“Draw-Informed Candidate Selection”，在草稿生成前预先采样验证随机性，并在草稿和验证阶段同步这些随机数；利用已知采样结果与草稿模型预测共同指导草稿树构建和异步预取中的节点选择。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出DICE方法，通过预采样并同步验证阶段的随机性来减少推测解码中的不确定性，从而提升解码吞吐量。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文研究推测解码这一独立的高效推理技术，没有直接涉及VLA或WAM。但推测解码可应用于语言模型加速，若未来将此类技术集成到机器人策略网络或世界模型中，可能对VLA/WAM的推理效率具有潜在价值。

papers.abstract: Linear manufacturing typically operates in highly structured settings with standardized objects, allowing robots to execute pre-programmed motions based on precise models. In contrast, circular manufacturing involves dynamic and less controlled environments, where product components can vary due to appearance and physical changes across different product generations. In this context, uncertainty arises from both the unknown or partially observed states of components (e.g., damaged surfaces, altered shapes) and the unstructured disassembly environment, often characterized by heavy clutter, occlusions, and limited sensing viewpoints. This demands a flexible and adaptable robotic grasping system that can cope with unexpected object changes. To address these challenges, this paper proposes an autonomous grasp learning framework designed for highly uncertain and variable conditions. The framework explicitly distinguishes between uncertainty due to noisy or incomplete sensory observations (aleatoric uncertainty) and uncertainty due to limited knowledge and distribution shift (epistemic uncertainty). Moreover, the framework employs an active perception strategy to reduce visual ambiguity: semantic and spatial scene understanding is achieved using vision language models (VLMs), while view planning enables the robot to adjust its viewpoint to improve observability. In addition, the approach leverages large-scale human demonstration data to learn interaction patterns, which are then transferred to robotic end-effectors, enabling robust manipulation in these variable settings. Quantitative validation, including the utility of active vision on disassembled components in practice, is expected to form an important part of future work.

papers.abstract: Multimodal search agents answer knowledge intensive visual questions by grounding them in retrieved evidence, and recent recipes train them on multi hop tasks that are synthesized from knowledge graphs and grown online to keep pace with the agent. These recipes, however, treat the searchable world as fixed: a new question can be well formed and verifiable while its evidence is absent from the retrieval backend, so the agent issues the right query, retrieves nothing, and is penalized as if its policy were at fault. Such unreachable negatives accumulate with every round of growth. We propose Search-RSI, a recursive self improvement framework that expands the search world along the agent's capability frontier. In each round, the current policy diagnoses its partially mastered regions of a task space spanned by hop depth, relation rarity, and distractor density; new tasks there are grown together with their evidence; and the same policy decides how they are used: candidates on which its probes disagree feed reinforcement learning, while those beyond its reach become hint guided demonstrations of its own. Keeping the policy inside this loop matters: an improver frozen at the start of training loses 3.2 points. On nine multimodal search benchmarks, Search-RSI keeps improving where static task growth saturates, raising the average accuracy of the recipe it builds on by 9.8 and 9.5 points at 9B and 27B, of which 7.0 points are out of reach for a world that is merely made consistent. The loop uses no external model and only privileged task structure that is removed before training, at 1.27x the compute of static growth.

analysis.key_results: 在九个多模态搜索基准上，Search-RSI平均准确率在9B和27B模型上分别提高9.8和9.5个百分点，其中7.0个百分点是仅使世界一致无法达到的；训练起始时冻结的改进器性能下降3.2个百分点；计算成本为静态增长的1.27倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Search-RSI框架，通过递归自我改进动态扩展搜索世界，使任务生成与证据检索同步，从而提升多模态搜索智能体的训练效果。
analysis.method: 每轮训练中，当前策略诊断任务空间中部分掌握的区域（跳跃深度、关系稀有度、干扰密度），在该区域生成任务及其证据，并根据策略的一致性决定用于强化学习或提示引导的自我演示。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出Search-RSI递归自我改进框架，在多模态搜索智能体的能力前沿扩展搜索世界，以解决静态任务增长中不可达负样本累积的问题。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文关注多模态搜索智能体的训练数据生成与自我改进，与VLA或WAM无直接关系；其递归自我改进和任务空间诊断思想可能对机器人策略学习有方法论参考价值，但摘要未涉及机器人领域。

papers.abstract: Training a humanoid motion tracker by backpropagating imagined returns through a learned world model is fast, because the model gives a first-order policy gradient. We ask how much of that gradient holds in the simulator. On a tracker for the Unitree G1, the $0.5\%$ of imagined rollouts with the largest gradients carry $22\%$ of the summed gradient norm, yet neither a second rollout from the same state nor the simulator confirms them. When the actions are moved along the model's gradient, the simulator returns 94% of the predicted change in return where the gradient norm is below the batch median, 48% between 3 and 10 times the median, and 1% above 30 times; the part of a gradient that either check confirms stops growing at a few times the median. We therefore cap each rollout's action-gradient norm at 10 times the batch median, draw imagination starts in proportion to their predicted gradient norm so that the cap removes less, and reset episodes where the world model and critic predict the lowest return. Trained on 223 hours of motion and tested on 353 motions that no actor performed in training, the method raises the normalized return of SuperMimic, the baseline it builds on, from 0.953 to 0.967 and the lowest $1\%$ of test clips from 0.65 to 0.76, halves the test clips that fall persistently, from 15--18 to 7--10, and reaches the baseline's final return in 40% of the baseline's iterations and half its training time. On LAFAN1, trained and evaluated on the same clips as prior work, it reaches 0.935 against 0.906.

analysis.key_results: 在223小时运动数据训练、353个未见过动作测试中，将SuperMimic的归一化回报从0.953提升至0.967，最低1%测试片段从0.65提升至0.76，持续跌倒片段减少一半，训练时间减半；在LAFAN1上达到0.935（对比0.906）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种基于世界模型的策略梯度截断训练方法，使Unitree G1人形运动跟踪器学习更快、性能更高。
analysis.method: 对每个rollout的动作梯度范数设置10倍于批次中位数的截断上限，并按预测梯度范数成比例地采样想象起点，同时重置世界模型和批评者预测回报最低的episode。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 通过分析世界模型中巨大策略梯度的不可靠性，提出梯度截断与重要性采样等改进，显著提升人形机器人运动跟踪策略的训练速度和性能。

papers.abstract: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) can improve pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) policies through imagined experiences. However, existing VLA-MBRL methods primarily rely on large-scale image or video generation world models, incurring large computational overhead. Latent world models offer a more efficient alternative but face two challenges: compounding errors during recursive prediction and incompatibility with VLAs' visual input interfaces. In this work, we propose LS-MBPO, a lightweight residual MBRL framework that leverages latent world models to improve upon pretrained VLAs. LS-MBPO introduces two key techniques: (1) Hierarchical Forcing, which combines dense causal supervision with autoregressive feedback to mitigate compounding prediction errors; and (2) Latent Subchunk Rollouts, which leverage action chunks from a frozen VLA policy and a latent residual policy for successive subchunk refinement, bridging the gap between latent imagination and VLA policy execution. We further introduce a Progress-Conditioned Branch-Start Curriculum that progressively shifts rollout starting points from later to earlier task stages, enabling effective policy learning from short imagined rollouts. Extensive experiments on LIBERO, RoboTwin, and a real-world ALOHA robot show that LS-MBPO achieves superior task performance and training efficiency compared to existing methods.

analysis.key_results: 在 LIBERO、RoboTwin 和真实 ALOHA 机器人上，LS-MBPO 相比于现有方法取得了更优的任务性能和训练效率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 LS-MBPO 框架，利用潜世界模型实现高效的基于模型的 VLA 策略改进，引入 Hierarchical Forcing、Latent Subchunk Rollouts 和 Progress-Conditioned Branch-Start Curriculum 三项关键技术。
analysis.method: 采用潜世界模型进行想象推演，结合分层强制（Hierarchical Forcing）缓解复合误差，利用潜子块推演（Latent Subchunk Rollouts）衔接潜想象与 VLA 执行，并通过进度条件分支起始课程（Progress-Conditioned Branch-Start Curriculum）从短想象推演中有效学习。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出 LS-MBPO，一种轻量级残差 MBRL 框架，通过潜世界模型中的子块推演高效改进预训练 VLA 策略。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接针对 VLA 策略的基于模型的强化学习，使用潜世界模型替代图像/视频生成世界模型，降低计算开销，属于 VLA 与 WAM 交叉的核心研究。

papers.abstract: Latent world models plan by rolling out hundreds of candidate action sequences through a transformer predictor, so a single decision can take tens of seconds. Existing accelerations prune spatial tokens as in vision-language models, yet a sampling-based planner uses predicted costs only to rank candidates, so a rollout can be compressed freely as long as the ranking survives. We propose SOAR, a training-free method that adapts rollout compression to each planning decision. At every decision, SOAR probes a few candidates under several token budgets and keeps the smallest budget that preserves their ranking, so it compresses as far as the current decision allows, without task labels. A closed-loop study of more than 80,000 episodes fixes the rest of the rollout: the first step, which alone reads a real observation, stays exact, and the context frame is cached rather than recomputed. On seven navigation and manipulation tasks with frozen checkpoints, SOAR matches dense-level planning success at 2.3x speedup and retains 98% at 2.5x. Our code is available at https://github.com/starrywiki/SOAR.

analysis.key_results: 在七个导航和操作任务中，SOAR在冻结模型上匹配稠密级规划成功率并实现2.3倍加速，在2.5倍加速下保持98%成功率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SOAR，一种无需训练、秩一致的自适应展开压缩技术，通过在每个规划决策处探测不同令牌预算并保留候选动作排名，加速潜世界模型的采样规划。
analysis.method: 在每个规划决策处，SOAR对若干候选动作序列在多个令牌预算下进行采样，选择保持候选排名的最小预算，并对第一步观测保持精确、缓存上下文帧以重用。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: SOAR提出一种无需训练的自适应展开压缩方法，在潜世界模型采样规划中按决策动态选择最小令牌预算，实现2.3-2.5倍加速且保持成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接关注潜世界模型规划的高效推理压缩，属于机器人世界模型（WAM）的核心效率优化，对VLA/WAM的实时部署具有直接价值。

papers.abstract: Serving engines treat the ways of running a greedy language model as interchangeable: cached or not, padded or not, alone or batched, one token or several verified at once (speculative decoding). In finite precision they round differently. We measure how often the greedy text of Qwen3-0.6B (bfloat16, 128 new tokens, GSM8K and ARC prompts) differs from a reference that decodes one token per pass. Verifying 4 guessed tokens per pass changes 60% of 150 prompts and padding changes 68%; every first divergence has a top-1 minus top-2 logit gap of 0.375 or less. A split of the noise shows that cache entries written by multi-token passes are about as noisy as the multi-token pass itself. A margin gate (fall back to one token when the gap is below a bound calibrated on separate GSM8K prompts) whose fallback reads that cache does not help: 58 of 100 prompts differ, against 61 of 100 for plain verification. Rebuilding the cache with one-token passes leaves 0 of 100 different but costs 7.2 model passes per token, against 1.0 for the reference. Fixed-width decoding makes drafted and plain decoding identical (0 of 100 prompts differ) at 0.75 passes per token. On shifted MMLU and HellaSwag prompts the rebuild gate leaves 0 of 60 different, plain verification 48 of 60. On 138 further and shifted prompts the bound was exceeded at 0.6% of positions and missed 0 of 309 flips. One GPU, one drafter, small models.

analysis.key_results: 验证4个猜测token时60%的提示发生变化，padding改变68%；重建缓存后0%差异但每token需要7.2次模型前向；固定宽度解码以每token 0.75次前向实现0%差异。
analysis.limitations: 单个GPU、单个草稿模型、小模型。
analysis.main_contribution: 量化了投机验证与批处理/缓存等不同执行方式在有限精度下导致的贪心文本差异，并提出了重建缓存与固定宽度解码来消除噪声并评估其成本。
analysis.method: 对Qwen3-0.6B模型在不同解码方式（投机验证、批处理、缓存、padding）下进行有限精度舍入噪声测量，设计margin gate、重建缓存和固定宽度解码方法。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文测量并分析了投机解码中因有限精度舍入导致的贪心输出偏离，并评估了消除该噪声的方法及其计算成本。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注投机解码的数值噪声与消除，未直接涉及VLA或WAM；但其方法可用于任何自回归语言模型的高效推理，包括机器人策略或世界模型中的解码，对高效推理相关研究具有参考价值。
