papers.abstract: We present Ego4Gen (Egocentric 4D Future Generation), a world model for 4D future generation in robotic manipu lation. Given a single egocentric image and a text prompt, Ego4Gen jointly generates temporally aligned RGB frames, dense point maps, and dense scene flow, explicitly pre dicting the evolution of scene appearance, spatial struc ture, and motion. Built on Cosmos3-Nano, Ego4Gen ex tends the pretrained generative backbone through modality routed LoRA and asymmetric attention, using geometric pseudo-labels from MotionCrafter to learn to predict future geometry and motion latents. These latents can either be decoded into explicit 3D structure and motion or mapped to robot actions. To this end, we also introduce FlowIn verse, a lightweight inverse dynamics network trained in two stages to translate predicted 4D latents into robot ac tions. Experiments show that these geometry and motion latents outperform the evaluated latent-action and video latent baselines in out-of-distribution settings. Closed loop policy evaluations further demonstrate their utility for translating predicted 4D futures into robot control. To gether, these results support geometry-grounded motion to kens as a world-action interface, connecting 4D future gen eration with robotic manipulation and suggesting a path to ward reduced reliance on action-labeled data.

analysis.key_results: 实验显示，几何与运动潜变量在分布外设置中优于潜在动作和视频潜变量基线；闭环策略评估证明了将预测的四维未来转化为机器人控制的实用性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 Ego4Gen，一种能够联合生成未来 RGB、稠密点图和场景流的四维世界模型，并用几何驱动的运动标记作为世界-动作接口，实现从未来预测到机器人控制的连接。
analysis.method: 基于 Cosmos3-Nano 主干，通过模态路由 LoRA 和非对称注意力扩展；使用 MotionCrafter 生成几何伪标签；引入 FlowInverse 轻量逆动力学网络，两阶段训练将预测的四维潜变量映射为机器人动作。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: Ego4Gen 是一个面向机器人操作的四维未来生成世界模型，可从单张第一人称图像和文本提示联合生成 RGB 帧、稠密点图和场景流，并通过预测的四维潜变量映射机器人动作。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 高度相关：该工作构建了一个世界模型，并直接服务于机器人操作，通过几何运动标记连接预测未来与动作，属于世界-动作模型的范畴，对机器人策略学习和高效推理方法具有启示。

papers.abstract: Autoregressive inference in large transformer models is limited by token-level sequential execution, resulting in high latency and low GPU utilization. Speculative decoding (SD) mitigates this bottleneck by introducing a draft-and-verifier model. However, the drafting stage remains sequential, leaving the verifier idle and underutilizing compute. To address this, we propose a plug-and-play drafting adaptive drafting method that parallelizes inference across transformer layers during draft generation. Starting from a shared hidden state, our approach evaluates multiple layers in parallel and verifies consistency by measuring divergence in hidden-state space. Layer-wise draft states are accepted when deviations are small; otherwise, a correction step is applied. By exploiting redundancy across transformer layers, our method accelerates draft generation and improves hardware utilization without modifying architectures or requiring retraining. Experimental results on NLP tasks show that our method speeds up the drafting stage by up to $1.65\times$ with minimal degradation in accuracy, while maintaining the same performance as SD.

analysis.key_results: 在NLP任务上，起草阶段加速最高达1.65倍，准确率下降最小，同时保持与投机解码相同的性能。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一种即插即用的自适应并行起草方法，在草稿生成期间并行化Transformer层，无需修改架构或重新训练即可加速投机解码。
analysis.method: 从共享隐藏状态出发，并行评估多个Transformer层，并通过测量隐藏状态空间的偏差来验证一致性；当偏差较小时接受逐层草稿状态，否则执行校正步骤。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种即插即用的并行起草方法，通过在Transformer层间共享隐藏状态并并行评估多个层，减少起草阶段的顺序执行并提高硬件利用率，从而消除投机解码中验证器的空闲时间。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于通用推理效率，未涉及VLA、WAM或机器人技术，但所提出的并行起草方法可直接应用于基于自回归Transformer的VLA或世界模型，以减少延迟并提高GPU利用率。

papers.title: Cannot Wait to Verify: Parallel Drafting to Eliminate Verifier Idle Time in Speculative Decoding
papers.title_zh: 不能等待验证：通过并行起草消除投机解码中的验证器空闲时间

papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) capabilities have been associated with localized parameter regions, enabling targeted model editing and intervention. However, it remains unclear whether a region identified before model optimization remains an effective intervention target afterward. We evaluate the functional persistence and parameter overlap of coding capability regions across three instruction-tuned models under quantization, pruning, and LoRA-based adaptation. Although re-extracted regions exhibit substantial parameter reorganization, ablating the original region after optimization eliminates or nearly eliminates coding performance in almost all conditions, while magnitude-matched controls preserve performance. Partition analysis further shows that the shared subset of the original and re-extracted regions accounts for most of the observed ablation effect in the majority of conditions. These results demonstrate that parameter overlap and functional persistence are distinct: capability regions can remain causally effective intervention targets even when their parameter realization changes substantially.

analysis.key_results: 重新提取的区域存在显著参数重组，但消融原始区域在几乎所有条件下消除或几乎消除编码性能；共享子集在多数条件下贡献大部分消融效应。
analysis.main_contribution: 证明模型能力区域的功能持续性可以与参数重叠分离：即使参数表示发生显著重组，原始区域仍可作为因果有效的干预靶点。
analysis.method: 对三个指令微调模型进行量化、剪枝和LoRA适配，评估编码能力区域的功能持续性和参数重叠，并进行分区分析。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 研究指令微调模型在量化、剪枝和LoRA适配后，编码能力区域的参数重叠与功能持续性，发现原始区域仍可作为有效干预靶点。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该文独立研究量化与模型优化对能力区域的影响，未涉及VLA或WAM，但对模型量化相关工作有方法学参考价值。

papers.abstract: Quantization enables efficient inference in language models through model parameter compression. This work audits the impact of quantization on capability and safety domains including model safeguards, instruction-following, ethics and bias. Through benchmarks, we find that model safeguards and bias can degrade under quantization, while other capabilities such as truthfulness remain more stable in Qwen3-4B. We define this uneven transfer of LLM capabilities under quantization as Jagged Robustness. We find multiple factors driving Jagged Robustness: task complexity, evaluation method and generation coherence. Moreover, we verify the degradation of model safeguards by observing increased compliance with unsafe requests under quantization, and demonstrate universal adversarial suffix attacks that are benign for the full model but jailbreak quantized models. The findings indicate that it is risky to assume that the performance and robustness can transfer evenly across different capability domains from full models to quantized models.

analysis.key_results: 模型安全防护和偏差在量化下退化，而真实性等能力在Qwen3-4B中较稳定；量化模型对不安全请求的合规性增加，且存在对全精度模型无害但能越狱量化模型的通用对抗后缀攻击。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出锯齿鲁棒性概念，揭示LLM量化对安全防护、偏差等能力的不均衡影响，并发现量化可导致新的越狱漏洞。
analysis.method: 通过基准测试审计量化前后模型在安全防护、指令遵循、伦理和偏差等领域的表现，并分析任务复杂度、评估方法和生成连贯性等因素。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文审计了量化对LLM能力与安全领域的影响，发现模型安全防护和偏差在量化下可能退化，并称之为锯齿鲁棒性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于LLM量化对安全与能力的影响，未直接涉及VLA或WAM。但对将量化应用于机器人模型或世界模型时的鲁棒性和安全性评估具有参考价值。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language Navigation(VLN) requires an embodied agent to follow language instructions through unseen 3D environments, where the target spaces often lie beyond the current observation. Navigation world models address this challenge by predicting future views either as pixels or latent representations, providing valuable look-ahead information for action decision. Both paradigms define the future primarily through what the agent may observe, raising a fundamental question: is predicting future views the ultimate form to represent the future for VLN? Cognitive studies show that the human hippocampus prospectively represents both future goals and intervening locations along planned routes. Inspired by this predictive-map view, we organize the navigation-relevant future around goal-directed spatial states and route structure. We instantiate this perspective with two complementary abstractions: a short-horizon waypoint that specifies the next local state to reach, and a mid-horizon corridor that captures the spatial support of the upcoming route. Based on this design, we propose FS-Nav, a future-state world modeling framework that predicts waypoint-corridor states from spatial memory and language instructions, and communicates them to a VLM navigator through top-down and first-person interfaces. Experiments on standard VLN benchmarks demonstrate that FS-Nav achieves state-of-the-art performance. This highlights navigation-relevant future-state modeling as a promising direction for representing the future in VLN.

analysis.key_results: 在标准VLN基准上实现了最先进性能。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出FS-Nav，一种预测航点-走廊状态的未来状态世界建模框架，用于视觉语言导航。
analysis.method: 从空间记忆和语言指令预测短视距航点与中视距走廊状态，并通过俯视和第一人称接口传递给VLM导航器。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: FS-Nav提出一种未来状态世界模型，通过预测航点和走廊状态并与VLM导航器交互，在VLN中表达导航相关的未来。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 明确指出传统世界模型以未来观察（像素或潜在表示）为中心，而FS-Nav以目标导向的空间状态和路径结构组织未来，并通过航点和走廊抽象进行行动决策，属于机器人世界建模的替代范式。

Conditioned on the instruction, observation history, and rendered guidance, the Future-State-Guided Navigator generates an action chunk and interacts with the environment in a closed loop. papers.abstract: We present Zing-1.0, a Playable World System built on Controllable Rendering. An executable engine resolves player actions under the world's rules and produces proxy video from the updated state. A streaming video model synthesizes the player's view from this proxy, and the runtime delivers it to inform subsequent actions. (1) Principle and system. We formulate Controllable Rendering and define the interfaces among world construction, world execution, observation synthesis, and the interaction runtime. To our knowledge, this is the first implementation-independent specification of a Playable World System. (2) AI-native engine. WorldKit provides structured authoring tools and reusable character, camera, and control components for coding agents to construct executable proxy worlds. It supports extensible interactions and precise geometric motion control while separating executable behavior from final visual appearance. (3) Streaming renderer. We adapt MiniMax-H3 for block-causal autoregressive generation and incremental decoding. Proxy video constrains structure and motion, while text and separate scene and subject references specify appearance. We train the generator on diverse tasks and distill it to generate each block in a few denoising steps. The renderer leads the compared streaming editors on OpenVE (3.90) and LongV2VBench (3.44). On StreamEval, Zing-1.0 scores 57.86 on instruction editing and 54.06 on reference editing, exceeding the published baselines on both tracks. (4) Interaction infrastructure. We build an Interaction Runtime that routes player actions to WorldKit while supporting in-play prompt and reference updates. Cross-block joint execution and sparse attention with compressed K/V reduce inference overhead. With the DiT on a single H200 and encoding and decoding on one H100 each, the serving system achieves a steady-state throughput of 23.82 FPS at $832\times480$.

analysis.key_results: 在OpenVE上得分3.90，LongV2VBench上得分3.44，StreamEval指令编辑57.86分、参考编辑54.06分，均超过已发布基线；单H200 DiT加编码/解码各一个H100实现23.82 FPS的稳定吞吐。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出可玩世界系统的首个实现无关规范（Controllable Rendering），并构建了AI原生引擎WorldKit、流式渲染器以及交互运行时。
analysis.method: 系统由WorldKit结构化世界构建与可控渲染框架、基于MiniMax-H3的块因果自回归生成与增量解码的流式渲染器、以及交互运行时组成，其中代理视频约束结构与运动，文本与参考图指定外观。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: Zing-1.0是一个由可控渲染驱动的可玩世界系统，通过可执行引擎解析玩家动作并生成代理视频，再经流式视频模型合成最终视图。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作属于机器人世界模型（WAM）的相邻领域，专注于可玩世界的构建与渲染，为WAM研究提供了系统规范、引擎与流式视频生成思路，但不直接涉及机器人动作预测或VLA模型。

papers.abstract: Latent action models let a robot policy learn from video by turning the change between two frames into a training target. In egocentric video, a cup can move across the image because a hand pushes it or because the wearer turns. Both changes help predict the next frame, but only the first describes manipulation. During training, EgoLAM supervises the action code with measured wrist motion and supplies camera motion separately to the forward model. Even when the wearer turns while pushing a cup, the training target still describes how the hand pushed it. The action encoder pools object slots around each hand, and wrist translation and rotation can be decoded from the code in a common reference frame. Extracting a code then requires only two RGB frames. Alongside LARYBench classification and regression, we measure how much wrist motion a frozen code retains and how strongly it responds to a synthetic view or lighting change. EgoLAM has the highest hand-motion decoding score among eight evaluated models. Across three LIBERO suites, policies pretrained on its codes and fine-tuned on expert demonstrations achieve 79.38% mean success, 28.73 points above expert behavior cloning and 9.76 points above the strongest other latent action model in each suite on average.

analysis.key_results: EgoLAM 在八个评估模型中具有最高的手部运动解码分数；在三个 LIBERO 套件上，基于其代码预训练并微调的策略平均成功率为 79.38%，比行为克隆高 28.73 个百分点，比最强其他潜在动作模型高 9.76 个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 EgoLAM，一种潜在动作模型，通过手腕运动监督和相机运动分离，从自我中心视频中学习操作相关的动作表示。
analysis.method: 使用手腕运动监督动作编码，将相机运动单独提供给前向模型；动作编码器融合每只手周围的对象槽，并在公共参考系中解码手腕平移和旋转。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: EgoLAM 提出一种潜在动作模型，通过手腕运动监督和相机运动分离，从自我中心视频中学习用于机器人操作的潜在动作。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中的动作表示学习，通过从视频中学习潜在动作以改善机器人操作策略，属于 VLA 和机器人学习范畴。

papers.abstract: Surface electromyography (sEMG) enables continuous hand-pose estimation, but learning representations that generalize across users and movements remains challenging. We introduce InterBand-EMG, which combines band-specific quantization with cross-band reconstruction and structured masked code prediction to learn transferable EMG representations for hand-pose tracking. We also introduce SynapMyo, an eight-channel EMG-to-pose dataset comprising 1,227.74 hand-hours from 499 users across 68 movement categories. Experiments on emg2pose and SynapMyo show that InterBand-EMG outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in joint-angle accuracy across all three generalization settings on both datasets. The source code and the SynapMyo dataset will be publicly released upon acceptance of this paper.

analysis.key_results: 在emg2pose和SynapMyo数据集上，InterBand-EMG在三种泛化设置下均优于最先进的基线方法，关节角度精度更高。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出InterBand-EMG模型，结合频带特定量化、跨频带重建和结构化掩码码预测，学习可泛化的sEMG表征；并发布包含499名用户、1,227.74手小时的SynapMyo数据集。
analysis.method: 频带特定量化、跨频带重建、结构化掩码码预测。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出InterBand-EMG模型，通过频带特定量化、跨频带重建和结构化掩码码预测，学习可迁移的sEMG表征用于手部姿态估计，并发布了大规模SynapMyo数据集。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文关注sEMG的手部姿态估计，与机器人学习相关，但未涉及视觉-语言-动作模型或世界模型；其量化方法属于模型量化，但与VLA/WAM无直接结合。

(a) Independent reconstruction uses a separate decoder for each band (b) Concatenation combines and projects features from all three bands into a joint representation for full-spectrum reconstruction. (c) Band-query attention, used in InterBand-EMG, takes each band’s features as queries and retrieves context from all bands. The retrieved context is added to that band’s projected features and passed to a shared decoder with band-specific reconstruction heads. In both attention variants, keys and values span all bands, electrodes, and temporal patches.

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates language generation by letting a target model verify several draft tokens in one forward pass. Earlier neural drafters such as EAGLE extend each candidate sequence one token at a time. Recent work has turned to parallel drafters such as DFlash, which predict a whole block at once. Another approach uses n-gram retrieval to find an earlier occurrence of the current context suffix and copy the tokens that followed it directly into the draft. We introduce CoPyro, which feeds these copied tokens into a parallel drafter in place of masks. The drafter learns from context which tokens to keep and which to revise as it predicts the block in its usual forward pass. Across eight benchmarks on Qwen3-4B, CoPyro improves overall acceptance length for all four parallel drafters tested, with gains of 2.19-5.08% when trained on 100K samples. With DFlash trained on 710K samples, overall gains range from 1.08% to 2.00% across the tested model sizes and temperatures. Code generation benefits most in both settings. On Qwen3-8B, processing the proposals adds an average of 0.24 ms per decoding round in Transformers.

analysis.key_results: 在Qwen3-4B上，四种并行起草器的整体接受长度提升2.19-5.08%（训练10万样本）；在DFlash训练71万样本时，不同模型规模和温度下提升1.08-2.00%；代码生成任务提升最大；在Qwen3-8B上，处理提议每轮解码平均增加0.24ms。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出CoPyro框架，将n-gram检索的复制令牌作为并行起草器的输入以替代掩码，使起草器学会保留或修改这些令牌，从而提升整体接受长度。
analysis.method: 使用n-gram检索找到当前上下文后缀的先前出现位置，复制其后续令牌，并将其馈送至并行起草器（如DFlash）进行块预测。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: CoPyro通过将n-gram检索的复制令牌与并行起草器结合，提升推测解码的接受长度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于推测解码这一高效推理技术，未直接涉及VLA或WAM。但其方法可用于加速任何自回归模型，包括机器人策略或世界模型，因此具有一定的潜在应用价值。

figures.caption: Overview of CoPyro. Before each drafting step, CoPyro finds the longest suffix of the context that occurred earlier (dotted) and copies the tokens that followed it as a proposal. The proposal replaces the mask inputs of the parallel drafter, together with learned match-length and agreement embeddings; the drafter, its output head and the target model's verification are unchanged.
figures.label: Figure 1

papers.title: CoPyro: Feeding Copy Proposals to Parallel Drafters
papers.title_zh: CoPyro：将复制提议馈送至并行起草器的推测解码方法

papers.abstract: Single-modality action-expert pretraining controls competition from visual shortcuts before vision--language--action (VLA) adaptation. Yet single-modality pretraining can impair the vision--language interactions needed for subsequent joint prediction. We construct a diagnostic model in which VA or LA pretraining can disable an initially active pathway for joint vision--language modeling. In this model, subsequent training with complete visual and language inputs cannot restore the pathway, even with unlimited adaptation. We therefore introduce Stochastic Context for Action Expert Pretraining (SCAP), a new action-expert pretraining stage that precedes full-input training. During this stage, visual and text tokens are randomly masked before entering the VLM. In this unified diagnostic model, SCAP can preserve the joint vision--language modeling pathway during pretraining and subsequent full-input training. Compared with direct full-input training, it can also reduce reliance on visual shortcuts and increase reliance on language instructions. SCAP consistently improves performance across four different VLA architectures. In real-robot experiments, it achieves 76.67% average success across three instruction-conditioned manipulation tasks, outperforming full-input pretraining by 25 percentage points.

analysis.key_results: SCAP在四种VLA架构上一致提升性能；真实机器人实验中，在三个指令条件的操作任务上平均成功率达76.67%，超过全输入预训练25个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SCAP预训练阶段，在动作专家预训练时随机掩码视觉和文本输入，以保持联合视觉-语言建模路径并减少视觉捷径依赖。
analysis.method: 在动作专家预训练阶段，对输入VLM的视觉和文本token进行随机掩码，形成随机上下文（Stochastic Context），随后再进行全输入训练。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出随机上下文动作专家预训练（SCAP），通过在预训练阶段随机掩码视觉和文本token，防止视觉捷径并保留视觉-语言联合建模能力，从而提升VLA模型性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接针对VLA模型训练策略，解决动作专家预训练中视觉捷径和模态交互受损问题，属于VLA策略学习与机器人操作的核心研究。

figures.caption: SCAP training and model architecture. (a) The action expert is pretrained with randomly masked visual and language tokens and a frozen backbone, then jointly adapted with the backbone on complete inputs. (b) The expert reads keys and values from the corresponding full-attention layers of the backbone and predicts the flow velocity.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: SCAP: Stochastic Context for Action Expert Pretraining
papers.title_zh: SCAP：面向动作专家预训练的随机上下文方法

papers.abstract: Agent harnesses are turn-based: the agent acts, waits for the result, then reasons. When the action invokes a pretrained robot policy, such as a vision-language-action (VLA) or world action model (WAM), the policy may react continuously to observations, but the agent cannot revisit its decision until the call returns. Meanwhile, a person may step into the robot's path or move the object it is about to grasp. Invoking the agent more often narrows this blind interval, but a reasoning model takes seconds per decision and most control steps need no new one. We propose TRIP, a training-free, event-driven harness in which the agent programs its own interrupts. With each call, the agent writes a tripwire: a lightweight, stateful Python program that runs alongside the policy, can query a compact VLM (for example, to locate a person and measure their distance), and decides whether the call continues or control returns to the agent. When it fires, the harness halts the policy and returns control with the reason; the agent then reassesses, adapts, and continues under a rewritten tripwire. We evaluate TRIP with three VLAs and one WAM on RoboHD, a benchmark of 168 RoboCasa365 scenes in which a simulated person disturbs the robot and any human-robot contact counts as failure. Compared with a turn-based harness using the same agent and tools, TRIP halves the rate of human contact with the strongest policy, raising safety from 61.3% to 81.3%, without sacrificing task success (38.7% vs. 31.0%). Real-robot experiments show that TRIP completes two manipulation tasks under human interference where the turn-based harness and the policy alone largely fail.

analysis.key_results: 在RoboHD基准（168个RoboCasa365场景，模拟人类干扰）上，使用三种VLA和一种WAM评估，TRIP将人类接触率降低一半，最强策略的安全性从61.3%提升至81.3%，且任务成功率未受损（38.7% vs. 31.0%）；真实机器人实验表明TRIP在人类干扰下完成了两个操作任务，而基线方法大多失败。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出TRIP，一种训练无关、事件驱动的智能体框架，允许智能体编写轻量级有状态Python程序（tripwire）来中断底层VLA/WAM策略的执行，从而在人类干扰等情况下及时重新决策。
analysis.method: 在每次调用VLA/WAM策略时，智能体生成一个tripwire（轻量级有状态Python程序），该程序与策略并行运行，可查询紧凑VLM以感知环境（如检测人员并测量距离），并在满足条件时中断策略，将控制权返回给智能体进行重新评估和调整。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种训练无关的事件驱动框架TRIP，使机器人智能体能够自行编程中断条件，在人类干扰下更安全、更高效地控制VLA/WAM策略。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接针对VLA/WAM在真实世界部署中的安全性和效率问题，通过事件驱动中断机制让上层智能体在必要时重新决策，属于VLA/WAM与高效推理（减少不必要的智能体调用）的结合，对机器人策略部署具有直接价值。

figures.caption: TRIP in one episode with Xiaomi-Robotics-1, while a person mops past the robot. A tripwire fires when the person comes within 0.3 m of the base, and the agent backs the robot out of the way, then resumes the policy under a tripwire on the person’s new position. When that one fires at the spot the person has just left, the agent rewrites it to watch for a close or reaching person, and the policy finishes the task. Top: when the agent, the policy and each (simplified) tripwire run.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Overview of TRIP. Given an instruction ℓ \ell , the agent selects a call c c and a tripwire w w . During execution, the tripwire reads observations o t o_{t} , queries a compact VLM, and combines the results with depth and memory m m to produce z t z_{t} . A false output allows execution to continue; a firing stops the call and returns control to the agent with the reason and memory. The agent then reassesses the scene and updates the call and tripwire. Snowflakes denote frozen models; calls and VLM queries are illustrative.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: Tripwire: Robot Agents that Program Their Own Interrupts under Human Disturbance
papers.title_zh: Tripwire：在人类干扰下自行编程中断的机器人智能体

papers.abstract: JEPA-style world models support visual planning by predicting future representations conditioned on future actions. However, similar observations can conceal different motion states, making temporal context essential for interpreting future action effects. We propose PACE-WM, a parallel world model that uses executed-action history to contextualize future prediction and planning. Specifically, PACE-WM maintains a recurrent memory of executed actions and uses this memory to condition a causal Transformer. PACE-WM predicts multiple future representations in parallel without recursive predicted-state feedback within each prediction window. We further introduce Reference-Anchored Minimum Progress (RAMP) for action selection during planning. RAMP scores candidate actions by their predicted goal improvement along direct and split paths relative to a shared reference. Across four visual planning tasks, PACE-WM with RAMP achieves an average success rate of $98\%$ and plans approximately $7$-$9\times$ faster than autoregressive LeWM under matched CEM settings. We also construct four controlled benchmarks to evaluate PACE-WM's capabilities in motion disambiguation, goal-relative motion, and goal adaptation. Project page is available at https://github.com/LHS180/PACE-WM.

analysis.key_results: 在四个视觉规划任务中，PACE-WM with RAMP 平均成功率达 98%，在匹配的 CEM 设置下比自回归 LeWM 规划速度快约 7-9 倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 PACE-WM，一种并行世界模型，利用已执行动作的历史来有条件地预测未来表征，并引入 RAMP 动作选择方法，在视觉规划中实现更高成功率和更快规划。
analysis.method: 维护已执行动作的递归记忆，并用其条件化因果 Transformer；在不进行递归预测状态反馈的情况下并行预测多个未来表征；使用 RAMP 基于预测目标改进对候选动作评分。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出 PACE-WM，一种利用动作历史进行时间上下文建模的并行世界模型，在视觉规划任务中显著提升成功率和推理速度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接属于世界模型（WAM）研究，聚焦于机器人视觉规划中的动作条件未来预测，与本站主题高度相关。

figures.caption: PACE-WM architecture. Recurrent action memory adjusts the first future action block. A causal Transformer propagates this context across action tokens and uses the current visual representation to predict future latents in parallel.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: PACE-WM: Parallel World Modeling with Action History for Visual Planning
papers.title_zh: PACE-WM：基于动作历史的并行世界模型用于视觉规划

papers.abstract: Visual labeling of egocentric demonstrations often leaves contiguous gaps in action supervision. Reliable poses around a gap still provide its net translation and rotation. We use this information to train vision-language-action policies while preserving ordinary flow matching on reliable local actions. A composition objective constrains the aggregate motion of missing-action estimates, combining multiple fixed windows when a gap exceeds the policy horizon. A shared interval branch learns from reliable endpoints and supplies the composition target. On LIBERO with 20% of demonstrations and 70.5% missing actions, the main method achieves 87.9% mean success over three training runs. In one paired comparison with matched observation exposure and training cost, its advantage over masking is 10.5%. On Ego-informed RoboTwin gaps, success is 45.4%, versus 40.3% for masking. On five real-robot tasks, mean success is 59.6%, versus 54.8% for interval flow matching alone and 48.8% for masking.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO上用20%示范且70.5%缺失动作时，主方法在三次训练运行中平均成功率达87.9%；在匹配观察暴露和训练成本的配对比较中，比掩码方法高10.5%；在Ego-informed RoboTwin gaps上成功率为45.4%，掩码方法为40.3%；在五个真实机器人任务上平均成功率为59.6%，而区间流匹配为54.8%，掩码方法为48.8%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出区间运动监督方法，在动作标注存在大量缺失的情况下，利用缺失段端点的净平移和旋转信息训练VLA策略，并通过组合目标约束缺失动作的聚合运动。
analysis.method: 在保留可靠局部动作上标准流匹配的同时，使用组合目标约束缺失动作估计的聚合运动；当缺失区间超过策略视界时，组合多个固定窗口；共享区间分支从可靠端点学习并提供组合目标。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出利用动作监督中的可靠端点信息，通过组合约束训练视觉-语言-动作策略，以应对示范数据中大量缺失动作标注的问题。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的训练，解决机器人动作标注不完整的问题，对VLA及机器人操作学习具有核心价值；与具体世界模型（WAM）无直接关联。

papers.title: Learning from Incomplete Actions: Interval Motion Supervision for Vision-Language-Action Policies
papers.title_zh: 从缺失动作中学习：面向视觉-语言-动作策略的区间运动监督

papers.abstract: Reward models and LLM judges are routinely quantized to 4 bits so that scoring many candidates stays affordable, and the usual check is that benchmark accuracy barely moves. That check is close to blind. Across eight reward models from two families (0.6B-8B), three generative judges and four 4-bit quantizers, quantization rewrites 1.1-12.3% of pairwise preference decisions on RewardBench while aggregate accuracy moves by as little as 0.03 points (p = 1.00), because the errors it fixes and introduces cancel. Flips concentrate where the full-precision margin is small relative to the quantization noise scale sigma: a Gaussian approximation Phi(-|m|/sigma) describes the aggregate rate, over-predicting it in all 30 scalar settings and failing for generative judges, and occupancy of the resulting vulnerability window falls from 25% to 7% with model size, which is what makes small judges fragile. The churn stays within noise under benign best-of-16 and becomes clear under adversarial pressure for some quantizers (146:54 harmful:helpful flips on one family, reversing sign on another). Downstream it changes what ships: across six (model, quantizer) pairs from two families, 14.6-65.7% of problems get a different best-of-64 selection while only 2.6-9.6% get a different final answer, with selections changing 5-8x more often than answers in every pair, and the pair the benchmark calls identical (0.03 points, p = 1.00) still changes 34.5% of them. Benchmark churn ranks that downstream change (rho = 0.89); benchmark accuracy does not order it reliably. Held-out audits then locate the useful diagnostic in the margin rather than the Gaussian: every margin-based predictor orders flips identically (AUC 0.927), and on the level a directly measured churn rate wins in-distribution. As a routing signal it is matched by plain top-k. The contribution is the characterization, not the model.

analysis.key_results: 量化重写了1.1-12.3%的成对偏好决策，基准准确率仅变化0.03分；脆弱窗口占比从25%降至7%随模型规模增大；14.6-65.7%的问题在best-of-64下选择不同，2.6-9.6%的最终答案不同；benchmark churn与下游变化相关性为0.89，margin预测器AUC为0.927。
analysis.limitations: 高斯近似在所有30个标量设定中均高估了翻转率，且对生成式裁判失效；提出的诊断方法在分布内与简单top-k相当；作者声明贡献在于特性刻画而非新模型。
analysis.main_contribution: 刻画了量化奖励模型中的决策不稳定性，提出了“脆弱窗口”概念，并表明基于margin的预测器比基准准确率更能预测下游决策变化。
analysis.method: 对八个奖励模型（0.6B-8B）、三个生成式裁判和四种4比特量化器进行实验，通过RewardBench上的成对偏好决策、best-of-16/64选择以及高斯近似和margin分析来量化决策翻转。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文研究了4比特量化对奖励模型和LLM裁判的偏好决策稳定性的影响，发现量化会在基准准确率几乎不变的情况下引发大量决策翻转。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 无直接关系。本文专注于量化对奖励模型决策稳定性的影响，未涉及视觉-语言-动作模型或机器人世界模型，但其对量化引起的决策翻转的分析方法可能对高效部署VLA中的奖励模型或评估器有参考价值。

papers.title: The Vulnerability Window: Decision Instability in Quantized Reward Models
papers.title_zh: 脆弱窗口：量化奖励模型中的决策不稳定性

papers.abstract: Language-model agents using the Model Context Protocol (MCP) face three runtime verification gaps: (i) action fabrication, where post-tool prose narrates side effects that failed, timed out, or never ran; (ii) provenance collapse, where unverified model prose or web text enters durable memory alongside executed tool outputs; and (iii) syndicated echo amplification, where mirrored web pages satisfy multi-source corroboration from one origin. Existing MCP firewalls inspect wire calls before execution, while LLM-judge guardrails require multi-gigabyte VRAM without binding prose to receipts. We present epistemic-guard (v0.5.2), an open-source Python library and out-of-process stdio MCP receipt proxy (15 modules, 0 MiB GPU VRAM). epistemic-guard isolates Ed25519 signing keys out of process, writes RFC 6962 Merkle logs with AER-1 receipt translation, checks post-turn prose on CPU with SHA-256-verified OpenVINO INT8 encoders (4 models, 279.48 MB total; 82.67 MB on the supervision path), gates SQLite writes across 7 provenance domains, and collapses verbatim and lightly edited wire-syndicated RAG mirrors. On conformance suites, epistemic-guard rejects 100.0% of tampered receipts (200 Merkle leaves), passes 58/58 official AER-1 ingestion vectors and 50/50 reference-verified AER-1 exports, verifies 100.0% of 40 fault-injected wire calls and 100 concurrent appends with 0 key leaks, and blocks 100.0% of 100 unauthorized memory writes. Across $N=250$ frozen-benchmark traces, epistemic-guard reaches 93.2% accuracy at 17.9 ms warm median CPU latency (8.62 ms single-clause; 921.8 ms cold-start load), beating 12B-14B GPU judges by 6.4-6.8 points ($p=0.0259$, $p=0.0095$) at 4.26-4.5$\times$ lower latency; on $N=60$ live mcp-proxy traces, it catches 96.15% of hazards at 76.67% accuracy (38.24% FPR; $+18.34$ points over Stage-1-only, $p=0.001$) in 9.16 ms p50.

analysis.key_results: 在一致性测试套件中，epistemic-guard拒收了100.0%的篡改收据（200个Merkle叶子），通过了58/58个官方AER-1摄取向量和50/50个参考验证的AER-1导出，验证了100.0%的40个故障注入的线调用和100个并发追加且零密钥泄漏，并阻止了100.0%的100次未授权内存写入。在N=250个冻结基准追踪中，达到了93.2%的准确率，CPU延迟中位数为17.9毫秒（单子句8.62毫秒；冷启动加载921.8毫秒），比12B-14B的GPU评判器高出6.4-6.8个百分点（p=0.0259，p=0.0095），且延迟降低4.26-4.5倍；在N=60个实时mcp-proxy追踪中，以96.15%的召回率和76.67%的准确率（38.24%的假阳性率；比仅阶段1高18.34个百分点，p=0.001）在9.16毫秒的p50延迟下捕获了危险。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了一个开源的Python库和进程外stdio MCP收据代理，用于解决语言模型代理在运行时验证中的三个缺口：行为捏造、来源坍缩和联合回声放大。
analysis.method: 采用Ed25519签名隔离、RFC 6962 Merkle日志、AER-1收据翻译、SHA-256验证的OpenVINO INT8编码器（4个模型，共279.48 MB；监督路径82.67 MB）、跨7个来源域的SQLite写入控制，以及缩减逐字和轻度编辑的联合RAG镜像。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出名为epistemic-guard的开源Python库和MCP收据代理，通过进程外签名、Merkle日志、CPU上的INT8编码器和来源控管内存写入，对使用工具的自主代理进行运行时验证。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文主要关注工具使用型语言模型代理的运行时验证，使用了量化技术（OpenVINO INT8编码器）来实现高效的CPU推理。它不直接涉及VLA、世界模型或机器人动作学习，但其量化方法和对代理安全验证的关注可能为机器人代理的可靠性提供方法学上的启发。

papers.title: Epistemic Guard: Out-of-Process MCP Receipt Proxying, Post-Turn Prose Supervision, and Provenance-Gated Memory for Tool-Using Autonomous Agents
papers.title_zh: 认知防护：为使用工具的自主代理提供进程外MCP收据代理、话轮后文本监督和来源控管记忆

papers.abstract: Low-bit activation quantization of large language models remains challenging, as a small number of dominant directions dictate the quantization range. State-of-the-art methods isolate these directions in a high-precision subspace through transformations calibrated offline and folded into the weights, which fixes the subspace for all prompts, leaving each prompt's few unique directions unprotected, and rules it out wherever no weight can absorb the transformation. We present PLoQ, a prompt-adaptive low-rank decomposition that extracts the dominant activation components before quantization, quantizes them separately, and restores them within the layer's GEMM, without modifying the weights. The low-rank component's basis is estimated from each prompt during prefill and reused throughout decoding. At the same bit width as state-of-the-art mixed-precision quantization (4-bit weights, activations and K/V cache with an eighth of the channels at 8 bits, about 4.2 bits per activation on average), PLoQ outperforms it on all six Llama and Qwen models from 1B to 70B parameters, at up to 8k tokens (16k on two of them), recovering up to 46% of the perplexity that the state of the art still loses to 4-bit activations. On Llama-3.1-8B at 8k tokens it adds only 4% to prefill and 8% to decoding.

analysis.key_results: 在与最先进混合精度量化相同的比特宽度下（4位权重、激活和KV缓存，其中1/8通道为8位，平均每激活约4.2位），PLoQ在6个Llama和Qwen模型（1B到70B参数，最长8k token，其中两个达16k）上均优于该基线，最多恢复46%的4位激活量化引起的困惑度损失。在Llama-3.1-8B上，8k token时预填充仅增加4%，解码增加8%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出PLoQ，一种提示自适应的低秩分解方法，在量化前提取激活值的主成分并单独量化，在层GEMM中恢复它们，而无需修改权重。
analysis.method: 在预填充阶段为每个提示估计低秩基，并在解码阶段复用；将主成分与量化后的残差分开处理，在GEMM中结合。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出PLoQ，在预填充阶段提取提示特定的激活值主成分作为低秩分量，并与量化后的残差一起进行GEMM计算，从而在4位量化中实现更低困惑度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文面向大语言模型的激活量化，没有讨论VLA、机器人世界模型或具身智能应用。其低秩分解和量化技术可能为VLA/WAM的高效推理提供启发，但摘要未直接涉及。

papers.abstract: Frontier multimodal language agents such as GPT-6 Astra have demonstrated strong capabilities in controlling robots directly via low-level numerical actions without high-level primitives. However, existing benchmarks report only episode-level success rates, which show neither how these agents succeed nor where they fail. In this paper, we present a systematic action-level analysis of frontier agents on direct robot control across 12 manipulation benchmarks. We introduce AgentRoboCritic, an intent-grounded critique framework in which the policy agent states a local intent alongside each action, and a critic evaluates the action's outcome and failure mode against this intent. Our action-level analysis demonstrates the promising capabilities of frontier agents on direct robot control, including closed-loop recovery from local execution failures, reliable semantic grounding across diverse scenes, and strong zero-shot manipulation without task-specific adaptation. It also identifies their current limitations, including task-relevant physical execution bottlenecks such as grasping and alignment, and uneven recovery across failure modes. Finally, we validate our critic on a 400-action human-annotated benchmark and release a dataset of 12,844 annotated actions alongside a fine-tuned open-source critic, Muse-Glimmer-30B, whose failure-mode accuracy rises from 32.58% to 74.24%, enabling low-cost action-level analysis.

analysis.key_results: 前沿智能体具备局部执行失败后的闭环恢复、跨场景语义对齐和零样本操纵能力；但存在抓取、对齐等物理执行瓶颈，且不同失败模式的恢复能力不均衡；Muse-Glimmer-30B失败模式准确率达74.24%。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入意图锚定的批判框架AgentRoboCritic，系统分析前沿智能体在直接机器人控制中的动作级表现，识别能力与局限，并发布12,844条标注动作数据集和微调模型Muse-Glimmer-30B，将失败模式识别准确率从32.58%提升至74.24%。
analysis.method: 策略智能体在输出每个动作时附带局部意图，批判器基于该意图评估动作结果与失败模式；在12个操纵基准上开展动作级分析，并使用400动作人工标注基准验证批判器。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出AgentRoboCritic框架，对前沿多模态语言智能体在直接机器人控制任务上的行为进行动作级分析和失败模式评估，并发布标注数据集与开源批判模型。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作聚焦前沿视觉-语言-动作（VLA）智能体在直接机器人控制中的细粒度评估，对理解VLA策略的失败模式和能力边界具有直接价值，可用于指导VLA模型改进和世界模型中的行为分析。

papers.abstract: Acquiring every feature of an instance is often costly: a measurement can carry a monetary price, a time delay, or a privacy cost. Active Feature Acquisition (AFA) addresses this by learning a policy that decides, per instance, which features to acquire under a budget. Existing AFA methods train this policy by optimizing a self-constructed utility target rather than distilling an explicit teacher. We construct this teacher explicitly. At training time the label and the unobserved feature values are available, and together they determine the teacher in closed form: an oracle that ranks every candidate by its effect on the downstream predictor's error. OracleImitator distills this ranking into a deployable policy by soft-target imitation. Across multimodal medical diagnosis and the AFABench benchmark, OracleImitator matches or outperforms existing AFA methods across the budget range, recovering 90% of the attainable accuracy gain at under a quarter of the acquisition cost. Because the teacher is an explicit algorithmic object rather than an implicit optimization target, we can also measure directly how much of its ranking is recoverable by a policy restricted to what is visible at deployment.

analysis.key_results: 在多模态医学诊断和 AFABench 基准上匹配或优于现有主动特征获取方法，以不到四分之一的获取成本恢复了 90% 的可实现准确率增益。
analysis.main_contribution: 构建显式的 Oracle 教师，并通过软目标模仿将其蒸馏为可部署的策略。
analysis.method: 在训练时利用标签和未观察的特征值，通过闭式解构造一个对候选特征按对下游预测器误差影响排序的 Oracle，然后使用软目标模仿训练部署策略。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出 OracleImitator，通过蒸馏一个明确的 Oracle 教师来学习主动特征获取策略。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文主题为主动特征获取，与 VLA/WAM 无直接关系。但其知识蒸馏方法可作为策略压缩的一种思路，可能对 VLA 等大模型的高效推理具有方法论价值。

papers.abstract: Robotic vision-language-action (VLA) models can execute diverse individual manipulation skills, yet they still struggle with long-horizon loco-manipulation tasks, where temporal structure, skills, and precision are tightly coupled within a monolithic model. We propose Physically Grounded Execution (PGX), a framework that offloads temporal and precision control to two classical training-free components, allowing the VLA to focus on stage-specific skill dynamics. PGX decomposes long-horizon loco-manipulation into three layers: (i) a predicate-based state machine governs task progression, using physical predicates to gate phase transitions, trigger recovery, and coordinate navigation and waiting. Shared predicate semantics connect offline demonstration segmentation, online execution, and stage-wise evaluation; (ii) VLA skills operate within active manipulation phases, with flat or stage-trained models concentrating on task-relevant actions; and (iii) world-coordinate locking (WCL) maintains spatial consistency through base station keeping, object-relative positioning, and world-anchored contact targets. We demonstrate the effectiveness of PGX with extensive experiments conducted on three simulated tasks and one real-world task using a Unitree G1 humanoid robot for long-horizon loco-manipulation, showing improvements in stage progression and task success rates. Project page is available at: https://kl-research.github.io/pgx

analysis.key_results: 在三个仿真任务和一个使用 Unitree G1 人形机器人的真实任务上进行了广泛实验，显示阶段进展和任务成功率有所提升。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出物理接地执行（PGX）框架，将长时序移动操作任务分解为基于谓词的状态机、VLA 技能和世界坐标锁定三层，从而提升任务成功率和阶段进展。
analysis.method: PGX 框架：谓词状态机管理任务进展并触发恢复；VLA 技能在主动操作阶段执行；世界坐标锁定通过基座保持、物体相对定位和世界锚定接触目标维持空间一致性。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: PGX 通过将时间与精度控制卸载给两个经典免训练组件，使 VLA 专注于阶段特定技能动态，从而提升长时序人形机器人移动操作任务的性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接针对 VLA 模型在长时序人形机器人移动操作中的不足，通过外部物理接地组件增强 VLA 的时序与精度控制，属于 VLA 在机器人操作中的直接应用与改进。

papers.abstract: Reliable reasoning for long-horizon embodied tasks requires predictions grounded in the observed execution state. We present ACE-Brain-0.7, a 9B vision--language model that combines spatial grounding, task understanding, and progress estimation. To train the model, we curate 3.7 million question--answer pairs, drawing execution supervision from egocentric human videos, robot episodes, and simulation. These questions span different stages of an execution and connect task-level judgments with observed progress and outcomes. We then fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B on this collection together with additional task, spatial-grounding, and progress-estimation data. Across six public task-reasoning benchmarks, ACE-Brain-0.7 achieves an average score of 76.5, ahead of GPT-6 Astra at 72.7 and Claude Opus 5.5 at 73.5. Our model also leads the evaluated models in spatial grounding, averaging 75.90 across seven benchmarks and reaching 91.25 Acc@0.5 on RefCOCOg. Controlled evaluations further indicate that our task-only model makes more effective use of visual history and more accurately distinguishes execution states. Together, these results show that ACE-Brain-0.7 effectively combines spatial perception with temporal understanding, delivering strong execution-grounded reasoning and comparing favorably with closed-source models.

analysis.key_results: 在六个公共任务推理基准上平均得分 76.5，超过 GPT-6 Astra (72.7) 和 Claude Opus 5.5 (73.5)；在七个空间定位基准上平均得分 75.90，并在 RefCOCOg 上达到 91.25 Acc@0.5；控制评估表明任务模型更有效地利用视觉历史并更准确地区分执行状态。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 ACE-Brain-0.7，一个 9B 视觉语言模型，将空间定位、任务理解和进度估计相结合，用于长程具身任务的执行基础推理，并在多个基准上取得领先性能。
analysis.method: 利用来自第一人称人类视频、机器人片段和仿真的 370 万问答对，对 Qwen3.5-9B 进行微调，融合任务、空间定位和进度估计数据。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: ACE-Brain-0.7 是一个 9B 视觉语言模型，通过结合空间定位、任务理解和进度估计，对长程具身任务进行可靠的执行基础推理。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作是 VLA 领域的核心研究，专注于具身智能体的执行基础推理模型，结合视觉、语言、空间定位与进度估计，直接服务于机器人长程任务，与本站主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Real-time task guidance is inherently flexible: when an agent guides a user through a task, multiple responses and timings can be appropriate, and sometimes the best action is to remain silent. Existing benchmarks often miss this flexibility by treating synthesized dialogues as fixed targets for what to say and when to say it. We introduce FLUID (Flexible, Evidence-Grounded Situated Task Guidance), a unified framework for modeling, evaluating, and enabling flexible interaction in multimodal task guidance. Using naturally occurring human-human guidance from WTaG and HoloAssist, FLUID grounds interventions in their supporting evidence, necessity, and timing flexibility, and uses this representation both to evaluate flexible guidance and to build a real-time agent for task guidance. Our agent achieves the strongest overall balance of response correctness, intervention precision, timely guidance, and response latency among evaluated systems, while still leaving room for improvement in avoiding speech overlap. Together, FLUID moves situated task guidance beyond rigid reference matching toward more natural and adaptive human-AI interaction. Project page: https://fluid-guidance.github.io.

analysis.key_results: 该智能体在评估系统中实现了响应正确性、干预精确性、及时引导和响应延迟之间的最佳整体平衡，但在避免语音重叠方面仍有改进空间。
analysis.limitations: 在避免语音重叠方面仍有改进空间。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了 FLUID 框架，将情境任务引导从固定的参考匹配转向更自然、自适应的交互，并构建了一个实时的任务引导智能体。
analysis.method: 利用 WTaG 和 HoloAssist 中的人类-人类引导数据，将干预措施基于其支持证据、必要性和时间灵活性进行建模，并使用该表示来评估灵活引导和构建实时智能体。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: FLUID 是一个统一的框架，用于建模、评估和实现多模态情境任务引导中的灵活交互，通过利用人类-人类引导数据并基于证据、必要性和时间灵活性来构建实时引导智能体。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 尽管该论文涉及机器人学习中的视觉-语言交互和机器人操作，但其主要焦点是任务引导而非视觉-语言-动作模型或世界模型，因此与本站主题的直接关联有限。

papers.abstract: Pretrained language models (LMs) remain unreliable on exact multi-digit arithmetic without gradient fine-tuning or external tool interpreters. We introduce closed-form, zero-gradient circuit-grafting primitives that compile deterministic computation directly into pretrained LM weights using zero training examples and zero runtime hooks, while bounding per-layer normalization drift and preserving natural-language (NL) competence. Our construction combines three analytical mechanisms: (1) two-layer Mellin-GLU quadrature over bias-free SwiGLU/GeGLU layers, turning unknown per-token RMSNorm scaling into translation along a log-spaced gate grid ($>250\times$ dynamic range) with IEEE 754 error bounds; (2) cross-token scale cancellation via signed Chebyshev Indefinite-RoPE self-sink attention and memoryless SiLU-antisymmetric GatedDeltaNet shifts; and (3) axis-aligned width extension ($d \to d+K$) with $\sqrt{d/(d+K)}$ norm compensation, Base-1000 canonical BPE emission, and differential $(+254,-256)$ tied unembeddings. An automated 5-stage compiler synthesizes 4-8 digit signed $\{+,-,\times\}$ circuits in constant $\mathsf{TC}^0$ depth alongside 3-literal Boolean (100%, $N=1{,}728$; plus 42-layer Gemma 4 E4B audits) and 5-bit Majority/Parity (100%) circuits. On 6-digit arithmetic ($N=1{,}200$, BF16), IBM Granite 4.2 3B (1.07M-1.33M active non-zeros, $\le 0.036\%$) and Alibaba Qwen 3.5 4B (2.25M-2.39M non-zeros, $\le 0.057\%$) reach 99.17% and 100.00% ALU-prefix accuracy (100% with an FP32 sidecar) and 98%-100% mid-sentence resumption, outperforming 12.8K-sample LoRA (42.2% / 61.7%, 0% inline continuation). A factorized block-sparse sidecar holds A100 memory at 7.89 / 10.65 GiB (4.60 / 8.14 GiB under INT8/INT4 + FP32 sidecar) while passing all 14/14 pre-registered $>2$K-token Tango splits ($N=4{,}392$; 0/11,134 OOD triggers).

analysis.key_results: 在6位算术上，Granite 3B和Qwen 4B分别达99.17%和100%的ALU前缀准确率；电路稀疏度极低（≤0.057%）；块稀疏sidecar显存占用7.89/10.65 GiB，INT8/INT4下4.60/8.14 GiB；14/14 Tango分片通过，无OOD触发。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入闭式、零梯度的电路移植原语，把确定性计算编译进预训练LM权重，实现多位数算术与布尔电路的高精度执行，同时保持自然语言能力。
analysis.method: 结合三层分析机制：基于Mellin-GLU的两层正交积分、跨token符号消除注意力/状态机、以及带范数补偿的宽度扩展，配合自动化5阶段编译器生成TC^0深度电路。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出零梯度电路移植原语，将确定性算术与布尔电路直接写入预训练语言模型权重，无需微调或运行时钩子。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 无直接关系。论文聚焦于预训练语言模型的确定性电路编译与高效推理，未涉及VLA、世界行动模型或机器人策略。

papers.abstract: Embodied intelligence aims to let robots perform complex physical tasks with human-like adaptability and reliability, which requires three complementary capabilities: history-based cognitive reasoning, precise and timely physical execution, and the composition of reasoning and execution through environmental feedback. Yet existing benchmarks either evaluate reasoning and execution within the same tasks or assess them separately without their composition, so they reveal little about whether a failure comes from reasoning, execution, or their composition. We introduce Mind2Act World, a diagnostic benchmark of 30 simulated manipulation tasks from five real-world application domains. Each task has three difficulty levels and two scene settings (Clean and Random), yielding 180 configurations. The tasks form three views: Mind tests decisions based on past observations, Act tests precise and timely execution, and Mind2Act combines both in closed-loop tasks where action outcomes guide later decisions. Comparing the three views shows whether a system lacks a capability or fails to compose capabilities it already has. A diagnosis harness further attributes the failed episodes of three representative systems to Mind, Act, or their composition and summarizes each system in a profile card. Our evaluation of multimodal agents, vision-language-action models (VLAs), and world-action models (WAMs) shows that competence in a single view does not carry over to Mind2Act tasks. Even the strongest agent succeeds in 52.7% of Mind and 39.0% of Act episodes but in only 12.0% of Mind2Act episodes. The strongest agent retains task state but struggles with sustained contact, whereas end-to-end policies execute practiced motions but retain little task state. These findings point to composing reasoning and execution through environmental feedback as the main open problem.

analysis.key_results: 最强智能体在Mind视图成功率为52.7%，Act视图为39.0%，但Mind2Act视图仅为12.0%；最强智能体能保持任务状态但难以持续接触，而端到端策略能执行熟练动作但状态保持差。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了Mind2Act World基准，包含30个模拟操作任务（来自五个真实应用领域、三个难度级别、两种场景设置），以三个视图（Mind、Act、Mind2Act）诊断系统在推理、执行及其组合上的能力，并提供诊断工具将失败归因于Mind、Act或组合。
analysis.method: 构建了包含180种配置的模拟操作任务基准，通过对比三个视图的表现来诊断能力缺陷，并使用诊断工具分析三个代表性系统（多模态智能体、VLA、WAM）的失败原因。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一个诊断性基准Mind2Act World，用于评估机器人操作中基于历史的心智推理、精确及时的动作执行以及通过环境反馈将两者组合的能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该基准直接评估并诊断了VLA（视觉-语言-动作模型）和WAM（世界-动作模型）在机器人操作中的表现，揭示了单一视图能力不直接转化为组合任务能力，与本站主题VLA和WAM高度相关。

papers.abstract: Retrieval-augmented vision-language-action (VLA) models enable efficient test-time adaptation by leveraging expert demonstrations as additional context without updating model parameters. However, even when retrieved demonstrations are relevant to the current task, the VLA may fail to effectively utilize the retrieved information, ultimately leading to task failure. To address this challenge, we propose R2-VLA, a risk-controlled retrieval-augmented VLA framework that enables reliable test-time adaptation by satisfying a user-specified task success rate requirement with minimal expert assistance. Specifically, R2-VLA learns an uncertainty predictor that estimates the uncertainty of the VLA's predicted actions given the retrieved demonstrations, guiding when to act autonomously or request expert assistance. We further introduce a task-level risk-control procedure that calibrates the uncertainty threshold to satisfy a user-specified task-failure risk requirement. Moreover, R2-VLA continually incorporates expert corrections into its retrieval memory to improve future adaptation while preserving the prescribed task-level risk guarantee. Experiments across three VLA backbones and four LIBERO benchmark suites demonstrate that R2-VLA improves average task success by 9.2--11.2 percentage points, achieving the desired target with fewer expert requests. These results highlight the effectiveness of connecting the usefulness of retrieved demonstrations with task-level risk control to enable successful robotic manipulation.

analysis.key_results: 在三种VLA骨干和四个LIBERO基准套件上，R2-VLA将平均任务成功率提高9.2–11.2个百分点，同时以更少的专家请求达到目标成功率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出R2-VLA框架，在检索增强VLA中引入不确定性预测器和任务级风险控制程序，在无需更新模型参数的前提下实现满足用户指定任务成功率要求的最小专家辅助测试时自适应。
analysis.method: 学习不确定性预测器估计给定检索演示时VLA预测动作的不确定性，引导自主执行或请求专家辅助；引入任务级风险控制程序校准不确定性阈值以满足用户指定的任务失败风险要求；持续将专家修正纳入检索记忆以改进未来自适应。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出R2-VLA框架，通过风险控制检索增强实现视觉-语言-动作模型的可靠测试时自适应，在满足任务失败风险要求的条件下减少专家干预。

papers.abstract: Long-term agents accumulate large external memory stores as interactions unfold, increasing the costs of storage, retrieval, and response generation. Efficiency is constrained by two coupled factors: a growing record count increases retrieval overhead, while longer retrieved contexts increase prefill computation and decoding-time attention costs. Existing methods prune or consolidate records, but pruning can discard useful evidence, whereas consolidation may produce fewer yet longer retrieval units. We introduce MemFolder, a structure-guided memory folding framework that sequentially reduces record count and context length. The framework comprises two core components that share memory groups, using cross-record structure to guide both evidence consolidation and compact representation. RecordFolder grounds entity mentions, progressively selects representative yet complementary anchors, and combines semantic and entity affinity with temporal chaining to consolidate compatible records into fewer retrieval units. ContextFolder encodes the original records within these groups into compact text and uses verification feedback to revise encodings when key facts cannot be recovered. Experiments on the three text-based memory benchmarks LoCoMo, PersonaMem, and LongMemEval and the two multimodal benchmarks M3-Bench-web and M3-Bench-robot demonstrate the strong performance of our methods. Notably, on Mem0, RecordFolder retains 99.0% of the original average performance across the three text-based benchmarks with 50% fewer records, exceeding the strongest baseline by 1.9 percentage points in performance retention. Combined with ContextFolder, existing record compression methods further shorten their output records while retaining most of their performance.

analysis.key_results: 在LoCoMo、PersonaMem和LongMemEval三个文本基准上，RecordFolder减少50%记录时保留99.0%的平均性能，比最强基线高1.9个百分点；结合ContextFolder可进一步缩短输出记录长度并保留大部分性能。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出MemFolder结构引导记忆折叠框架，通过RecordFolder和ContextFolder协同减少记录数与上下文长度，在多个文本和多模态记忆基准上以更少存储开销保持性能。
analysis.method: RecordFolder基于实体提及和语义/实体亲和性及时间链选择代表性锚点以合并记录；ContextFolder将原始记录编码为紧凑文本，并通过验证反馈修正编码以确保关键事实可恢复。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: MemFolder通过结构引导的记忆折叠顺序减少记录数量和上下文长度，在文本和多模态记忆基准上保持性能的同时提升智能体记忆效率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作专注于智能体记忆管理的高效压缩，通过减少检索开销和上下文长度提升推理效率，与VLA或WAM无直接关系，但其高效记忆折叠技术可能对机器人世界模型中的外部记忆管理具有潜在的方法借鉴价值。

(2) Existing methods target one axis, while MemFolder combines RecordFolder and ContextFolder to reduce both. (b) ContextFolder compresses each group’s source records to a target token-retention ratio using a planner that prioritizes facts and prepares checks, a compressor that generates grammar-based candidates, and a blind verifier that tests recovery over up to three rounds. papers.abstract: A central goal of humanoid robotics is for robots to perform the everyday work people do in homes and workplaces. Existing egocentric video datasets cover many of these activities but provide little synchronized whole-body motion data for learning loco-manipulation at scale. We build Awaken-Human, which pairs approximately 50,000 hours of egocentric stereo video with synchronized whole-body human motion and covers more than 100 skills. Building on this, we also introduce Awaken-HI (Humanoid Intelligence), a vision-language-action model for humanoid loco-manipulation that jointly predicts original human motion and retargeted robot actions through a shared action expert. We show that loco-manipulation skills transfer more effectively from people to humanoids when human trajectories directly supervise the shared action expert. Increasing human pretraining data reduces held-out robot action prediction error according to an empirical scaling law and raises the mean success rate on downstream real-robot tasks. After full-corpus pretraining and T800 adaptation, Awaken-HI achieves a mean success rate of 93.75% across eight individual tasks and outperforms GR00T N1.7 and $\pi_{0.5}$ in both individual and long-horizon evaluations. The same policy generalizes to objects unseen during robot post-training and to new pairings of familiar objects and destinations.

analysis.key_results: 经过全语料库预训练和T800适应后，Awaken-HI在八项任务上平均成功率达到93.75%，在单项和长程评估中均优于GR00T N1.7和π0.5，并能泛化到机器人后训练未见过的物体和新配对。
analysis.main_contribution: 构建了约5万小时的同步全身人体运动数据集Awaken-Human，并在此基础上提出了Awaken-HI视觉-语言-动作模型，通过共享动作专家联合预测人体运动和重定向的机器人动作，显著提升了人形机器人的移动操作技能迁移。
analysis.method: 利用约5万小时自我中心立体视频与同步全身人体运动数据，通过共享动作专家联合训练视觉-语言-动作模型，同时预测原始人体运动和重定向的机器人动作。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文构建了一个大规模同步全身人体运动与自我中心立体视频数据集，并提出了一个联合预测人体运动和机器人动作的视觉-语言-动作模型，用于人形机器人的移动操作。

papers.abstract: Representative vision-language navigation (VLN) methods typically couple a vision-language model (VLM) brain with a learnable action head and fine-tune the VLM brain on navigation-domain data to predict geometric goals. However, such adaptation can substantially alter base VLM weights and degrade general visual capabilities. We introduce ZeroVLN, a slow-fast navigation framework that achieves effective navigation with zero navigation-domain SFT of the VLM brain. Rather than teaching the brain to predict geometric goals, we equip it with a semantic tool-calling interface for conveying movement decisions to an action expert in natural language. We first adapt the action expert to carry out these movement requests, then jointly improve the brain's movement decisions and the action expert's continuous execution through closed-loop reinforcement learning (RL). Trained on the same navigation episodes, ZeroVLN substantially outperforms representative SFT-based hierarchical VLN methods on standard VLN-CE (continuous environments) benchmarks, while inducing only minor changes to the brain's weights and largely preserving its general capabilities. To our knowledge, ZeroVLN is the first slow-fast VLN framework with zero navigation-domain SFT of the VLM brain, and the first to jointly optimize its slow and fast policies through closed-loop agentic RL in VLN-CE.

analysis.key_results: 在标准VLN-CE基准上大幅超越代表性SFT分层VLN方法，同时仅对大脑权重产生轻微改变，基本保留其通用能力。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出ZeroVLN框架，实现了零导航领域SFT的VLM大脑导航，并首次在VLN-CE中通过闭环智能体强化学习联合优化慢策略与快策略。
analysis.method: 采用慢-快导航架构，赋予VLM语义工具调用接口，将移动决策以自然语言传递给动作专家；先适配动作专家执行移动请求，再通过闭环强化学习联合改进大脑决策与动作专家执行。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: ZeroVLN提出慢-快导航框架，在不进行导航领域SFT的情况下，通过语义工具调用和闭环强化学习实现视觉语言导航。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作聚焦视觉语言导航，使用VLM作为策略核心并通过强化学习训练，与VLA（视觉-语言-动作）模型密切相关，但其目标是导航任务而非机器人操作与世界模型，对WAM无直接关联。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have recently been equipped with tactile sensing to perceive visually subtle contact events in contact-rich manipulation. However, adding tactile input yields inconsistent gains, and some visuo-tactile VLA models rely little on tactile input, because much of the tactile change, such as the gel deformation during gripper closure, is predictable from visual observations and executed actions. To address this problem, we introduce TacInno, which isolates the contact dynamics that vision and executed actions cannot explain, termed tactile innovation, and uses tactile innovation only as a training target. Specifically, the TacInno tokenizer, conditioned on visual observations and executed actions, compresses the future tactile change into a discrete code, and the policy, TacInno-VLA, learns to predict the code, adding no module for the code at deployment. TacInno-VLA achieves average success rates of 87.5% across six simulation tasks and 70.5% across four real-world tasks, outperforming the strongest visuo-tactile baseline by 10.7 and 9.0 percentage points, respectively. Ablation studies validate the contributions of visual and action conditioning, multi-frame encoding, and auxiliary code prediction. Together, these results demonstrate the effectiveness of tactile innovation as a supervision signal for contact-rich manipulation.

analysis.key_results: 在六个仿真任务上平均成功率87.5%，四个真实世界任务上70.5%，分别比最强视觉-触觉基线高出10.7和9.0个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出TacInno框架，将触觉创新（tactile innovation）作为监督信号用于训练VLA模型，从而改善接触丰富操作任务的性能。
analysis.method: TacInno tokenizer基于视觉观察和执行动作压缩未来触觉变化为离散码，策略TacInno-VLA学习预测该离散码，部署时无需额外模块。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: TacInno通过提取并预测视觉和执行动作无法解释的触觉创新信号，提升VLA模型在接触丰富操作中的表现。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接针对VLA模型在接触丰富操作中的应用，通过触觉创新信号增强动作预测能力，与本站VLA主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Egocentric video captioning requires fine-grained detail and accurate timing, yet current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often miss brief actions, confuse their order, or misinterpret the wearer's motion. Existing caption formats also offer limited support for combining detailed narration with precise timing. We present EgoCaptioner, which pairs a video-level overview of the setting, participants, and the wearer's overall activity with timed steps whose narration adapts to varying perceptual demands and marks key moments at specific timestamps. We develop a coarse-to-fine annotation pipeline that establishes event structure before expanding step descriptions, yielding 50,000 training examples from eight egocentric video sources. Complementary rewards assess factual accuracy and coverage, measure step-level temporal alignment, and penalize fragmented or redundant narration, guiding caption refinement through Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). To improve the reliability of factual supervision, we supplement caption references with pose-derived motion facts when sensor data are available. Across five egocentric benchmarks, EgoCaptioner achieves leading performance among evaluated open-source models in caption quality, caption-conditioned question answering, and temporal alignment. It also surpasses Gemini 3.1 Pro on PhysCapBench and all evaluated proprietary baselines on Minerva-Ego under the caption-to-QA protocol. Ablations support the complementary roles of factual and temporal rewards and show that coarse-to-fine annotation provides more effective supervision than single-pass annotation.

analysis.key_results: 在五个自我中心基准上，在字幕质量、字幕条件问答和时间对齐方面领先开源模型；在PhysCapBench上超过Gemini 3.1 Pro，在Minerva-Ego的字幕到问答协议下超过所有专有基线；消融实验验证了事实和时间奖励的互补作用以及粗细结合标注的有效性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出EgoCaptioner方法，结合粗细结合标注流程与基于GRPO的奖励优化，生成全面细粒度、时间对齐的自我中心视频字幕。
analysis.method: 粗细结合标注流程，结合视频级概述与带时间戳的步骤级叙述；使用事实准确性、时间对齐、覆盖和流畅性奖励通过GRPO进行优化；在传感器数据可用时，利用姿态派生的运动事实增强事实监督。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种自我中心视频字幕生成方法，通过粗细结合的标注流程和奖励引导优化，提升字幕的细节与时间对齐能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作专注于自我中心视频字幕生成，其细粒度时间对齐的叙述和动作理解对于机器人学习中的动作预测和世界建模具有潜在价值，但未直接涉及VLA或WAM。

papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) demonstrate broad generalization across tasks and domains. However, comparable generalization in robot manipulation remains challenging. Heterogeneity in robot embodiments, task formulations, geometric conventions, and action interfaces fragments interaction experience across benchmarks and hardware. We rethink robot skill learning through alignment: Can heterogeneous interactions across benchmarks and embodiments jointly improve one shared skillset for robot manipulation? We propose UniCraft, a framework for learning robot manipulation skills by aligning heterogeneous settings. Specifically, UniCraft represents observed scene geometry using consistent coordinate conventions and aligns sensing and control interfaces across robots. It organizes tasks from different benchmarks in a canonical format, allowing interaction feedback to jointly refine shared skills and the orchestration policy that guides their selection and composition, without any demonstrations or model weight updates. We interleave tasks from 3 benchmarks and 6 embodiments, collecting 2,700 learning rollouts per agent model. During training, UniCraft improves pooled task success on unseen scenarios and tasks by 9-28 percentage points on LIBERO-PRO, 10.8-13.3 on RoboTwin 2.0, and 3.1-14.4 on RoboCasa365 (Epochs 1-3). After training, with the learned skills frozen, UniCraft demonstrates zero-shot transfer across 4 new robot embodiments and 5 additional agent models on robosuite and RoboDojo.

analysis.main_contribution: 提出UniCraft框架，通过对齐异构设置（几何坐标、传感与控制接口、任务格式）来学习可复用的机器人操作技能，并支持跨基准和实施例的联合提升。

analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出UniCraft框架，通过对齐异构机器人设置、统一坐标与接口、规范化任务表示，无需示范或权重更新即可跨基准与实施例提升机器人操作技能。

papers.abstract: Beam is a sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) model with 501.3B total parameters and 23.4B active parameters, specifically built and optimized for coding, reasoning, and agentic workloads. Beam delivers frontier level reasoning, while requiring 3-4x less inference compute than many models of its class. Pretrained on 23.8T diverse, curated, high-quality tokens, Beam features a 1M-token context window achieved through a novel two-stage midtraining phase, built on verifiable, correctness-anchored data. Post-training leveraged a large-scale, fully asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL) campaign across 10.5K GB300 GPUs, generating over 100M rollouts over 4 weeks of training. We believe this is one of the largest scale RL runs conducted by any open lab to date. Across our evaluation suite, capabilities continued to improve as we increased RL compute, with no sign of a plateau. Supported by deep hardware-model co-design, FP8/NVFP4 quantization, and a 1.93B-parameter speculative decoding drafter (DFlash 2), Beam maximizes serving throughput with efficient, flexible deployment. Averaged across conversation turns and harm categories, Beam refuses or pivots on 88.9% of harmful requests while complying with 81.5% of harmless requests, achieving the highest refusal/pivot rate on harmful requests among open-weight models on the Pareto frontier.

analysis.key_results: Beam在推理计算上比同类模型少3-4倍；在有害请求上拒绝或转向88.9%，无害请求合规81.5%；RL计算增加时能力持续提升，未见平台期。
analysis.main_contribution: 构建并优化了501.3B参数的稀疏MoE模型Beam，用于编码、推理和智能体工作负载，并集成推测解码和量化以实现高效推理。
analysis.method: 使用23.8T令牌预训练、两阶段中训练拓展1M上下文、异步强化学习后训练，辅以FP8/NVFP4量化和1.93B参数的推测解码草稿模型DFlash 2。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: Beam是一个稀疏混合专家模型，通过推测解码和量化等效率优化，在推理、编码和智能体任务上实现前沿性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文未涉及视觉-语言-动作（VLA）或世界-动作模型（WAM），但其推测解码和量化技术可迁移至机器人策略模型的高效推理，与本站关注的高效推理主题间接相关。

papers.abstract: Large multimodal models can support long-horizon robot manipulation, but frequent model calls incur substantial latency and token costs. The central challenge is determining when agent assistance or intervention is needed and whether errors require correcting robot execution, subtask planning, or both. To address this problem, we propose RoC (Reasoning on Call), an efficient framework that coordinates a low-level policy and a high-level reasoning agent through an online task-state monitor. The monitor combines temporal visual observations with ordered interaction memory to jointly estimate progress within the active subtask and predict its successor. These predictions guide event-triggered agent review for coordinated execution repair and plan revision. Verified outcomes govern memory updates and subtask transitions, allowing routine execution to remain with the policy while reasoning focuses on decisions requiring additional assessment. On RMBench, RoC improves task success rate by 24.0 percentage points and reduces token consumption by 65.3% compared with the strongest agent-based baseline. It also outperforms the strongest policy-based baseline by 15.1 percentage points in task success rate. Real-world experiments further validate its effectiveness across three long-horizon manipulation tasks. Overall, RoC supports efficient agent intervention and coordinated recovery across execution and planning for long-horizon robot manipulation.

analysis.key_results: 在RMBench上，相比最强智能体基线，任务成功率提升24.0个百分点，token消耗降低65.3%；相比最强策略基线，成功率提升15.1个百分点；在三个长时程操作任务的真实机器人实验中有效性得到验证。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出RoC（Reasoning on Call）框架，结合时序视觉观察与交互记忆，在线估计子任务进度并预测下一步子任务，实现事件触发的智能体审查与协同修正，显著提高任务成功率并大幅减少token成本。
analysis.method: 低层策略与高层推理智能体通过在线任务状态监控器协同；监控器联合时序视觉观察与有序交互记忆，预测活动子任务进度和后续子任务，触发智能体参与执行修复与计划修订；验证结果控制记忆更新与子任务切换。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出RoC框架，通过在线任务状态监控协调低层策略与高层推理智能体，在需要时触发智能体干预，以提升长时程机器人操作的成功率并降低token消耗。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作面向长时程机器人操作，通过低层策略与高层视觉-语言推理的协同提升任务执行效率与可靠性，与机器人操作、视觉-语言模型和高效推理密切相关，对VLA/WAM在长时程操控中的实际应用具有参考价值。

papers.abstract: A one-pass decision encoder reads a text, a question and several named options, and returns a probability for each option in a single forward pass. We ask how far Laya, a 421M-parameter encoder of this kind, can be compressed before its decisions change. We count decisions that differ from Laya's own full-precision (fp32) answer, and track calibration (how well confidence matches accuracy, measured by expected calibration error, ECE), on 1,221 synthetic items with the training schemas, 273 with an unseen schema, and 800 out-of-family questions from ARC, MMLU and HellaSwag. Layer pruning of a related model family is known; we add flips, calibration, held-out data and retraining. bf16 changes 0.2% of in-family decisions but 2.2% out of family; 6-bit grouped rounding 1.3% and 5.9%; deleting 6 layers 0.9% and 9.1%, while ECE rises from 5.9% to 39.2%. One fitted temperature, needing no labels, restores it to 3.6%. One scale per tensor fails below six bits, and CPU dynamic int8 changes 30% of decisions, nearly all through one layer. Total variation tracks flips for rounding but not for deletion, and an early exit saves layers over a static cut only if its confidence gate is first recalibrated. Distilling a 16-layer student cuts its in-family flips from 44% to 9% (45% out of family). At equal stored size, rounding flips fewer decisions than deletion. Data are synthetic and LLM-labelled, for one architecture.

analysis.key_results: bf16改变0.2%的同族决策但2.2%非同族；6位分组舍入为1.3%和5.9%；删除6层为0.9%和9.1%，ECE从5.9%升到39.2%；一次拟合温度恢复为3.6%；每个张量一个尺度在低于6位失败；CPU动态int8改变30%的决策，几乎全部通过一层；总变差跟踪舍入的翻转但不跟踪删除；早退仅在重新校准置信门后节省层；蒸馏16层学生将同族翻转从44%削减到9%（非同族45%）；在相同存储大小下，舍入翻转的决策少于删除。
analysis.limitations: 数据是合成的且由LLM标注，仅针对一种架构。
analysis.main_contribution: 测量并比较了多种压缩策略（bf16、6位分组舍入、层剪枝、蒸馏、早退等）对决策变化和校准的影响，并发现温度校准可恢复剪枝后的校准。
analysis.method: 使用带有训练模式、未见模式以及ARC、MMLU、HellaSwag的非同族问题合成数据，统计与fp32基准相比决策不同的数量，并跟踪ECE。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 研究一个421M参数的一次性决策编码器在压缩（量化、剪枝、蒸馏、早退）后决策变化的情况。

papers.abstract: Video diffusion transformers reuse key--value (KV) caches across denoising steps, which quickly becomes a bottleneck for long video generation. We find that quantizing temporally distant cache vectors leads to a large range and high quantization error, but that nearby video tokens in the KV-cache share a persistent pattern per channel. These patterns also vary across videos, motivating rotations that are adapted to each video's unique cache. We propose Temporal Rotation Quantization (TRQ), a method that rotates frames in the cache that are adjacent in time before quantization. For each block of temporally adjacent cache vectors, TRQ fits an orthogonal transform that maps the block's per-channel means to a vector that is close to a constant across channels. To keep the quantization format lightweight, we parameterize this rotation as a tree of $2 \times 2$ planar rotations, each stored with only two bits, followed by a fixed Hadamard transform shared across all blocks. The rotations are fit without gradients or changes to model weights, and we prove that a simple greedy fit is globally optimal for our 'mean-flattening' objective. The transforms are fit online for each new video, and we release fused Triton kernels to make this process efficient at inference. At 2-bit precision and matched compression, TRQ improves VBench subject consistency over the state-of-the-art method QVG from 90.38 to 92.02 on LongCat-Video-13B and from 86.33 to 87.61 on HY-WorldPlay-8B, as well as improving other metrics.

analysis.key_results: 在2比特精度下，TRQ在LongCat-Video-13B上将VBench主体一致性从90.38提升至92.02，在HY-WorldPlay-8B上从86.33提升至87.61，并改善其他指标。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Temporal Rotation Quantization (TRQ)，一种无需梯度或修改模型权重的在线时域旋转量化方法，用于降低视频扩散Transformer中KV缓存的量化误差。
analysis.method: 对时域相邻的KV缓存块拟合正交旋转（参数化为2×2平面旋转树加Hadamard变换），使每通道均值接近常数（mean-flattening），然后进行2比特量化；旋转在线拟合，并使用Fused Triton内核加速。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出TRQ方法，针对视频扩散Transformer的KV缓存，通过在线拟合时域旋转来改善2比特量化的效果。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于视频扩散Transformer的KV缓存量化，属于通用高效推理技术，未涉及VLA、世界模型或机器人；对本站主题无直接关系，但量化方法可能为机器人视频生成或世界模型的高效推理提供参考。

We observe that (i) Within a video, nearby frames share persistent spatial patterns and (ii) the final two panels show that these patterns differ across videos, even at the same frame index and channel. papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable robots to perform diverse tasks from visual observations and language instructions. While prior work has explored task suppression and refusal, stopping prohibited behavior once execution is underway and controlling the resulting physical response remain challenging. Our evaluation reveals that policies which suppress a task from its initial state can still complete it when taking over partway through execution. Even when the task remains unfinished, the robot may drop a held object, making non-completion an incomplete measure of safety. To address these challenges, we introduce State-Aware Fallback Imitation (SAFI) for tasks where holding provides an appropriate alternative response. SAFI comprises two stages, (1) fallback target construction, which assigns stationary arm commands and consistent gripper targets throughout prohibited-task demonstrations, and (2) joint policy adaptation, which learns these targets alongside the original actions of retained tasks. This supervision teaches an explicit alternative response at intermediate execution states while maintaining the robot's other skills. Extensive experiments with OpenVLA-OFT across LIBERO and BadLIBERO tasks evaluate prohibited completion, physical incidents, and retained-task performance. On the evaluated LIBERO tasks, SAFI reduces aggregate target success after takeover to 1.3\%, with no recorded physical incidents or action saturation, while preserving high retained-task success.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO任务中，SAFI将接管后的目标成功率降至1.3%，无物理事故或动作饱和，同时保持较高的保留任务成功率。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出状态感知回退模仿（SAFI）方法，通过构建回退目标和联合策略适应，使VLA模型在禁止任务执行过程中能够安全停止并保持其他技能。
analysis.method: SAFI包含两个阶段：（1）回退目标构建，在禁止任务演示中分配静止手臂指令和一致夹爪目标；（2）联合策略适应，与保留任务的原始动作一起学习这些目标。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 针对VLA机器人策略在禁止任务执行中无法安全停止的问题，提出状态感知回退模仿方法，训练替代响应以提升安全性。

papers.abstract: Humanoid agents in everyday environments are expected to react to diverse cues as humans do, with semantically appropriate and physically executable behaviors. Existing cue-driven reaction generation methods support only a narrow range of cue modalities and are limited to purely kinematic generation, leaving the resulting reactions susceptible to physical artifacts. To this end, we present MixReact, the first unified framework for physics-based reactive humanoid control from text, audio, and video cues, integrating a Discrete--Continuous Mixture of Transformers (DisCo-MoT) for state prediction with a History-aware Action Transformer (HAT) for physical execution. DisCo-MoT couples a discrete masked-modeling branch with a continuous autoregressive diffusion branch via one-way mixture attention within a MoT architecture. Guidance from discrete context mitigates collapse into averaged behaviors in one-to-many reaction generation, while direct prediction in continuous state space bypasses the decoding bottleneck of discrete representations. HAT then maps the predicted next state and observed execution history to executable actions, enabling robust closed-loop control in physics-based simulation. Experiments across all three modalities demonstrate consistent improvements over the baselines in fidelity, diversity, and physical consistency, while ablations validate the complementary contributions of the components. Our code will be released to facilitate future research. Project page: https://binlee26.github.io/MixReact_Page/

analysis.key_results: 在三种模态上的实验表明，MixReact在保真度、多样性和物理一致性方面一致优于基线，消融实验验证了各组件的互补贡献。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出首个从文本、音频和视频线索进行物理反应式人形控制的统一框架MixReact，通过DisCo-MoT状态预测和HAT物理执行实现了语义适当且物理可行的行为。
analysis.method: 利用离散掩码建模与连续自回归扩散分支通过单向混合注意力耦合的DisCo-MoT预测状态，再利用历史感知动作Transformer(HAT)将预测状态与执行历史映射为可执行动作，实现闭环物理控制。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一个统一框架MixReact，利用离散-连续混合Transformer和动作Transformer实现从文本、音频和视频线索到物理可执行人形反应的控制。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接面向人形机器人控制，将视觉、语言等多模态输入映射到物理动作，属于VLA范畴；其离散-连续混合状态预测和闭环执行策略对机器人视觉-语言-动作模型的高效推理和物理一致性具有直接参考价值。

papers.abstract: Recently, video world models have advanced interactive generation, with large models offering higher quality and smaller models enabling faster inference. Existing speculative methods combine their strengths through fast draft generation and selective target regeneration guided by rewards on decoded frames. However, verification covers only the external scorer's evaluation dimensions and adds decoding and scoring costs. Moreover, these scores provide no correction, requiring costly target regeneration for rejected drafts. To address these limitations, we propose Speculative World Model (SpecWM), a unified, training-free inference framework for streaming world models. It verifies draft chunks using the target's latent velocity field. Verification also yields a reusable correction; two thresholds select Accept, Refine, or Reject. Specifically, one-step refinement reuses it to improve perceptual quality, while three-step refinement strengthens camera following and trajectory consistency. These findings motivate transition-aware refinement. On WBench Navigation, SpecWM improves visual quality at 1.63$\times$ speedup over the target and raises NavScore from the draft's 75.99 to 85.63, achieving the best quality-speed-control trade-off. Additionally, our LongSpecBench shows sustained quality and control over long, multi-turn rollouts, while experiments on Hy-Nomas validate SpecWM across backbones and denoising budgets.

analysis.key_results: 在 WBench Navigation 上，SpecWM 以 1.63 倍于目标的速度提升视觉质量，并将 NavScore 从草稿的 75.99 提高到 85.63；LongSpecBench 显示长期多轮 rollout 中质量和控制的持续性；Hy-Nomas 实验验证了跨骨干和去噪预算的适用性。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 SpecWM，一种统一的免训练流式世界模型推理框架，通过目标潜速度场验证草稿块，并利用验证结果提供可复用的修正，实现接受、精炼或拒绝的三种决策。
analysis.method: 利用目标模型的潜速度场验证草稿块，验证同时产生可复用的修正；通过两个阈值选择接受、精炼或拒绝；一步精炼提升感知质量，三步精炼增强相机跟随与轨迹一致性，并引入过渡感知精炼。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: SpecWM 提出一种免训练的统一推理框架，利用目标模型的潜速度场验证草稿块并将验证结果用于精炼，在流式世界模型上实现质量与速度的最佳权衡。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作专注于流式世界模型的推测解码，世界模型是机器人动作-世界建模的重要组成；尽管未直接涉及 VLA 或机器人策略，但其高效推理方法对资源受限的机器人世界模型部署具有潜在价值。

papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can act as closed-loop robot-use agents (RUAs) by writing and executing control code through tool interfaces. However, turning an open-weight VLM into a high-performing embodied agent requires a complete post-training stack: out-of-the-box open VLMs fail completely at interactive tool contracts, strong frontier teachers are accessible only as black-box endpoints without exposed weights or token probabilities, and supervised imitation alone plateaus under rollout distribution shift. We present EmbodyAgent, an end-to-end post-training framework with three tightly coupled pipelines: (1) a black-box data synthesis pipeline that queries a strong teacher under a forced think-then-code contract and filters trajectories by task success; (2) an SFT pipeline that distills the explanation-and-program targets into an open-weight 9B VLM with both vision and language encoders trainable; and (3) an online RL pipeline that optimizes student-generated episodes via group-relative advantage with a runtime-error-penalized outcome reward. All three pipelines share one primitive-free Python execution tool exposing only raw visual observation and seven-dimensional end-effector control, with no action decoder and no interface shift across stages. Under a strictly separated evaluation protocol on ten LIBERO Spatial tasks (disjoint state splits, greedy test-time decoding, training-only safeguards), held-out success on 100 test states rises from 0/100 (base 9B VLM) to 14/100 (after SFT) and 84/100 (after RL), while training rollout success climbs from 8.4% to 87.7% and median model calls per episode drop from 36 to 11. We further identify a self-reinforcing runtime-error mode induced by outcome-based RL on executable code, and establish a failure-category monitoring and sampling-side curation protocol that stabilizes training.

analysis.key_results: 在10个LIBERO Spatial任务上，100个测试状态的成功率从0/100提升至SFT后的14/100和RL后的84/100；训练rollout成功率从8.4%升至87.7%，每次episode的中位模型调用次数从36降至11。
analysis.limitations: 识别出基于结果的RL在可执行代码上会诱导自强化运行时错误模式，需通过失败类别监控和采样侧策展协议来稳定训练。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一个端到端后训练框架EmbodyAgent，包含黑盒数据合成、SFT蒸馏和在线RL三条流水线，使开放权重9B VLM能够作为机器人使用代理。
analysis.method: 使用黑盒教师进行数据合成（强制思考后编码并过滤成功轨迹），SFT蒸馏至开放权重9B VLM（训练视觉和语言编码器），以及使用组相对优势和运行时错误惩罚的在线RL优化。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出EmbodyAgent框架，通过黑盒蒸馏、SFT和在线RL将开放权重视觉语言模型训练为可编写执行控制代码的具身机器人智能体。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接聚焦于将视觉语言模型训练为具身机器人智能体，属于VLA研究，通过提升VLA的性能和效率，对相关主题具有高度相关性。
