papers.abstract: GPTQ is the de facto standard solver for layer-wise post-training quantization (PTQ) of large language models, yet the solver itself has received less attention than weight preprocessing and cross-layer objectives. We target a bottleneck of GPTQ: its greedy procedure optimizes continuous group scales separately from the assignment of discrete integers. Evaluating each integer candidate with its closed-form optimal scale has been used for per-channel quantization; JointQ extends it to group-wise quantization, where a row's scales are coupled through the Hessian, and applies it to refine the GPTQ solution. Each local-search move changes one integer and recomputes its group's optimal scale in closed form, accounting for the other groups through the full Hessian; all scales are periodically re-solved jointly. The search starts from a row-wise selection among scale-refitted candidates including the GPTQ solution, so unregularized JointQ never has a larger layer-wise calibration error than GPTQ. JointQ preserves the GPTQ output format and is thus a drop-in replacement. Across four models and four settings, JointQ improves six-task average zero-shot accuracy over vanilla GPTQ in 14 of 16 comparisons and perplexity in 12 of 16. The mean accuracy gain increases from 0.0044 in W4G128 to 0.1559 in W3 per-channel, and JointQ also improves average accuracy over GPTQ with MSE-based scale search and activation ordering in all eight per-channel comparisons, though rarely in G128. An ablation shows that JointQ's diagonal Tikhonov regularization mitigates severe W3 per-channel perplexity degradation, so the largest gains are not due to the local search alone. Overall, JointQ's primary empirical benefit is downstream accuracy preservation in challenging low-bit and large-group regimes. Code is available in the OneComp library at https://github.com/FujitsuResearch/OneCompression.

analysis.key_results: 在 4 个模型和 4 种配置下，JointQ 在 16 项比较中有 14 项提高了六任务平均零样本精度，12 项提高了困惑度；在 W3 per-channel 下平均精度增益从 W4G128 的 0.0044 增至 0.1559。
analysis.main_contribution: 将 GPTQ 中的贪婪整数赋值扩展到联合优化整数与分组尺度，并在不增加逐层校准误差的前提下改进量化质量。
analysis.method: 在 GPTQ 输出基础上，利用局部搜索逐整数更新并用闭式解重算其组的尺度，同时通过完整 Hessian 考虑其他组的影响，并定期联合求解所有尺度。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出 JointQ，在 GPTQ 基础上通过联合优化整数赋值与分组尺度来改进大语言模型的后训练量化。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文聚焦于独立的后训练量化技术，未直接涉及 VLA、WAM 或机器人模型，但对高效推理部署（包括潜在机器人模型）有参考价值。

papers.abstract: Autoregressive normalizing flows (NFs) provide a tractable density for learning and sampling continuous robot actions. We show that a single maximum-likelihood objective can train vision--language--action (VLA) policies competitive with leading methods on manipulation benchmarks. We present NF-VLA, which combines conditional autoregressive normalizing flows with score-based action refinement. Its deep--shallow architecture concentrates visual, language, and proprioceptive prefix conditioning in a high-capacity deep block, while unconditioned shallow blocks provide a shared invertible action transformation. The vision--language backbone and flow are jointly trained by exact maximum likelihood on Gaussian-smoothed action chunks. The same learned density supplies a single score-based correction at inference, refining generated actions to account for training-time smoothing without a separately trained denoiser. Trained on LIBERO from a pretrained vision--language backbone without robot pretraining, NF-VLA achieves 98.35\% success across the four standard suites and 72.6\% on LIBERO-Plus using the same checkpoint without further fine-tuning. Ablations show that deep-only prefix conditioning and score-based refinement both improve closed-loop success. Together, these results establish carefully structured autoregressive flows as a competitive approach to VLA control, with one learned density supporting policy training, action generation, and refinement.

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are capable of producing desired robotic behaviors in ideal settings. However, they often fail when the robot's actuation changes at deployment. For example, remounting, mechanical wear, or command latency changes can lead to failed tasks and unsafe behaviors. To address the inevitable actuation shift, we propose ReGround, an inference-time method that keeps the VLA frozen and re-grounds its intended motion. ReGround learns the deployed robot's dynamics from task-agnostic motor babbling, and then tracks the policy's intended motion while staying close to the policy's own plan. ReGround activates only upon detecting a shift, and needs no rewards, demonstrations, or retraining. We show via two VLAs, eight LIBERO tasks, and five shift settings that ReGround can restore near-oracle success, such as raising $\pi_{0.5}$'s success from 0.16 to 0.90 under 400 ms latency, while remaining safer than a linear-calibration baseline. Project website and open-source code: https://umersiddique94.github.io/ReGround/.

analysis.key_results: 在两种VLA、八个LIBERO任务和五种偏移设置下，ReGround恢复接近oracle的成功率，例如在400ms延迟下将π0.5的成功率从0.16提高到0.90，且比线性校准基线更安全。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出ReGround，一种无需奖励、演示或重训练的推理时方法，通过任务无关的运动噪声学习部署机器人动力学，并在检测到执行器偏移时跟踪VLA的意图运动，同时保持接近原始计划。
analysis.method: ReGround通过任务无关的运动噪声学习部署机器人动力学，并在检测到偏移后，在保持接近VLA自身计划的同时追踪其意图运动。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出ReGround方法，在推理时保持VLA冻结，通过重新接地其意图运动来应对机器人执行器偏移。

papers.abstract: Continuous and accurate estimation of human hand kinematics is important not only for intuitive human-machine interaction, but also for capturing fine-grained human manipulation demonstrations that can provide action supervision for embodied-intelligence datasets and dexterous robot learning. However, individual sensing modalities may be insufficient for reliable estimation under varying operating conditions. We present a finger-unencumbered multimodal framework for continuous regression of 20 hand joint angles from egocentric RGB images and 128-channel forearm high-density surface electromyography (HD-sEMG). The framework combines a Vision Transformer-based visual encoder, a Transformer-based EMG encoder, and a degree of freedom (DoF) query Transformer fusion decoder. To account for the varying informativeness of visual and EMG cues across joint DoFs and input conditions, the decoder assigns a separate learnable query to each DoF, enabling DoF-specific and context-adaptive fusion of the two modalities. The framework was evaluated on synchronized multimodal data from 10 participants. Averaged across participants, the proposed fusion model achieved a mean coefficient of determination ($R^2$) of $0.88$ and a mean absolute error (MAE) of $2.80^\circ$, compared with $0.82$ and $3.21^\circ$ for the vision-only model and $0.68$ and $5.13^\circ$ for the EMG-only model. It also outperformed the evaluated representative unimodal baselines and alternative fusion designs. DoF-wise analyses showed larger fusion gains for visually ambiguous joints and viewing conditions, while synthetic visual occlusion demonstrated greater robustness than vision-only estimation. These results highlight the complementary value of egocentric vision and forearm HD-sEMG for capturing fine-grained human hand kinematics, with potential applications in human demonstration acquisition and dexterous robot learning.

analysis.key_results: 10名受试者数据评估，融合模型平均R²为0.88，MAE为2.80°，优于视觉-only模型的0.82和3.21°、肌电-only模型的0.68和5.13°，并在视觉遮挡测试中表现出更强鲁棒性。

papers.abstract: The CAPSARII project advances a cyber-secure, ultra-low-power wearable platform and Internet of Battlefield Things (IoBT) framework to support real-time monitoring of military personnel and data-driven decision support. The architecture integrates smart-textile sensing, a body/squad area mesh, edge-deployed AI on secure RISC-V microcontrollers, and cloud/federated analytics for cross-mission learning and comparative studies. Two representative use cases--pilot fatigue and warfighters operating in harsh environments--guide requirements, validation, and interface design (including HUD and haptic feedback). As an initial step toward embedded models, we benchmark stress classification on a public wearable dataset: tree-ensemble baselines achieve state-of-the-art performance for accuracy and F1 (e.g., XGBoost: $\mathrm{Accuracy}=0.901\!\pm\!0.023$, $\mathrm{F1}=0.920\!\pm\!0.019$), while a feature-based Transformer attains the highest AUC ($0.963\!\pm\!0.025$), informing feature-engineering and compression choices for edge deployment. Building on these results, CAPSARII employs HW/SW co-design, model compression (pruning, quantization, distillation), and precision tuning to meet stringent energy and memory budgets; it further investigates Processing-in-Memory accelerators for future efficiency gains. A structured gap analysis highlights the remaining challenges: establishing validation standards for physiological signal quality and textile durability; achieving low-latency, scalable BAN/SAN communications under mobility and interference; and deploying hybrid lightweight/post-quantum cryptography with robust device identity and side-channel resilience on constrained endpoints. By consolidating these elements into a coherent, secure IoBT stack, CAPSARII delineates a practical roadmap from laboratory baselines to mission-ready soldier monitoring in both training and operational scenarios.

analysis.limitations: 摘要提到仍需解决生理信号质量和纺织品耐用性验证标准、移动干扰下低延迟BAN/SAN通信、以及受限端点上混合轻量级/后量子密码与设备身份及侧信道韧性等挑战。

analysis.method: 基于公共可穿戴数据集的基准测试，使用树集成模型（如XGBoost）和特征Transformer进行压力分类；后续采用软硬件协同设计、模型压缩（剪枝、量化、蒸馏）和精度调优满足边缘部署约束。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: CAPSARII项目提出一种融合智能纺织品传感、边缘AI和联邦分析的可穿戴IoBT平台，用于士兵健康监测，并初步在公开生理数据集上评估了嵌入式模型性能。

papers.abstract: An autonomous vehicle must foresee the consequences of its actions, especially in the rare, time-critical situations where crashes happen. A world model offers this foresight, but only within the coverage of its training data, which poses an exploration-exploitation dilemma. Within this coverage a planner can hardly improve on the data, and beyond it the model's errors mislead it. Logs of competent driving rarely contain the failures that would widen the coverage, and agents that learn from interaction gain them only by failing themselves, without being shown what to do instead. We propose SAFER, a framework that learns offline from failures that others make, judged by an expert, and keeps learning online from its own driving. Offline, partially trained agents and scripted, recoverable perturbations Stage failures in simulation, and an expert Annotates every visited state with its action and value, so that much of what the planner explores is covered before it drives. In planning, a chunked latent world model Foresees the consequences fast enough for real-time use, and a risk-aware sampling-based planner Evaluates candidate maneuvers by their return minus a bounded collision penalty. Online, a loop continuously Refines the model wherever this driving leaves the coverage of the offline data. In closed-loop evaluation against the compared methods, SAFER reaches the highest route completion and reward per step on the CARLA Leaderboard routes, 0.95 and 0.77 from a privileged bird's-eye view, and the highest episode reward in MetaDrive, 53.4 in regular and 49.0 in safety-critical traffic. Project page: https://ys-qu.github.io/safer-website.

analysis.key_results: 在CARLA Leaderboard路线上达到最高路线完成率0.95和每步奖励0.77（特权鸟瞰视角），在MetaDrive中达到最高回合奖励53.4（常规）和49.0（安全关键交通）。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出SAFER框架，通过离线从专家评判的他人失败中学习，并结合在线自车驾驶数据持续细化世界模型，以解决自动驾驶中世界模型覆盖范围有限的问题。
analysis.method: 离线阶段利用部分训练智能体和可恢复扰动在仿真中制造失败，专家为每个访问状态标注动作和价值；在线规划采用分块潜空间世界模型和风险感知采样规划器；在线再通过连续细化循环更新模型。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: SAFER框架通过离线从他人失败中学习并在线持续细化，解决自动驾驶世界模型规划中的探索-利用困境。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接聚焦于自动驾驶的世界模型（WAM）构建与使用，并涉及基于世界模型的策略学习，与本站主题高度相关。

figures.caption: Learning paradigms for autonomous driving, compared by where the experience beyond competent driving comes from. The glyph under each paradigm shows the coverage of its data (gray) and how the paradigm treats it. Exploiting (blue) spreads the candidates over the coverage and takes the best one up to its edge, but no further. Exploring (orange) grows the coverage at the price of failures (red crosses), the paradigm’s own or, for SAFER, failures that others make, labeled by the expert (teal). A step out of the coverage that does not grow it is misjudged (?). (a) Imitation learning copies expert demonstrations and never observes a failure; reinforcement learning discovers consequences by failing in the environment. (b) A world model learned online ( Hafner et al., 2020 ; Li et al., 2024 ) still explores by failing. A world model learned from logged expert driving ( Wang et al., 2024b ; Zheng et al., 2025 ) covers competent driving only, and a planner that searches beyond this coverage favors the actions that the model misjudges. (c) SAFER broadens the coverage offline with staged failures that an expert annotates, plans with a fast chunked world model that prices collision risk, and extends the coverage online from the planner’s own driving. The BEV frames, candidates and risk curves in (c) are from a recorded collision of the corpus (Fig. 5 a).

papers.abstract: Masked modeling is the dominant self-supervised paradigm for point-cloud videos. However, it leaks the information it is meant to predict, whether it reconstructs masked points as in MAE-style methods or predicts their latent features. Because point-cloud tokens are anchored at points sampled from each frame, querying a target at its own position reveals where its geometry has moved, in reconstruction and latent prediction alike. For latent predictors, random spatio-temporal masks introduce a further shortcut, as visible frames on both sides of each target allow interpolation rather than forecasting. The pretext task thus reduces to completion. Once the target positions are withheld, a masked latent predictor performs only slightly better than copying the last frame. To remove this leakage, we propose PointWM, a latent world model that turns completion into forecasting by predicting the features and geometry of future frames from strictly earlier context. Each target is queried only with its last-seen position and timestamp, while a latent action learned without annotations is meant to capture the part of the future that the past leaves undetermined. On HOI4D action segmentation with a P4Transformer backbone, PointWM improves F1@50 over training from scratch by 24.9 offline and 29.1 under strictly causal inference. These results show the promise of latent world models as a leakage-free pretraining paradigm for point-cloud videos.Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/InitalZ/PointWM.

analysis.key_results: 在HOI4D动作分割任务上，使用P4Transformer主干，PointWM相比从零训练提升了F1@50离线24.9，严格因果推理下提升29.1。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出PointWM，一种无泄漏的潜世界模型预训练范式，将点云视频的补全任务转为预测任务。
analysis.method: 从严格更早的上下文预测未来帧的特征和几何；目标仅用其最后位置和时间戳查询；学习无标注的潜在动作以捕捉不确定的未来部分。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文提出PointWM，一种潜世界模型，通过只从严格更早的上下文预测未来帧的特征和几何，消除点云视频遮挡建模中的信息泄漏。

papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) are routinely aligned with offline pairwise RLHF objectives, but multimodal preference data is scarce and treats every response token as equally informative. Under a small preference budget, pair construction becomes nearly irrelevant: standard DPO-style, image-conditional, and self-improvement objectives all perform within 1.1 points on MM-RLHF metrics and 0.5 points on hallucination rates, matching the SFT baseline. We call this entropy-blind preference optimization: the learning signal ignores policy uncertainty, which in chain-of-thought VLMs concentrates on specific fork tokens where visual claims are made. We introduce GEM-MM, extending entropy-guided preference modeling to VLMs. It samples on-policy candidates, rewards high-entropy reasoning forks, penalizes uncertain final answers, and updates the model via group-normalized policy gradients. On a 3000-prompt MM-RLHF budget with Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct, GEM-MM achieves the best entropy-depth preference score (61.7% vs. 57.3-58.4% baselines) and implicit-reward accuracy (41.4%). Crucially, it reduces AMBER hallucination from 23.4-24.0 to 20.6 and CHAIR from 5.0-5.1 to 4.6 at matched caption coverage. It also ranks best on all three HallusionBench granularities, with a conservative operating point raising the near-chosen rate to 62.4%. An off-the-shelf multimodal reward model ranks GEM-MM first, and two such models independently confirm our main ablations (p < 0.001). We report confidence intervals, paired significance tests, metric-reward functional overlaps, and document a collapse mode when exceeding the fair budget. Code and evaluation harness: https://github.com/SNOWTEAM2023/GEM-MM

analysis.key_results: 在 3000 提示 MM-RLHF 预算下，GEM-MM 实现最佳熵深度偏好分数 61.7%（基线 57.3-58.4%），隐式奖励准确率 41.4%，AMBER 幻觉率降至 20.6，CHAIR 降至 4.6，且在 HallusionBench 各粒度排名最佳。
analysis.limitations: 摘要提到在超过公平预算时会出现崩溃模式（collapse mode），并报告置信区间和配对显著性检验，但未具体描述该崩溃模式的细节。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 GEM-MM 方法，将熵引导偏好建模扩展到视觉语言模型，通过采样在线策略候选、奖励高熵推理分叉并惩罚不确定最终答案，利用组归一化策略梯度更新模型。
analysis.method: 熵引导偏好建模：采样在线策略候选，奖励高熵推理分叉，惩罚不确定最终答案，使用组归一化策略梯度更新模型。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出 GEM-MM，通过熵引导偏好对齐在链式思考视觉语言模型中优先优化高不确定性的推理分叉，以减少幻觉并提升偏好学习效果。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文聚焦于视觉语言模型的偏好对齐与幻觉减少，未涉及机器人动作预测、世界模型或 VLA 高效推理，因此与本站主题无直接关联。

Given a multimodal query x = ( x I , x Q ) x=(x_{I},x_{Q}) (text-only q q in the original figure) drawn from a preference pool { a − , a + } \{a^{-},a^{+}\} , the Reflective Inference Engine π θ \pi_{\theta} elaborates k k chain-of-thought candidates; Cognitive Filtering computes per-token entropy and an entropy-guided score that rewards fork tokens while penalizing uncertain final answers; SEGA forms a contextual group advantage and applies a full-parameter gradient update. papers.abstract: Offline language models could extend access to maternal-health information where internet connectivity is unreliable, but deployment requires both clinically appropriate responses and feasible local execution. This study presents an offline Android assistant integrating ready-made quantized language models, a clinically validated local knowledge package, conversational context, and model-initiated local retrieval. Gemma 4 E2B and Qwen3.5 0.8B were compared across 45 conversations and 312 turns per configuration, including a dedicated offline agentic benchmark. Gemma achieved higher response-quality, context-retention, and safety scores; Qwen offered faster generation and lower memory use. Clinician assessment of 150 Gemma responses across nine clinical domains yielded a mean quality score of 3.80/4, with 147 responses meeting the acceptance criterion. A paired RAG-on/off experiment evaluated 74 questions: retrieval improved 11 responses, left 56 neutral, produced four adverse response changes, and left three pairs unassessable. RAG-on had descriptively higher mean usefulness, safety, correctness, and actionability in the conditional 70-pair subset excluding the four flagged pairs from both conditions. Physical-device testing demonstrated offline responses on a 6 GB Android handset, with a 14.3 s median latency, alongside successful reconnection synchronization in the integrated application. Together, the findings document clinical response quality and practical performance of the integrated offline maternal-health assistant.

analysis.key_results: Gemma在响应质量、上下文保留和安全性方面优于Qwen；Qwen推理速度更快且内存占用更低。150条Gemma响应经临床评估平均质量得分3.80/4，其中147条达到接受标准。14.3秒中位延迟，6GB Android设备可离线运行。
analysis.limitations: 检索（RAG）开启后，有4个响应出现不良变化，总体中性居多；摘要未说明其他局限。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出并评估了一个集成了量化语言模型、临床验证的本地知识包、对话上下文以及模型发起本地检索的离线Android母胎健康助手。
analysis.method: 在离线Android设备上集成量化语言模型（Gemma 4 E2B和Qwen3.5 0.8B），并利用对话、本地知识包和模型发起检索；通过45个会话、312轮及专门离线agent基准比较模型表现。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本研究设计并评估了一个在低连接环境中运行的离线母胎健康助手，集成量化语言模型、本地知识包和本地检索，并报告了临床质量与端侧性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文是独立的模型量化与端侧部署研究，应用于医疗领域，与VLA或机器人动作-世界模型无直接关系。量化技术对VLA/WAM的端侧高效推理具有潜在参考价值。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) and World-Action Models (WAMs) have emerged in autonomous driving with the promise of strong generalization to long-tail scenarios. Although these models achieve state-of-the-art results on autonomous driving benchmarks, most existing benchmarks are dominated by nominal scenarios and therefore cannot test this promise. To test one such long-tail capability that is critical for safety, we introduce ReactBench-AD, a benchmark that measures how driving models react to objects that appear in the ego vehicle's path. Built on real NAVSIM and PhysicalAI-Autonomous-Vehicles scenes, ReactBench-AD composites a crossing pedestrian, a standing pedestrian, or a stationary car consistently across all camera views and history frames. Each edited scene thus forms an exact, pixel-level counterfactual pair with its original, which allows us to isolate the causal effect of the inserted object on the predicted trajectory. Evaluating four VLAs and two WAMs, we find that they react weakly, often barely at all. Finally, we test how easily one of the evaluated VLAs, ReCogDrive, can be taught to brake hard for imminent hazards: a short fine-tuning stage on edited scenes substantially improves its reactions, with the learned behavior generalizing to unseen objects and fully real scenes, at minimal cost to nominal driving. These results call into question the out-of-the-box long-tail capabilities of these models, but suggest that they can be a strong foundation for acquiring them with little additional training, highlighting the value of real or synthetic data that demonstrates the long-tail behaviors nominal datasets rarely contain. Code and data will be made publicly available.

analysis.key_results: 四个VLA和两个WAM对插入的物体反应微弱，通常几乎没有反应；对ReCogDrive进行少量微调可大幅改善其对迫近危险的反应，且该行为可泛化到未见物体和完全真实场景，同时对标称驾驶的性能代价很小
analysis.main_contribution: 提出ReactBench-AD基准，利用像素级反事实编辑构建精确对照场景，以因果方式评估驾驶模型对路径内迫近危险的即时反应，并展示对VLA进行少量微调可有效提升该长尾能力
analysis.method: 基于NAVSIM和PhysicalAI-Autonomous-Vehicles真实场景，在所有相机视图和历史帧中一致地合成穿过行人、站立行人或静止车辆，生成与原场景配对的反事实场景；评估四个VLA和两个WAM，并对ReCogDrive进行编辑场景上的短期微调
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出ReactBench-AD基准，通过像素级反事实编辑评估自动驾驶VLA和WAM对路径中突然出现物体的反应能力，并展示了少量微调即可显著改善反应
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接评估并改进VLA和WAM在长尾安全关键场景下的反应能力，与本站主题高度相关；通过反事实基准和微调揭示了当前模型在即时危险反应方面的不足及改进路径，对VLA与WAM的评估和提升具有直接价值

papers.abstract: Test-time scaling improves vision-language-action (VLA) policies by drawing several action candidates and executing the best one. We find that its returns diminish quickly when the candidates are resampled from one decoder: they differ by noise rather than by plan, and for each of three resampling sources, going from four to eight candidates adds only 0.06-0.07 to the average number of completed tasks on CALVIN. We introduce PlanDiv, an action head that makes the candidates differ by plan: a lightweight planner proposes K latent plan hypotheses, a shared masked-diffusion executor decodes one action chunk per plan from a single backbone pass, and the policy executes the chunk that its own likelihood ranks highest. The plans are learned from demonstrations alone, without plan labels or rewards. With the backbone, data and training recipe held fixed, eight plan-conditioned candidates raise five-task chain success on CALVIN ABC$\rightarrow$D from 56.9% to 69.9%, while eight candidates from autoregressive, plan-free or same-plan resampling reach at most 64.9%. The same-plan baseline is PlanDiv's own checkpoint with the plan held fixed, so this gap comes from the plans, not from drawing more samples. On LIBERO-Long, four plans remove 40% of single-candidate failures, against at most 21% for matched resampling. On a real Franka arm the gain appears where a task admits more than one solution: PlanDiv is on par with a single-output OpenVLA-OFT+ baseline on a one-solution task and succeeds in 51 of 54 trials against 40 of 54 on two tasks with two solutions.

analysis.key_results: 在CALVIN ABC→D上，八个计划条件候选将五任务链成功率从56.9%提升至69.9%，而自回归、无计划或同计划重采样的最多64.9%；在LIBERO-Long上，四个计划消除了40%的单候选失败；真实Franka臂上在两解任务中51/54次成功对40/54次成功。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出PlanDiv动作头，使候选动作在计划层面而非噪声层面产生差异，并通过自身似然排序选择最佳执行，从而在测试时缩放VLA策略且无需额外标注或奖励。
analysis.method: 轻量级规划器提出K个潜在计划假设，共享掩码扩散执行器从单次骨干网络传递中解码每个计划对应的动作块，策略执行自身似然最高的动作块。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: PlanDiv通过轻量级规划器提出多个潜在计划假设，并用共享掩码扩散执行器解码动作块，选择似然最高的块执行，从而在保持单次骨干网络传递的条件下实现测试时缩放，提升VLA策略的任务成功率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的测试时缩放问题，通过引入潜在计划实现计划层面的多样性，提升VLA在机器人操作任务中的表现，与本站VLA主题高度相关。

papers.abstract: Automated tunnel-lining inspection must segment different defect geometries: cracks are thin, elongated, and connectivity-sensitive, whereas leakage, lining falling off, and segment damage are spatially extensive and context-dependent. Existing approaches generally apply a common decoder across defect classes or introduce boundary, topology, and directional mechanisms as isolated enhancements. This paper introduces Morphology-Decoupled Segmentation (MDS), in which defect morphology becomes the organising principle for feature routing, decoding, and interaction. A supervised routing module partitions multiscale encoder features into complementary linear and areal streams. The linear stream employs Deformable Strip Attention with image-conditioned direction hypotheses to preserve crack continuity without assuming fixed horizontal or vertical orientations, while the areal stream combines Pyramid Pooling with feature-pyramid fusion to capture diffuse boundaries and regional context. The representations are coupled through gated cross-morphology attention, allowing complementary information exchange while retaining morphology-specific features. A resolution-adaptive tiling and probability-blending pipeline preserves fine defects across variable-resolution imagery. MDS achieves 81.17% mIoU on the internal validation set and improves foreground image-level recognition over a backbone-matched SegDINO model, primarily for areal defects. Controlled ablations demonstrate the complementary contributions of routing supervision and cross-stream interaction while revealing a trade-off between areal-class performance and crack specialisation. The submitted model achieved 67.55% mIoU on an organiser-controlled hidden test, and the team placed second. Selective dynamic INT8 quantisation reduced model storage by 2.83 times with negligible accuracy loss.

analysis.key_results: 内部验证集mIoU 81.17%，隐藏测试mIoU 67.55%获第二名；动态INT8量化减少存储2.83倍且精度损失可忽略。
analysis.limitations: 摘要指出在面状类性能与裂缝特化之间存在权衡。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出形态解耦分割方法，将缺陷形态作为特征路由、解码和交互的组织原则，包括线性流与面状流的互补架构以及跨形态注意耦合。
analysis.method: 监督路由模块将编码器特征分为线性流（可变形条带注意力与方向假设）和面状流（金字塔池化与特征金字塔融合），通过门控跨形态注意力交互，并使用分辨率自适应平铺与概率融合。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出形态解耦分割网络（MDS），通过形态学引导的特征路由、解码与交互，提升隧道多类缺陷分割性能，并采用动态INT8量化减小模型存储。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文聚焦于隧道缺陷分割的模型量化，不涉及VLA、WAM或机器人动作/世界模型；仅模型量化部分对本研究方向有潜在通用价值。

papers.abstract: Rendered images are cheap to label, but a microcontroller classifier must survive 8-bit integer (INT8) quantisation and compute correctly on the chip. Five models, from MobileNetV2 at 224 px to a 61K-parameter convolutional neural network (CNN), were fine-tuned on a six-class scene dataset with and without a synthetic stage, against thresholds fixed in advance, and deployed on an ESP32-S3 and an RP2040. With full real data the stage gave no detectable gain. For the main deployable model the INT8 difference was +0.312 percentage points (pp), its interval below the +1.6 pp gain recomputed from the source study; quantisation did not detectably change it, nor did model size. With 10% of the real data the stage paid off for the CNN, by +3.438 pp on one seed and +2.715 pp over three; its cause is open. On the ESP32-S3 the main model took 152.7 ms and 16.3 mJ above idle per inference, and adding the stage changed neither beyond preset bounds. The model's INT8 outputs matched TensorFlow Lite's reference kernels exactly, but only after a memory overrun in a vendor kernel was patched. On the RP2040 the same model took 1.80 s and 27.3 mJ above idle, about twelve times slower, and the largest 96 px model exceeded the board's flash-capacity limit. Neither the RP2040 nor the host interpreter used for scoring reproduced the reference arithmetic. A synthetic stage is worth adding only when real data are scarce, and on-device INT8 outputs should be checked against reference kernels, not inferred from host scores.

analysis.key_results: 全量真实数据下合成阶段无增益；主模型INT8差分+0.312pp，低于源研究的+1.6pp；10%真实数据下CNN增益+3.438pp（单种子）或+2.715pp（多种子）；ESP32-S3上主模型推理152.7ms、16.3mJ，添加阶段无显著变化；RP2040上1.80s、27.3mJ，且最大模型超出闪存容量。
analysis.main_contribution: 量化评估了合成预训练阶段在微控制器部署中的实际收益，并强调了设备端INT8输出验证的必要性。
analysis.method: 在六类场景数据集上微调五种模型（MobileNetV2至61K参数CNN），在有/无合成阶段、固定阈值、部署于ESP32-S3和RP2040的条件下，比较INT8量化前后的精度、延迟与能耗。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 研究了在微控制器上部署INT8量化分类模型时，合成预训练阶段对精度、延迟和能耗的影响。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 无直接关系，属于独立模型量化研究，但提供了嵌入式部署中量化精度与硬件验证的方法学参考，对机器人端的VLA/WAM部署有潜在工程价值。

papers.abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as an important paradigm in robot learning, jointly predicting future scene states and robot actions from current observations and instructions. However, future states entangle task-related changes with large amounts of task-irrelevant content, such as static backgrounds, which weakens the model's ability to capture changes relevant to task execution. To address this, we propose Difference World Action Model (DiffWAM), a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) framework that enhances world representations by jointly learning future-state prediction and consecutive visual difference prediction. We define consecutive visual differences as differences between the latent representations of consecutive observations, providing an explicit learning signal for temporal variation. The framework comprises a World Expert for future frame prediction, an Action Expert for action generation, and a Diff Expert for predicting these latent differences along the trajectory. A structured unidirectional attention mask conditions the Diff, World, and Action Experts solely on the current-frame representation while blocking attention between experts. This design allows both the World and Diff Experts to be removed during inference, introducing no additional inference overhead. DiffWAM achieves state-of-the-art performance on the LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0 benchmarks and substantially improves over FastWAM on real-world manipulation tasks. Specifically, it attains average success rates of 98.8%, 92.65%, and 88.3%, outperforming the state-of-the-art baseline (i.e., FastWAM) by 1.75, 1.55, and 15.0 percentage points, respectively.

analysis.key_results: 在 LIBERO 和 RoboTwin 2.0 上达到最先进性能，真实世界操作任务上优于 FastWAM，平均成功率分别为 98.8%、92.65%、88.3%，比 FastWAM 高 1.75、1.55、15.0 个百分点。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 DiffWAM，一种通过引入 Diff Expert 预测连续视觉差异来增强世界表示的混合专家框架，且可移除专家模块以避免增加推理开销。
analysis.method: 混合专家（MoE）框架，包含 World Expert、Action Expert 和 Diff Expert，采用结构化单向注意力掩码，仅依赖当前帧表示，并可移除 World 和 Diff Expert。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出 DiffWAM，一种混合专家世界动作模型，通过联合预测未来状态和连续视觉差异来增强任务相关变化表示，并在推理时无额外开销。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 高度相关：该工作直接改进世界动作模型（WAM），通过差异建模增强任务相关状态预测，且可在推理时无额外开销移除模块，对机器人操控学习和高效推理具有直接价值。

The World and Diff Experts receive the same noised future-frame latents, share their first N − M N-M layers, and use independent final M M layers for state generation through denoising and latent-difference prediction through regression, respectively. papers.abstract: Looped language models such as Ouro and Raven apply one weight-shared block several times per token, so autoregressive decoding (AR) runs every loop of every token in sequence. Pipelined self-speculative decoders overlap these loops by drafting tokens from shallow readouts and verifying them at full depth. Yet every loop of a looped LM ends in a readout of the next token, and draft tokens pass through every depth anyway, so each depth can check them without an extra pass. We introduce LoopSkim, in which the depth of the pipeline is the verifier. Draft tokens copied from the context, as in prompt lookup decoding, enter after the first loops, any later readout that contradicts one replaces it at that depth, and only full-depth readouts commit tokens. LoopSkim fixes the random draws of every position in advance, so each check compares two tokens and decoding stays lossless in exact arithmetic under sampling for any number of checks and draft chains. Without training, its speedup over AR averages 1.73x that of LoopSpec across greedy decoding and sampling, and its checks between the first loops and full depth speed it up on every model. An optional draft head adds a second chain and raises this average to 1.99x.

analysis.key_results: 在贪心解码和采样下，LoopSkim相对自回归解码的平均加速比为LoopSpec的1.73倍；加入可选草稿头后提高到1.99倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出LoopSkim，一种适用于循环语言模型的无损多深度自投机解码方法，无需训练即可在多个模型上平均取得比LoopSpec高1.73倍的加速，加入可选草稿头后平均提升至1.99倍。
analysis.method: 将流水线深度作为验证器，利用上下文复制草稿token，在后续深度读出中逐层验证并替换，仅全深度读出的token才会被提交；同时预先固定每个位置的随机采样，保证精确算术下无损。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: LoopSkim通过在循环语言模型的流水线各深度直接验证草稿token，实现了无损的多深度自投机解码并带来显著加速。

papers.abstract: Video world models promise to predict the future of a scene from its present. Do current models keep this promise? We probe this question counterfactually. When a small change to the present flips the future, such as a box resting a few millimeters before or past a table edge, a model that tracks the state of the world must flip its prediction too. We build FlipTest, a three-level hierarchy of increasingly strict tests over 1,680 initial frames from 10 simulated and 15 real-world tasks. At the base, visual minimal pairs, two nearly identical frames whose true futures differ, test whether predictions change across the boundary; matched controls go further and test whether they change only where the future does; and dense sweeps, the strictest level, locate exactly where they change. All 11 video world models we evaluate fall short. The best averages 18.3% pair accuracy over real and simulated scenes, below the 25% of random guessing. Models flip as often on steps that leave the future unchanged as on steps that change it, and their response stays flat across the sweeps. On the same frames, a vision-language model is selective and traces a near S-shaped curve near the boundary, and a coding agent that measures the image comes close to the true boundary. This implies that the deciding information is in the frame, and video models just miss it. We therefore urge the community to rethink world modeling as pure video prediction. Next-frame prediction must do more than draw plausible pixels; it must also identify the causal states that control future dynamics.

analysis.key_results: 所有11个视频世界模型表现不佳；最佳模型在真实和模拟场景上的平均对准确率仅为18.3%，低于随机猜测的25%；模型对改变未来与不改变未来的步骤翻转频率一样，且响应平坦；相比之下，视觉语言模型具有选择性并在边界附近呈现近S形曲线，编码代理接近真实边界。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出FlipTest，一个三级递进的严格测试框架（视觉最小对、匹配控制、密集扫描），用于检验视频世界模型是否学习到控制未来动态的世界状态，并评估了11个模型。
analysis.method: 设计了基于反事实的FlipTest基准，包含1680个初始帧，涵盖10个模拟任务和15个真实世界任务，通过最小对、匹配控制和密集扫描三个层次评估模型行为。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 通过构建反事实的翻转测试框架，系统评估并揭示了当前视频世界模型在捕捉决定未来动态的因果状态上的不足。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接评估视频世界模型对世界状态的学习能力，对机器人世界模型（WAM）的评估与改进有重要方法学价值，但其本身不涉及VLA或具体的机器人策略学习。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models map visual observations, robot states, and natural-language instructions to robotic actions, but their multimodal interfaces introduce new security risks. Existing VLA backdoor attacks primarily study trigger-based activation and stealthy action manipulation, leaving conditional suppression of malicious behavior underexplored. We investigate suppression-aware backdoors, which combine conjunctive trigger activation with instruction-conditioned suppression. We instantiate this design through three variants: Cross-Modal Trigger, combining robot-state and spatially separated visual triggers; Self-Suppressing Trigger, requiring a state trigger and a [DISRUPT] instruction token for activation, with [RESTORE] token suppressing the attack; and Multi-Trigger, additionally requiring a visual trigger while retaining suppression even when physical triggers persist. We evaluate these attacks using SmolVLA on two SO-100 manipulation datasets against four baselines: State Backdoor, BadVLA, TabVLA, and SilentDrift. Self-Suppressing and Multi-Trigger reduce Isolation Forest detection from 96--98% to 1--18% and action-space l divergence by 10--14X, achieving 63--71% attack success rates with perfect clean-task performance. Experiments with OpenVLA on LIBERO further show that the attacks transfer to a 7B-parameter policy, evading STRIP and action-distribution-shift detection. Our findings establish conditional suppression as an important dimension for evaluating backdoor threats in VLA policies.

analysis.key_results: Self-Suppressing和Multi-Trigger将Isolation Forest检测率从96-98%降至1-18%，动作空间l散度降低10-14倍，攻击成功率63-71%，干净任务性能完美；攻击可迁移到7B参数的OpenVLA策略，并逃避STRIP和动作分布偏移检测。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出抑制感知后门攻击框架，包括三种变体（跨模态触发器、自抑制触发器和多重触发器），并展示其在SmolVLA和OpenVLA上的有效性。
analysis.method: 结合状态与视觉触发器的跨模态激活、指令token [DISRUPT]/[RESTORE] 控制攻击抑制，以及多触发器保持攻击的同时允许物理触发器持续存在。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文研究并设计了针对VLA模型的新型抑制感知后门攻击，可在特定条件下激活或抑制恶意行为，并评估其对现有检测方法的逃逸能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文直接针对VLA模型的安全性和鲁棒性评估，属于该主题下的对抗性攻击研究；不涉及WAM或高效推理，但为VLA模型的可靠性提供了重要的评估维度。

papers.abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) world models predict future embeddings instead of pixels and plan in latent space. Two challenges remain: 2D images leave the metric geometry that manipulation acts on implicit and entangled with appearance, and what these models imagine stays hidden, as they are mostly judged in simulation by short-horizon latent planning. We present JEPA4R, a JEPA world model that observes single-depth-camera point clouds, predicts and plans in their latent space, and acts through a policy head on its frozen latents; we call this 4D point planning. A decoder on the frozen world model shows what it imagines as 4D point clouds, with a mean point error within 1.1 cm over 200 steps. Under the policy-learning protocols of OGBench and CortexBench, JEPA4R leads pixel JEPA models on OGBench Cube-Single, Cube-Double, Cube-Triple and Scene, and ranks first on MetaWorld and Adroit Relocate with 98.4% and 88.0%, above the runner-up, R3M, at 96.0% and 65.3%. Trained only in a digital twin, JEPA4R and its policy heads run zero-shot on the real arm with both a gripper and a dexterous hand.

analysis.key_results: 在OGBench Cube-Single、Cube-Double、Cube-Triple和Scene上优于像素JEPA模型；在MetaWorld上98.4%、Adroit Relocate上88.0%，排名第一；在真实机械臂上实现零样本操作，平均点误差200步内小于1.1厘米。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出JEPA4R，一种具身JEPA世界模型，该模型在冻结的潜在空间上通过策略头进行4D点规划，并能通过解码器可视化想象的4D点云。
analysis.method: 基于JEPA，输入单深度相机点云，在潜在空间进行预测和规划，并通过策略头输出动作。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: JEPA4R提出了一种基于联合嵌入预测架构的具身世界模型，通过单深度相机点云进行4D点规划，并在真实机械臂上实现零样本操作。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文核心是具身世界模型，直接属于WAM范畴，且通过策略头将世界模型潜在表示与动作预测结合，对VLA中的动作预测模块具有参考价值。

papers.abstract: Flow-matching robot policies generate each action chunk through repeated network evaluations, one per denoising step. Cross-cycle caches such as C$^3$ache reuse computation from earlier replanning calls, but whether they beat simply taking fewer steps is unclear. We compare the two in Fast-WAM, a 6B-parameter world action model, on LIBERO-Goal. Two uncached steps keep the success of ten: on all 500 initial states they are non-inferior within two percentage points, for one checkpoint and noise seed. Under PyTorch's default compile mode, they also cut a replanning call on an RTX A6000 from 202 to 92 ms. This leaves little room for caching. A cache that keeps two fresh steps cannot be faster than two uncached steps: every call still encodes the images, runs the video expert and computes those two steps. Caching the first of two steps, refreshed every fourth call, saves at most 11--14% of a call by our cost model. Cached policies are also fragile. Their losses tracked the share of the flow path the cached steps cover: under Fast-WAM's current time shift, C$^3$ache's eight cached steps cover 80% of the path instead of 44%, and the cached policy succeeds on 63% of states against 95% uncached. Resampling the noise on every call cost caches covering 60% or more of the path 14--40 points. These results argue for fewer-step baselines and for testing reuse under the deployed sampler and noise settings. We release our evaluation harness, logs and a checklist.

analysis.key_results: 两个未缓存步骤在 500 个初始状态上与十个步骤的成功率在 2 个百分点内非劣；在 RTX A6000 上 PyTorch 默认编译下，一次重规划调用延迟从 202ms 降至 92ms；C³ache 的八个缓存步骤覆盖 80% 路径时成功率仅 63%，未缓存为 95%；每次调用重采样噪声时，覆盖 60% 以上路径的缓存成功率下降 14-40 个百分点。
analysis.limitations: 仅在一个检查点和噪声种子下验证了非劣效性，且评估限于 Fast-WAM 和 LIBERO-Goal。
analysis.main_contribution: 通过实验证明两个未缓存步骤即可保持十个步骤的成功率，并揭示缓存方法在 Fast-WAM 上优势有限且对噪声设置敏感，主张以更少步骤作为基线并部署时测试复用策略。
analysis.method: 在 LIBERO-Goal 的 500 个初始状态上，对 Fast-WAM 进行成功率和延迟的对比实验，使用成本模型分析缓存收益，并评估不同噪声采样方式对缓存策略的影响。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文在 Fast-WAM（6B 参数世界动作模型）上比较了流匹配机器人策略中跨周期缓存（如 C³ache）与直接减少去噪步骤的推理效率与成功率和鲁棒性。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 研究围绕 Fast-WAM（世界动作模型）展开，评估流匹配策略中的推理效率优化（减少步骤 vs 缓存）。虽然缓存技术与推测解码有相似思想（复用先前计算），但本文核心并非提出新的推测解码方法，而是对缓存与更少步骤的实证比较，对 VLA/WAM 的推理加速有直接参考价值。

papers.abstract: Looped Transformers improve parameter efficiency by repeatedly applying the same Transformer layers. During autoregressive decoding, however, generating each token requires several sequential passes through these layers, leading to high decoding latency. Pipelined self-speculative methods use shallow-loop predictions to process tokens at different loops in the same batch, but each token must reach the drafting depth before the next can enter the pipeline. We introduce LoopFill, a training-free speculative decoding algorithm for looped LLM that combines multi-token suffix drafts with shallow-loop predictions in a single draft tree. Both drafters contribute to one tree, so a suffix lookup can immediately extend a shallow prediction and several future tokens can enter the pipeline together. The shared block computes the highest-scoring draft candidates at different loop depths in one batch, and full-depth verification preserves the model's autoregressive output distribution. Across seven benchmarks, LoopFill's average speedup over greedy autoregressive decoding is $5.85\times$ on Ouro-2.6B and $5.13\times$ on Huginn-3.5B. The speedups exceed those of LoopAhead, the strongest baseline, by \(40\%\) on Ouro-2.6B and \(25\%\) on Huginn-3.5B.

analysis.key_results: 在七个基准上，LoopFill相对于贪心自回归解码的平均加速比为Ouro-2.6B上5.85倍、Huginn-3.5B上5.13倍，超过最强基线LoopAhead分别40%和25%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出LoopFill，一种免训练的循环LLM推测解码算法，通过结合多token后缀草稿与浅层循环预测在同一草稿树中，提高流水线利用率并加速解码。
analysis.method: LoopFill结合多token后缀草稿和浅层循环预测生成单一草稿树，在共享块中于不同循环深度批量计算最高分候选，并通过全深度验证保持自回归输出分布。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种免训练的循环Transformer推测解码算法LoopFill，通过结合多token后缀草稿与浅层循环预测共享草稿树，显著提升自回归解码速度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文专注于循环Transformer（looped LLM）的推测解码效率，未涉及VLA、WAM或机器人动作/世界模型；但其免训练推测解码方法对高效推理具有一般性参考价值，可潜在应用于机器人模型的推理加速。

papers.abstract: Purpose: Surgical training benefits from explicit comparison between cases: in patient condition, in technique and in skill proficiency. Surgical vision-language models (VLMs) offer a promising and flexible interface for this purpose. Yet current VLMs typically see one video at a time, and they often fall short when asked to compare videos. Methods: We propose EndoComparer, a VLM for comparative surgical video question answering with two components. (a) A Pseudo-Siamese Visual LoRA (PSVL) gives each video slot its own low-rank adapter over a shared frozen vision encoder, separating the two videos in the visual pathway at the cost of a single encoder pass. (b) A Perceive-then-Compare chain of thought (PtC-CoT) trains the model to first state what each video shows, then derive the answer from these statements. We further curate EndoDiffVQA, a benchmark of nearly 11K multiple-choice questions on video-pair over cholecystectomy and gastric bypass procedures, covering anatomy, tool, action and skill. Results: EndoComparer outperforms strong generalist and surgical VLMs on detecting and specifying difference between videos. Ablations show that two proposed components contribute complimentarily, and the model remains more robust under a video-swap control that exposes confusion between the two videos. Conclusion: Providing a dedicated visual reasoning path through PSVL and PtC-CoT makes cross-case comparison of surgical videos more robust for VLMs. EndoDiffVQA and EndoComparer provide a benchmark and a strong baseline for this task. Project page: https://camma-public.github.io/endocomparer

analysis.key_results: EndoComparer在检测和指定视频差异方面优于强通用和手术VLM；消融实验显示两个组件互补，模型在视频交换控制下更稳健。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出EndoComparer，一个用于比较手术视频问答的VLM，包含伪孪生视觉LoRA（PSVL）和先感知后比较的思维链（PtC-CoT）两个组件，并构建了EndoDiffVQA基准。
analysis.method: 使用伪孪生视觉LoRA（PSVL）为每个视频槽提供独立的低秩适配器，以及先感知后比较的思维链（PtC-CoT）训练模型先描述每个视频再推导答案。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一个手术视觉语言模型EndoComparer，通过伪孪生视觉适配和先感知后比较的推理方法来增强手术视频对之间的比较问答能力。

papers.abstract: World-action models (WAMs) augment vision-language-action policies (VLAs) with future prediction so that the policy can anticipate how its actions will affect the physical world. Existing WAMs supervise complete future observations. However, observations typically change little over an action chunk, so the future loss is dominated by copying static background content rather than learning task-relevant robot and object motion, limiting policy learning. Moreover, existing WAMs rely on large video generation models or separate world models, incurring heavy training and inference compute that hinders closed-loop deployment. To improve policy performance, we propose visual residual learning, supervising only the feature change from the current frame to the future frame in a frozen DINOv3 space. Compared with complete future features, this residual learning target yields a higher feature rank with richer and more diverse representations of scene changes, and spatially concentrates on the robot arm and manipulated objects rather than the background. To further improve computational efficiency, we present ResWAM, a residual world-action model with 2.3B parameters in total, including a lightweight 0.5B dual-branch DiT that jointly trains an action branch and a residual branch via conditional flow matching. Without robot pretraining (i.e., pretraining on external robot action trajectories beyond the benchmark demonstrations), ResWAM achieves top average success rates on LIBERO-Plus (81.1%), RoboTwin 2.0 (93.8%), and RoboDojo (9.40% success, 13.41 score) at the lowest training (2.7-4.0 TFLOPs) and inference compute (1.0-1.4 TFLOPs), and leads real-robot Open, Put, and Stack (80.0% average, +10.0% over $\pi_{0.5}$) at 92.7 ms latency.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO-Plus上达到81.1%平均成功率，RoboTwin 2.0上93.8%，RoboDojo上9.40%成功率和13.41分数，训练计算量2.7-4.0 TFLOPs，推理计算量1.0-1.4 TFLOPs；真实机器人Open、Put、Stack任务平均成功率80.0%，较π0.5提升10.0%，延迟92.7ms。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出视觉残差学习，仅在冻结DINOv3空间中监督当前帧到未来帧的特征变化，避免背景复制并聚焦机器人和物体运动；并提出轻量级的双分支DiT架构ResWAM，实现高效的世界-动作模型。
analysis.method: 视觉残差学习，使用冻结DINOv3空间中的特征变化作为监督信号；采用0.5B参数的双分支DiT，通过条件流匹配同时训练动作分支和残差分支。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出视觉残差学习和轻量级双分支DiT，以低计算成本训练世界-动作模型ResWAM，提升机器人策略在多个基准和真实机器人任务上的表现。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 直接面向世界-动作模型（WAM）的改进，与视觉-语言-动作策略（VLA）紧密相关，通过残差学习和轻量化设计同时提升策略性能和计算效率。

papers.abstract: World models learned from offline data allow an agent to plan without further interaction with the environment, but the sampling-based planners used with them handle safety constraints only by scoring or rejecting sampled action sequences. We instead pose safe planning in the latent space of a learned world model as a successive convex program (SCP), in which a learned discrete-time control barrier function is imposed as a constraint at every step of the horizon. SCP requires smooth dynamics, so we build the networks from smoothed MaxMin activations and spectrally normalised layers, and bound the resulting linearisation error in terms of the Lipschitz bound and the smoothing width. As SCP is a local method, we start it from a sampled plan. On two Safety-Gymnasium navigation tasks with offline data, this planner has fewer violations than MPPI and CEM drawing 128 times as many samples at equal wall-clock time in our main comparison, though not significantly, and earns greater return at longer horizons, and is much safer than SCP without a sampled start. SCP converged more often on Lipschitz-bounded models. Unlike sampling, it also reports at each step whether its plan is a feasible, first-order optimal KKT point of the planning problem in the model, or that no feasible plan was found nearby. Our implementation is publicly available at https://github.com/youngers2006/scwm.

analysis.key_results: 在Safety-Gymnasium导航任务中，该规划器在相同墙钟时间下违反约束次数少于采样128倍的MPPI和CEM，但差异不显著；在更长视界上获得更高回报；与无采样初始化的SCP相比更安全。SCP在利普希茨有界模型上收敛更频繁。
analysis.limitations: 与采样基线的安全性差异不显著。
analysis.main_contribution: 将安全规划问题表述为学习世界模型潜空间中的逐次凸规划，利用平滑激活和谱归一化层构建平滑动力学，并结合采样初始化以提升安全性。
analysis.method: 逐次凸规划（SCP）结合离散时间控制障碍函数约束，使用平滑MaxMin激活和谱归一化层保证平滑动力学，并从采样计划开始求解。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出在学习的潜空间世界模型中通过逐次凸规划（SCP）并施加离散时间控制障碍函数约束来实现安全离线规划。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文聚焦于基于学习世界模型的安全离线规划，提出了一种改进的规划方法，对机器人世界模型中的安全决策具有方法论参考价值，但未直接涉及VLA或机器人动作世界模型的统一框架。

papers.title: Successive Convexification in Learned World Models for Safe Offline Planning
papers.title_zh: 在学习的世界模型中用逐次凸化实现安全离线规划

papers.abstract: A surveillance drone on a bandwidth-starved link cannot send the video its operator would need, yet the operator's questions are often not about pixels: did three people converge, when, and where? We study what should cross a link of 1 Mbps down to 1 kbps instead, and in what order. BPS, a behavior-primitive stream, sends semantics first and pixels later: it runs a detector and a tracker onboard and sends short records (25 bytes on average) of multi-frame events selected by a mission card of 16-125 bytes, ahead of positions and pictures. We measure it by what a ground-side language model answers from it, under a preregistered protocol with a held-out set, against H.265 read by the vision fine-tune of the same model, H.265 on which the ground runs our own perception, a stream of quantized tracks, and onboard captions. On the development set (84% of questions about convergence, mostly one location) the event stream answers 74.3% of questions at 0.13 kbps. A reader that receives nothing answers 57.4%, and the video reader 59.6% at 100 kbps and 64.7% on the source frames. When the ground instead runs our perception on the video, video matches the stream at 100 kbps, about 800 times the stream's rate, and falls behind at 64 kbps and below. A track stream matches it at 96 times the bytes and loses 0.03 at 17 times. On held-out data the result is weaker: with events taken from annotated tracks, an oracle, the stream beats H.265 at 100 kbps (+0.13), but with onboard perception it does not (+0.01 [-0.04, +0.06]) and is no better than receiving nothing. Sent alone through emulated links the event records answer 0.739 at 1 Mbps and still 0.724 at 0.3 kbps; an every-frame track stream holds down to 1 kbps and video with ground-side perception down to about 100 kbps. On a Jetson Orin Nano the unchanged pipeline runs at 4.5 fps and misses most events.

analysis.key_results: 开发集上事件流在0.13 kbps下回答74.3%的问题，优于无信息基线（57.4%）和100 kbps H.265视频基线（59.6%）；在1 Mbps到0.3 kbps模拟链路上事件流回答准确率保持在0.739至0.724；Jetson Orin Nano上管线运行4.5 fps且漏检大部分事件。
analysis.limitations: 机载感知在留出集上效果较弱：与100 kbps H.265相比仅+0.01且置信区间跨零，与无信息接收相比无显著优势；在Orin Nano上运行帧率低且漏检大部分事件。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出并评估BPS（行为本原流），通过机载检测和跟踪生成多帧事件语义记录，在极低带宽下实现高效任务信息传输。
analysis.method: 机载运行检测器和跟踪器，生成短事件记录（平均25字节），由任务卡（16-125字节）选择后优先于位置和图片传输；地面语言模型基于事件流回答问题。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出一种行为本原流（BPS）方法，在极低带宽下优先传输语义事件记录而非原始视频，以支持地面语言模型回答无人机监控任务中的问题。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本研究专注于无人机监控场景下的高效语义事件流传输，与视觉-语言-动作（VLA）或世界-动作模型（WAM）无直接关联，但其语义优先的压缩传输思想对带宽受限的机器人遥操作或世界模型状态传输具有潜在借鉴价值。

The scheduler sends event records first and fills the remaining capacity with positions, appearance patches and keyframes. The ground turns the received records into a record table, and a language model answers the operator’s questions from that table.

papers.title: Semantics First, Pixels Later: Mission-Driven Event Streams for Drone Video over Bandwidth-Starved Links
papers.title_zh: 语义优先、像素其次：面向带宽受限链路的任务驱动无人机视频事件流

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding lets a cheap draft model propose tokens that a large language model verifies in a single forward pass. When the verifier keeps a KV cache, verification is cheap and drafting must be nearly free. Session-local drafters, which predict from the prompt and the text generated so far, meet that bar without training. We compare a recency-weighted, backing-off, confidence-gated session memory against prompt lookup decoding in its reference form, which copies from the earliest earlier match, and in a variant that copies from the most recent one, with paired per-prompt bootstrap intervals throughout. On general, medical, and legal text with a Mistral-7B verifier, recency accounts for the speed: most-recent lookup gains up to 0.09 in speedup over earliest-match lookup on 500-token generations, and session memory's weighting and backoff add nothing measurable on top, at 30 to 40 times the drafting cost. Energy tells a different story. On medical and legal text, unselective drafters are 14% faster than plain decoding yet use as much energy per token, while drafters that abstain on weak evidence save 3 to 4 joules per 100 tokens; a three-token minimum match length on prompt lookup matches the confidence-gated session memory. Outputs are token-identical to greedy decoding in 94% of generations, with every divergence at a numerical near-tie. Under a repetition penalty, long-generation speedups shrink from 1.4-1.7x to 1.1-1.2x, but recency still helps and the length floor is the only drafter that saves energy in both domains.

analysis.key_results: 最近匹配查找比最早匹配在500 token生成上速度提升可达0.09；无选择草稿在医学和法律文本上比普通解码快14%但能耗相当，选择性草稿每100个token节省3-4焦耳；输出在94%的生成中与贪婪解码完全一致。
analysis.main_contribution: 对比了会话局部记忆（重心加权、回退、置信门控）与提示查找解码（最早匹配与最近匹配变体），揭示近因匹配是速度提升主因，且选择性采用在能耗上优于无选择草稿。
analysis.method: 使用Mistral-7B作为验证器，在通用、医学和法律文本上比较不同会话局部草稿策略，并用配对自举区间评估速度提升、能耗和输出一致性。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文系统比较了基于会话局部记忆的草稿方法，发现在速度上近因匹配有效而权重与回退无益，但在能耗上选择性采用（置信门控或长度下限）能节省能量。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 与VLA和WAM无直接关系，但作为独立的推测解码效率研究，其会话局部草稿和基于置信度的弃权方法可为机器人策略或世界模型的高效推理提供参考。

papers.title: Text Speeding Itself Up: Recency and Restraint in Session-Local Drafting
papers.title_zh: 文本自我加速：会话局部起草中的近因与克制

papers.abstract: Vision-language models remain susceptible to visual hallucinations, often mixing grounded information with unsupported claims in the same response. Response-level reinforcement learning assigns a shared advantage to all tokens in a response, causing negative updates to suppress correct information alongside unsupported claims. To reduce hallucination while preserving useful visual information, we introduce SARGO (Self-guided Advantage-Routed Grounding Optimization), a post-training framework for selective reinforcement and suppression through on-policy self-guidance. Direct and reciprocal weighting gives better-supported tokens stronger reinforcement on positive updates and weaker penalties on negative updates. Agreement between overall and hallucination-specific advantages selects when to apply this guidance. At the response level, a reference-calibrated reward couples factuality with the retention and expansion of grounded information, discouraging lower hallucination scores obtained through omission. Experiments on Qwen3-VL-4B, Qwen3-VL-8B, and Gemma3-4B demonstrate that SARGO outperforms the evaluated mitigation baselines across Obj-Hal, AMBER, THRONE, and SHR evaluations. SARGO achieves these gains while preserving useful visual information and general multimodal capabilities.

analysis.key_results: 在 Qwen3-VL-4B、Qwen3-VL-8B 和 Gemma3-4B 上，SARGO 在 Obj-Hal、AMBER、THRONE 和 SHR 评估中优于基线。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 SARGO 框架，利用自引导的优势路由和参考校准奖励，选择性地强化有依据的 token 并抑制无依据的 token，以减少视觉幻觉。
analysis.method: 在策略自引导的直接和互惠加权、一致性门控，以及参考校准的响应级奖励，耦合事实性和有依据信息的保留。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: SARGO 是一个通过选择性强化和抑制来减少视觉语言模型幻觉的后训练框架，同时保留有用的视觉信息。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 不直接涉及 VLA、WAM 或机器人动作-世界建模，但包含视觉语言模型训练方法，可能对构建 VLA 的视觉基础模块具有参考价值。

figures.caption: Overview of SARGO. The frozen initial policy supplies reference responses for reward calibration, while the current policy scores its own rollouts under ordinary and privileged contexts to obtain token-level grounding support. Agreement between overall and hallucination-specific advantages selects when self-guidance applies. Direct and reciprocal weighting modulate the relative strength of token-level reinforcement and suppression, illustrated by bar magnitude. Neutral routes retain uniform token weights.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: SARGO: Agreement-Gated Reinforcement and Suppression via On-Policy Self-Guidance for Visual Hallucination Mitigation
papers.title_zh: SARGO：基于在策略自引导的一致性门控强化与抑制以缓解视觉幻觉

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have demonstrated strong capabilities in multi-task robotic manipulation. However, they still face limitations in control precision and execution stability during critical manipulation stages, such as object grasping, alignment and insertion. To combine general-purpose manipulation capabilities with task-specific fine-grained control, while enabling effective coordination between generalist and specialized policies throughout multi-stage manipulation tasks, this paper proposes MARS (Modular Atomic-skill Routing System), a dynamic routing framework for reinforcement learning-based atomic skills. MARS integrates a frozen generalist VLA policy with multiple independently trained atomic skill policies. Using a shared RL Token state representation and the reference action of VLA, specialized control policies are optimized through reinforcement learning for different cr`itical manipulation stages. For high-level policy selection, we develop a dynamic router that integrates temporal context and skill semantics. The router employs Mamba-based recurrent encoding and a historical feature window to capture state evolution during manipulation. Skill descriptions of candidate policies are encoded into semantic queries, and attention mechanisms are used to establish correspondences between skill semantics and temporal state features. Experimental results show that MARS achieves an average Macro-F1 score of 90.47% across four LIBERO task suites under fixed-trajectory evaluation, outperforming an MLP-based router by 7.08 percentage points. In the simulated Tube Transport task, the full-task success rate increases from 20.04% to 85.67%. These results demonstrate that stage-specific reinforcement learning and temporal state-aware dynamic policy routing can improve multi-policy coordination and overall task execution performance in multi-stage robotic manipulation.

analysis.key_results: 在四个LIBERO任务套件上平均Macro-F1达到90.47%，比MLP路由器高7.08个百分点；模拟Tube Transport任务全任务成功率从20.04%提升至85.67%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出MARS框架，整合通用VLA策略与特定阶段原子技能策略，并通过共享RL Token状态表示及参考动作进行强化学习优化；开发基于Mamba递归编码和语义查询的动态路由器，实现技能选择与时间状态特征的匹配。
analysis.method: 采用模块化原子技能路由系统，包含冻结VLA、多个独立训练的强化学习原子技能策略、共享RL Token表示、基于Mamba和注意力机制的动态路由器。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出MARS系统，将冻结的通用VLA模型与多个独立训练的原子技能策略结合，通过动态路由实现多阶段机器人操作中的细粒度控制。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文核心是VLA模型在机器人操作中的应用扩展，通过动态路由将通用VLA能力与任务特定原子技能结合，提升多阶段操作精度与稳定性，属于VLA与机器人学习交叉主题。

figures.caption: Overview of the MARS framework. MARS consists of three main components: shared state feature extraction, atomic skill policy learning, and dynamic skill routing. A shared RL Token adapter extracts compact state representations from the frozen VLA, supporting reinforcement learning-based atomic skill optimization with VLA reference actions. The dynamic router then combines historical state information and skill semantics to coordinate policy selection and switching during multi-stage manipulation.
figures.label: Figure 1

figures.caption: Architecture of the dynamic skill router. The dynamic skill router combines Mamba-based temporal encoding with a historical feature window to capture temporal context. Candidate skill descriptions form semantic queries, which interact through self-attention and extract skill-relevant historical features via cross-attention. A shared scoring network predicts routing probabilities, which guide the subsequent policy switching mechanism.
figures.label: Figure 2

papers.title: MARS: Dynamic Routing of Reinforcement-Learned Atomic Skills for Multi-Stage Robotic Manipulation
papers.title_zh: MARS：针对多阶段机器人操作中强化学习原子技能的动态路由框架

papers.abstract: Long-horizon embodied tasks fail in ways that end-task success cannot see. HospitalBench is a diagnostic benchmark of ten hospital chores in NVIDIA Isaac Sim, each two unscored warm-up steps followed by a causal chain of five scored sub-tasks in one continuous simulation: the state one step leaves (an object pose, a choice, a fact seen once) determines what the next step must do, unlike benchmarks that place sub-tasks side by side. Vision-language agents act through skill-level tools from camera images. A scripted robot that makes only the calls a model gets is the solvability check of a chore. From each trajectory the benchmark reads where a chain breaks, what the agent did after a failed call, and how far its own position estimate drifts from the true one. This version reports first results only: 15 of 60 planned runs (three models at high effort, one run each on chores T1 and T10 from both start states and T3 from one), with scripted-robot proofs on three of the ten chores. Of the 15 runs, 2 passed all five sub-tasks. Runs still going after sub-tasks 1 to 5 were 15, 8, 4, 2, 2. Of 189 failed calls, 168 were followed by a different call and 111 by a call that did not fail. These are first results and not a full benchmark. We will release the scenes, task chains, scripted robot, evaluation harness and trajectories.

analysis.key_results: 在已运行的 15 次试验中（共计划 60 次），有 2 次通过了全部五个子任务；各子任务后仍在继续的运行数分别为 15、8、4、2、2；在 189 次失败调用中，168 次之后跟随了不同的调用，111 次之后跟随了未失败的调用。
analysis.limitations: 当前仅报告了部分初步结果（15/60 次运行和 3/10 个脚本机器人证明），还不是完整的基准评估。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了 HospitalBench，一个用于诊断具身智能体在长时程医院任务链中失败位置和原因的基准，包含 10 个连续因果链任务、可解性检查脚本机器人和失败分析工具。
analysis.method: 在 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 中设计 10 个医院杂务任务链，每个任务链包含两个未计分的热身步骤和五个连续计分子任务；视觉语言智能体通过技能级工具从相机图像执行操作；使用脚本机器人验证任务可解性，并从轨迹中分析链断裂位置、失败后的调用行为以及位置估计漂移。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: HospitalBench 是一个在 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 中构建的诊断性基准，包含 10 个医院杂务长时程任务，每个任务由 5 个连续子任务组成，用于评估视觉语言智能体在具身环境中的因果链执行能力。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该基准面向视觉语言具身智能体，与 VLA 中的视觉语言和机器人操作能力直接相关，可用于评估 VLA 模型在长时程任务链中的表现，但与世界模型（WAM）无直接关系。

papers.abstract: We present CompoundingKernel, a self-improving agent system that writes GPU kernels by search. As of 2026-11-11, its generated kernels rank #1 on the public L1, L2 and Quantization boards of SOL-ExecBench (NVIDIA B200). They have held #1 on L1 since 2026-10-27, albeit a short loss on 2026-11-07. All 235 problems have a site-verified correct kernel; on the 209 public-board problems they are 4.40x faster than the benchmark's reference baseline. The search starts from zero: agents get each problem's PyTorch definition but no reference kernels or official scores. A per-problem archive outside the model holds every correct kernel and its lineage. An LLM controller reads it, picks a parent or a new design, and gives each parallel child agent one direction. Checks outside the model decide correctness. At equal wall time, it beat a coded UCB style tree on 35 of 38 problems by making 2.4x as many correct attempts. Over a thousand agents ran at once, and one warm restart fix raised their evaluation rate 3.6x. We find that the rate of reliable measurements, not the number of agents, limits how far such a search scales. Our code and kernels are available on URL.

analysis.key_results: 在209个公共榜单问题上，生成的内核比基准参考实现快4.40倍；在等墙钟时间内，35/38个问题上优于编码的UCB风格树搜索；超过一千个智能体并行运行，一次热重启修复将评估率提高了3.6倍。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了CompoundingKernel，一种自我改进的智能体系统，能够通过搜索生成高性能GPU内核，在SOL-ExecBench的L1、L2和Quantization公共榜单上排名第一。
analysis.method: 采用基于LLM控制器的搜索方法，每个问题维护一个包含正确内核及其谱系的存档，控制器选择父内核或新设计，并分配给并行子智能体特定方向进行搜索。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 介绍CompoundingKernel，一个通过搜索生成GPU内核并从零开始持续自我改进的智能体系统，在SOL-ExecBench基准上排名第一。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于通用GPU内核生成，特别涉及模型量化内核的优化，与VLA（视觉-语言-动作）和WAM（世界-动作模型）无直接关系，但其高效的量化内核搜索方法对VLA/WAM模型的高效推理部署具有潜在的方法论价值。

papers.abstract: In simulation, Vision-Agent-Action (VAA) performs pick-and-place in robot cells with gripper or base-frame changes without robot demonstrations or fine-tuning. It uses pre-trained vision-language and language models for interpretation, measures the command map and camera geometry from its own motion and fingertips, estimates lens distortion, and plans grasps from measured object depth. A controlled study of eight public LIBERO-fine-tuned vision-language-action models (VLAs) varies robot hardware, camera geometry, appearance, and base frame. Gripper and frame changes dominate their losses in the tested fractional design. Across 18 cells with these changes, frozen VAA achieves 230/360 successes (64%), the refined VAA 268/360 (74%), and the strongest released VLA on this subset 76/360 (21%). Paired ablations support the self-calibration bundle, lens estimation under compounded changes, and the measured-depth pipeline. On a two-step LIBERO-Goal chain with object state carried between instructions, VAA completes 54/60 chains in changed cells, while four evaluated VLAs complete none.

analysis.key_results: 在18个包含变化的单元上，冻结VAA成功230/360次(64%)，精炼VAA成功268/360次(74%)，最强VLA仅成功76/360次(21%)；在两步LIBERO-Goal链上，VAA完成54/60次，而四个评估的VLA模型均未完成。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出自校准VAA方法，结合预训练视觉语言模型与语言模型进行零样本迁移，并通过自身的运动、指尖测量和镜头畸变估计实现自校准，显著优于现有微调的视觉语言动作(VLA)模型。
analysis.method: 使用预训练视觉语言模型和语言模型进行解释，测量命令映射和相机几何，估计镜头畸变，根据测量的物体深度规划抓取，并通过自校准在无演示和微调的条件下部署抓取放置任务。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种自校准的视觉-智能体-动作(VAA)方法，在不使用机器人演示或微调的情况下，将抓取放置策略部署到具有夹爪或基座框架变化的新机器人单元。

papers.abstract: JEPA-based world models predict action consequences in latent space, but representative planning approaches rely on candidate-action search, requiring repeated evaluation of action sequences and incurring substantial online computational cost. Direct action generation avoids this search, yet how to leverage latent predictions to guide action generation given task goals remains a key challenge in translating learned physical dynamics into effective decisions. We introduce WA-JEPA, a world-action model that couples action generation, action-conditioned latent prediction, and goal-aware feedback. The model first generates an action proposal and predicts the resulting future scenes and proprioceptive states, then refines the proposal through two complementary feedback paths, using the task goal as a reference. Goal-discrepancy residual feedback (GDRF) uses differences between the latent representations of predicted scenes and the task goal to guide chunk-wise action refinement. Future-scene context feedback (FSCF) preserves fine-grained predicted scene representations to guide subsequent action refinement. Jointly learned from offline demonstrations, this process iteratively updates the same plan before execution, making future predictions directly participate in action generation without candidate-action search. We evaluate short-horizon goal reaching, long-horizon tasks, and full-task execution. The results show that goal-aware predictive feedback supports competitive task performance while maintaining a compact model and low online computational cost. Code is available at https://github.com/Dovisya/WA-JEPA.

analysis.key_results: 在短时程目标到达、长时程任务和全任务执行中展示竞争性任务性能，同时保持紧凑模型和低在线计算成本。
analysis.main_contribution: 将动作生成、动作条件潜在预测和目标感知反馈耦合，绕开候选动作搜索，使未来预测直接参与动作生成，同时保持低在线计算成本。
analysis.method: WA-JEPA 生成动作提案并预测未来场景和本体感觉状态，然后通过目标差异残差反馈（GDRF）和未来场景上下文反馈（FSCF）两条路径迭代精化动作，使用任务目标作为参考。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出世界-动作模型 WA-JEPA，通过目标感知的潜在预测反馈迭代精化动作，无需候选动作搜索即可实现高效规划。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该研究核心为世界-动作模型（WAM），属于机器人策略学习和世界建模方向，通过隐空间预测反馈直接生成动作，对 VLA/WAM 相关研究具有直接参考价值。

papers.abstract: Robot-use agents (RUAs) have emerged as a promising approach to general-purpose robot control. However, strong performance has so far been achieved only by frontier proprietary models such as GPT-6 Astra and Claude Fable 5.2, whereas open-weight models remain substantially less capable. We show that an open-weight 27B reasoning model can be trained to use real robots natively through reinforcement learning, entirely in simulation and without demonstrations. Like a computer-use agent (CUA), the model observes the environment, reasons in a chain of thought, and generates the next end-effector pose, without any harness. We build a Post-training Engine for Agentic Robotics (PEAR) and use it to train the model on simulated robot tasks at scale with robot-use reinforcement learning (RURL), mirroring how frontier models acquire computer use. We find that the skills acquired in simulation generalize well beyond the training tasks: they transfer to an unseen robot, to the real world, and to novel instructions. After training on LIBERO and RoboDojo in simulation, the model succeeds in 60% of our trials on a real dual-arm robot, whereas the base model succeeds in none. On LIBERO, training raises the success rate from 1.6% to 74.4%, approaching GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol at maximum reasoning effort. Compared with $\pi_{0.5}$, a vision-language-action model fine-tuned on demonstrations, our model is substantially more robust to changes in the task itself. On LIBERO-Pro, $\pi_{0.5}$ succeeds in only 0.75% of episodes when assigned a new task in a familiar scene whereas our model succeeds in 57.4%. Finally, the model retains its general capabilities, with no measurable degradation on nine reasoning, coding and vision benchmarks. These results highlight robot-use reinforcement learning as a promising component of foundation-model post-training.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO和RoboDojo仿真训练后，真实双臂机器人试验成功率达60%，而基座模型为0；在LIBERO上成功率从1.6%提升至74.4%；在LIBERO-Pro上对新任务的成功率达57.4%，优于π0.5的0.75%；在九个基准上无性能退化。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了一种后训练引擎（PEAR），用于在仿真中通过机器人使用强化学习（RURL）训练开源推理模型，使其原生地控制真实机器人，且无需示范。
analysis.method: 在仿真中构建大规模机器人任务，使用强化学习训练开源推理模型，模型观察环境、链式思考并生成末端执行器位姿。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种机器人使用智能体（RUA）方法，通过仿真中的强化学习训练开源推理模型原生控制真实机器人，无需示范。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接研究VLA（视觉-语言-动作）模型的强化学习后训练，通过仿真训练推理模型原生地控制机器人，对VLA研究具有核心价值。

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates generation by letting a lightweight drafter propose tokens for parallel verification by a target model. Diffusion drafters such as DFlash propose an entire token block in a single forward pass, but mainly focus on text-only tasks, leaving multimodal drafting underexplored. To study this setting, we first introduce a metric of token-level visual dependence based on the KL divergence between next-token distributions with and without visual input. We find that acceptance rates decrease from 46% in the lowest visual-dependence quartile to 22% in the highest, with this disparity persisting after multimodal training. Motivated by this observation, we propose MMFlash, a simple and effective framework that adaptively upweights visually dependent tokens that the drafter predicts poorly. For long video inputs, MMFlash further employs sparse attention to reduce redundant attention computation and improve drafting quality. Across various multimodal benchmarks, MMFlash achieves lossless decoding speedups of up to $3.58\times$, outperforming EAGLE-3 and DFlash by up to 195.4% and 17.1%, respectively.

analysis.key_results: 在多个多模态基准上实现最高3.58倍无损解码加速，分别比EAGLE-3和DFlash最高提升195.4%和17.1%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出MMFlash框架，通过自适应加权视觉依赖token并采用稀疏注意力，在多个多模态基准上实现无损解码加速，优于EAGLE-3和DFlash。
analysis.method: 首先基于有无视觉输入下的下一token分布KL散度定义token级视觉依赖度；MMFlash自适应加权视觉依赖token，并使用稀疏注意力处理长视频输入。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出MMFlash框架，通过自适应加权视觉依赖token和稀疏注意力，提升视觉语言模型推测解码的速度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于视觉语言模型的推测解码加速，属于高效推理方法，虽未直接涉及VLA或世界模型，但所提技术可迁移至机器人多模态模型的加速推理，具有潜在参考价值。

Each masked position of a block keeps its base weight b k b_{k} and gains a visual bonus that depends on d t d_{t} . (b) The MMFlash drafter adopts a simple sparse attention pattern for video inputs, shrinking a context of more than 40K tokens to about 1.6K.

papers.abstract: Agent sessions may involve frequent context edits, which effectively invalidate cached KV state and force requests to wait for re-prefill before decoding. We present Callo, a disaggregated serving system that leverages invalidated KV for speculative drafts to reduce this latency, while verifying drafts against the exact KV after prefill before committing tokens. Callo makes effective use of decode resources by scheduling speculations during periods of underutilization and preempting speculations when drafts are likely to not be accepted. We evaluated Callo on a two-GPU testbed using SWE-agent sessions across three model families, observing all-request speedups of 1.05-1.19x over vLLM at moderate load. We demonstrate that these gains are also realized at scale through cluster-level simulations driven by real-world traces.

analysis.key_results: 在两 GPU 测试平台上，使用 SWE-agent 会话在三个模型家族上进行评估，中等负载下相对 vLLM 所有请求加速 1.05-1.19 倍；通过基于真实轨迹的集群级模拟展示了在规模上的收益。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 Callo，一个在预填-解码分离服务系统中利用失效 KV 进行推测解码的系统，以减少上下文编辑导致的缓存未命中请求的延迟。
analysis.method: 在预填-解码分离架构中，利用失效的 KV 生成推测草稿，并在预填完成后根据精确 KV 验证草稿；通过在解码资源空闲时调度推测、在草稿可能不被接受时抢占推测来高效利用资源。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: Callo 通过在预填-解码分离架构下利用失效 KV 提供推测草稿，减少因上下文编辑导致的缓存未命中请求的等待延迟。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文直接聚焦于推测解码这一独立的高效推理主题，并未涉及 VLA、WAM 或机器人技术；其方法可能为后续在机器人策略或世界模型中采用推测解码提供系统层面的借鉴。

papers.abstract: Clinical world models expose language-model agents to predicted patient responses, but simulations can be unreliable for poorly supported treatments or unfamiliar hospitals. We introduce Support-Gated World-Model decision support, a lightweight extension of a propose--simulate--refine agent. A recurrent dynamics ensemble predicts short-horizon physiological responses to documented norepinephrine dose categories, while a behavior model estimates observational action support. The interface withholds predictions with insufficient support or excessive ensemble disagreement and abstains when no candidate qualifies. Evaluation on eICU-CRD includes 70 hospitals and 30,700 decision transitions, with 14 hospitals held out for testing. At 62.0% factual-transition coverage, joint gating yields a MAP mean absolute error of 7.3 mmHg, compared with 9.2 mmHg for random selection at the same coverage. The gated agent achieves 60.0% agreement with recorded actions at 81.0% decision coverage, compared with 55.0% agreement and 99.5% coverage for an ungated ensemble agent. Component ablations show lower factual risk with joint gating than with either gate alone.These results characterize a reliability--coverage trade-off in selective clinical simulation; they do not identify individualized treatment effects or establish improved patient outcomes.

analysis.key_results: 在 eICU-CRD 数据集（70家医院，30,700个决策转移，14家医院测试集）上，62.0% 事实转移覆盖率下 MAP 平均绝对误差为 7.3 mmHg，对比同覆盖率随机选择为 9.2 mmHg；门控智能体在 81.0% 决策覆盖率下与记录动作一致率达 60.0%，而无门控集成智能体为 55.0% 一致率和 99.5% 覆盖率；消融实验显示联合门控比单独门控具有更低的事实风险。
analysis.limitations: 结果表征选择性临床模拟中的可靠性-覆盖率权衡；未识别个体化治疗效果或证实改善患者结局。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入 Support-Gated World-Model 决策支持框架，结合循环动力学集成与行为模型估计动作支撑，通过联合门控与弃权机制提升临床模拟的可靠性。
analysis.method: 使用反复动力学集成预测短期生理响应，行为模型估计观察动作支撑，并通过联合门控（支撑不足或集成分歧过大时抑制预测）与无候选合格时弃权。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种支撑门控世界模型决策支持方法，通过预测自信度门控选择性临床模拟，在可靠性-覆盖率权衡中提高预测精度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文涉及世界模型在临床决策支持中的应用，与机器人世界建模（WAM）在方法论上相关（选择性模拟、置信度门控、动态预测），但不涉及视觉-语言-动作（VLA）或机器人操作，无直接机器人学联系。

papers.abstract: We introduce Gamer, a generalist agent framework built for long-horizon tasks in complex interactive environments. Its end-to-end architecture combines perception, memory management, and multi-step reasoning. A shared training and deployment pipeline supports interaction with both conventional 2D graphical interfaces and complex 3D simulated worlds. We first continue pre-training on a dataset constructed from tens of thousands of hours of device-level keyboard and mouse interaction. These trajectories span simulated games and embodied environments, allowing the model to learn environmental dynamics across both physical and virtual domains. Sparse-thinking instruction tuning then substantially reduces redundant computation while preserving the reasoning needed for complex decisions. We train the policy for long-horizon interaction with a stable multi-turn reinforcement learning method that addresses finite context windows, accumulated rollout errors, and sparse rewards. For real-time interaction, a cloud-edge inference engine serves numerous simulated game environments concurrently, supports unbounded-context execution, and keeps online inference latency low. Across multiple challenging 3D open-world games, Gamer demonstrates solid generalization and operational efficiency comparable to skilled players. It also achieves competitive results on a range of conventional 2D game benchmarks. These results suggest that even repetitive keyboard and mouse trajectories can support substantial gains from scaling data and learning algorithms. Training on these trajectories helps Gamer learn complex skills more steadily in environments with both physical and digital properties. This approach offers a path toward generalist agents that can interact across digital and physical worlds.

analysis.key_results: 在多个具有挑战性的3D开放世界游戏中表现出扎实的泛化能力和接近熟练玩家的操作效率；在多种传统2D游戏基准上取得有竞争力的结果。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出一个统一的端到端通用智能体框架Gamer，支持2D图形界面和3D模拟世界中的长时程实时交互，并通过大规模键盘鼠标轨迹的持续预训练、稀疏思考指令调优和稳定多轮强化学习，实现高效的训练与推理。
